remarks: This stunning Hollywood Regency-inspired home inside the gates of The Springs  represents the most compelling luxury value in Rancho Mirage. Optimized to captivate design purists, this rare property merges explosive dramatic aesthetics with a private backyard oasis featuring your own pool and peekaboo mountain views. Step inside this wonderful floor plan, which features 10-foot ceilings in the grand entertaining room with a fireplace and formal dining area. Features include tile flooring hand-laid in a striking diagonal pattern throughout most of the living area, mirrored accent walls, and a fully updated custom wet bar with a paneled front, premium quartz counters, a built-in sink, and dedicated wine refrigeration. The centerpiece is the masterfully executed chef's kitchen, featuring cabinetry in a two-tone tuxedo design. Bathed in natural light from a massive skylight, the kitchen features premium self-closing doors, dovetail drawers, crisp quartz counters, a counter-to-ceiling designer tile backsplash, and a full walk-in pantry. Elite culinary execution is guaranteed by a top-tier Bosch appliance package, including a 5-burner induction cooktop, all anchored by a wide peninsula bar top with a raised panel cabinet front. The seamless indoor-outdoor desert lifestyle flows effortlessly into a sun-drenched morning room, leading out to the private pool through expansive glass doors. All bedrooms feature updated, driftwood-colored wood-look flooring and custom plantation shutters. The expansive primary suite boasts a custom-organized walk-in closet and a timeless, preserved primary bath wrapped in classic marble flooring with double vanities and an oval soaking tub. Smart infrastructure upgrades include a new tankless hot water heater. Numerous other improvements are found throughout this delightful home. Offered at an irresistible, sub-million-dollar price point, this true designer styled showplace perfectly blends high-end updates with well-preserved original details. Experience an extraordinary country club lifestyle featuring the acclaimed 18-hole Desmond Muirhead championship golf course, premier tennis and pickleball, a state-of-the-art fitness center, exceptional dining, and a vibrant social scene. Ideally located in the heart of Rancho Mirage, this prestigious community offers the ultimate expression of refined desert living. Secure this magnificent turnkey footprint before it's gone.

remarks:
Where the days get easier and the living gets bigger.
You know the feeling you're after. The one where the house stops asking things of you, and the day opens up instead — whether that day still holds a full calendar of work or not.
It starts slow here, even on a workday. Coffee in your own private yard, fully enclosed and quiet, a clear head before the first call. When the laptop finally closes, the day is yours to stack however you like — a spirited game of pickleball, then a few laps in the pool, easing into the warm water of the spa as the afternoon winds down. Other days it's a walk to the lake, the water running over the rocks and the path looping you home. And the clubhouse has a way of gathering everyone, so good company is always close by.
The home is the part you stop thinking about. One level, all of it — no stairs at the end of a long day, now or twenty years from now — nothing half-finished, nothing waiting on you. It's attached, but it lives like a house of its own: your own entry, your own garage that brings you right inside, your own walls. The main living space opens up bright and easy, the kind of room that hosts a dinner as simply as it holds a quiet Tuesday. And the second room earns its keep — a real office on the working days, a soft landing for guests on the others, or the studio for the thing you finally have time to do.
Past the front door, all of Rancho Mission Viejo is yours: resort pools and spas, tennis and bocce, fitness studios, a dog park, and trails climbing up into the hills. And as a 55+ resident in Gavilan, you have something more — the exclusive amenities reserved just for this community, with an all-new recreation destination opening soon that takes the whole experience to another level. An ordinary week starts to feel like being away, even when you haven't gone anywhere.
This is the version of these years you've been picturing — upkeep shrinking, life expanding, on your schedule and around your work. Lock the door, head out, and let the community carry the rest.
Move-in ready and low-maintenance, this lock-and-leave home offers work-from-home flex space and lives like a single-family residence in the 55+ Gavilan enclave of Rancho Mission Viejo, South Orange County.

The open kitchen flows easily into the family room, creating a relaxed, connected space for everyday living. An outdoor laundry room keeps interior living space open and uncluttered.

Step outside to a flat, private backyard made for slowing down — shaded by fruit trees, including productive lemon trees, with plenty of room to garden, unwind, or simply enjoy the quiet. Two storage sheds and a second detached structure keep the space tidy and functional, while a covered carport comfortably fits two vehicles.

Big-ticket peace of mind comes standard: a roof that's only 3 years young, sewer line work already completed, and solar that will be paid off at closing — so you can settle in without worrying about what's next.

A great fit for a first-time buyer, or anyone looking for a home with character, calm, and room to grow.

remarks: A beautifully reimagined two-story residence tucked behind lush landscaping, this inviting home blends modern design with exceptional indoor-outdoor living. Conveniently located near Exposition Park, USC, public transportation, and major Los Angeles destinations, this home offers the perfect blend of privacy, comfort, and city convenience.

remarks: Discover the grandeur of the historic Mendenhall Estate, a fully restored and expanded home with Gold Rush-era roots located at the base of Palomar Mountain. Originally settled in 1879 as part of the Rancho Cuca Mexican land, this custom home features interior design elements that reflect the decor of the early 1900s. Once home to the Mendenhall cattle ranching family, the estate beautifully blends California history with modern luxury.  Spanning 5,469 square feet and nestled on 1.81 acres, the property includes 5 bedrooms/5 bathrooms.  The home has been completely remodeled and restored to its former glory, featuring top-of-the-line finishes throughout, including dazzling K9 crystal accents on chandeliers, doorknobs, and even hot/cold shower handles. Bathrooms feature Bluetooth-enabled sound systems and ambient overhead lighting with customizable color settings, bringing spa-like comfort into everyday living. In the upstairs primary suite, custom wall sconces add a warm, designer touch to both the bedroom and bath, elevating the ambiance and craftsmanship throughout. The poured concrete walls provide insulation and tranquility, while tons of windows offer an abundance of natural light and stunning mountain views. The main level features Brazilian travertine floors, 3 bedrooms (with a primary en-suite), 2 bathrooms, an office, a sunroom, 2 fireplaces, and direct access to the thermal-pane heated pool and a yard inspired by English gardens. The chef's kitchen impresses with natural quartzite countertops and premium appliances, including Miele, Bosch, Fisher Paykel, and appliance garages. Additionally, there is a spacious secondary kitchen that offers ample counter space for food preparation with plenty of cabinets for storage.  The newly permitted top floor offers 1,752 square feet of living space, which includes two bedrooms, two bathrooms, and a loft area. It features beautiful cedar ceilings and luxurious Italian marble vanities, and the flooring is luxury vinyl planks that are waterproof. The remodeled upstairs has a primary suite that boasts a spacious bathroom with a jetted tub, set in a custom-designed alcove. Additionally, there are roomy his-and-her walk-in closets that allow for personalized storage solutions. Plus, in the closet, you'll also find washer-dryer hookups along with space for a folding table. The primary bedroom is generously sized and showcases an antique stained-glass window from a church dating back to the 1800s. This top floor has its own dedicated water heater, ensuring instant hot water through a recirculating line to the guest bathroom. Additionally, the primary bedroom is equipped with a beverage refrigerator and a marble-topped coffee bar. All toilets throughout the home are from the Toto brand. The 605 square foot finished walkout basement comprises a living space, a bathroom, laundry facilities, 4 windows, AC/heating, and a private entry. There are two staircases on each side of the house to access the upper quarters.  Other features include plantation shutters, coffered ceilings, and a French Empire Crystal Chandelier. The estate also features 55 paid-for and owned solar panels and a producing well that sources Palomar Mountain spring water. No more high utility bills!  All these provide an eco-efficient estate living. Additional highlights include a new septic system installed in 2025 (with a 1,500-gallon tank and 150 feet of additional leech lines), a newer 3D Corning roof & Designer gutters that consist of custom copper-colored seamless gutters, including leaf guards, and antique downspouts. The upstairs has a new advanced HVAC system with 3 new split systems. The property is adorned with numerous fruit-bearing trees and includes an antique 40-foot Fruehauf trailer for storage. There is also an RV dump station. This estate is a rare and luxurious blend of history and modern convenience, awaiting a discerning buyer. It offers both seclusion and convenience. remarks: Charming Desert Hideaway with Pool, Spa & Mountain Views Welcome to this beautifully maintained custom-built home located in the highly desirable Harmony Acres neighborhood of Twentynine Palms. Offering over 1,800 square feet of comfortable living space, this 3-bedroom, 2-bath residence blends character, quality, and true desert charm. Built in 1992 and lovingly cared for, the home is in excellent condition and features unique architectural elements throughout. The main living area showcases a stunning cathedral-style vaulted ceiling that rises to a dramatic central peak, creating a spacious, open feel with striking visual appeal—a true centerpiece of the home. Designed to capture the essence of desert living, the home offers a seamless indoor-outdoor connection. Expansive windows from both the living room and kitchen frame the sparkling pool and spa, drawing your eye outside and creating the feeling that the outdoor space is part of the home itself—perfect for entertaining or simply enjoying peaceful desert days and evenings. Inside, you’ll also find a distinctive round bar, adding character and a great space to gather with friends and family, along with a functional and inviting layout designed for everyday living. Step outside to your private backyard retreat featuring a gunite pool and relaxing jacuzzi, surrounded by block walls for privacy and set against beautiful mountain views. Whether you're hosting guests or unwinding under the desert sky, this space offers the ideal setting. Additional highlights include a durable tile roof and a spacious 3-car garage, providing ample room for vehicles, storage, or hobbies. Conveniently located yet tucked away for privacy, this home is just one block from the well-known Huell Howser Estate, approximately 20 minutes to Joshua Tree National Park and the Village, 1 hour to Palm Springs, and about 2 hours to Big Bear Lake. Twentynine Palms continues to grow and attract attention, now home to the exciting Tortoise Rock Casino. Whether you’re searching for a full-time residence, vacation home, or investment opportunity, this one-of-a-kind property is a must-see. Schedule your private showing today and experience this exceptional desert retreat for yours

remarks: Epic Puerto Vallarta, Mexico Remodeled Oceanfront Masterpiece. Steps from Los Muertos Beach, Puerto Vallarta's Most Celebrated Shore. Life doesn't get better than this. Perched just steps above Los Muertos Beach in the heart of Puerto Vallarta's iconic Romantic Zone, this stunning remodeled oceanfront home delivers jetliner views of the Pacific and the effortless indoor-outdoor lifestyle you've always imagined. Step inside and be immediately captivated by soaring high-volume ceilings and a dramatic floor-to-ceiling wall of glass that frames unobstructed ocean views from every angle. The open-concept living and dining area flows seamlessly onto a sprawling entertainer's deck complete with dedicated lounge, dining, and breakfast areas, all with those unforgettable Pacific views as your backdrop.One level below, a sparkling pool beckons. One level below that? Direct private beach access to Los Muertos Beach.The home's three generously sized en-suite bedrooms and 3.5 bathrooms make it ideal for hosting family and friends in style. Every room captures the view. The chef-friendly kitchen comes fully equipped with stainless steel appliances and a convenient pass-through window to the dining areas. The entire home is fully air-conditioned throughout.Residents also enjoy a gorgeous shared infinity pool among just five exclusive residences in the building, along with overnight security for complete peace of mind.Outside your door, the world-renowned Romantic Zone awaits in close proximity, celebrated restaurants, beach clubs & pools, LIVELY nightlife, charming cafs, and boutique shopping.This is a rare opportunity to own one of Puerto Vallarta's most enviable oceanfront addresses. Come see it, you may never want to leave.

remarks: Welcome to Ironridge at Metro Heights, a new home community located in Montebello, CA which is approximately 20 minutes from downtown LA. Unit 503 is a new construction luxury condo located on the second floor. The Glenn floor plan features 3 bedrooms with 2 bathrooms a 2-car garage and is 1,447 sqft. Upon entering the home, you walk into the open floor plan,  which leads into kitchen. The kitchen features a kitchen island with a stainless-steel sink and Whirlpool appliances. The primary bedroom suite provides a beautiful walk-in closet and a spa like bath with a dual sink vanity. Highlights of this home are the 10ft. high ceilings throughout, and an upgraded interior insulation package, and a multi-slide stacked door leading to the  expansive balcony. The community amenities include multiple pocket parks, a walking trail, an attended front gate, and a 10,000 square foot community center with two pools, cabanas, multiple outdoor kitchens, office space, private areas for parties and a fitness center. Conveniently located near Montebello Shopping Center, the 60 and 605 freeways, and a variety of dining options. Unit 503 has an estimated closing date in November 2026. Photos provided are renderings, actual home is under construction.

The open floor plan features a spacious living room with a cozy fireplace, large dining area, and expansive view balcony perfect for relaxing or entertaining. The kitchen enjoys panoramic views from its picture window, while a second balcony off the dining area brings in abundant natural light.
The primary suite offers dual closets and an en-suite bath with dual sinks. A bright secondary bedroom with scenic views is ideal as a guest room or home office. Upgrades include luxury vinyl plank flooring, PEX plumbing, Recently added Air Conditioner and  Water Heater. A Flow-Tech water conditioning system has been installed in garage. Direct access to the oversized two-car garage provides exceptional storage, plus a private driveway accommodates two additional vehicles (4 car parking). Located in the desirable Encore community of Marina Hills, residents enjoy resort-style amenities including pools, spas, tennis and pickleball courts, BBQ and picnic areas, meeting rooms, and responsive on-site management. Home has been recently appraised at well over asking.
Conveniently located near award-winning schools, scenic hiking and biking trails, Laguna Beach, Salt Creek Beach, Dana Point Harbor, UCI, Saddleback College, and major freeways. An exceptional opportunity to enjoy privacy, spectacular views, and the best of South Orange County living.

remarks:
Located in Irvine’s highly sought-after Northwood community, this home offers an exceptional combination of generous proportions, abundant natural light, and a highly functional floor plan designed for refined everyday living. Soaring ceilings, dramatic skylights, and expansive windows create a bright and airy atmosphere throughout the main living spaces. The seamless connection between the living room, dining area, and kitchen provides an elegant setting for both everyday comfort and entertaining. One of the home’s most desirable features is the main-level primary suite, offering privacy, convenience, and flexibility rarely found in comparable homes. The suite features generous dimensions, a spacious walk-in closet, and a private bath, while the secondary bedrooms are thoughtfully located upstairs.The kitchen provides extensive cabinetry and workspace and opens to a light-filled breakfast area overlooking the surrounding greenery. Additional flexible living spaces are ideal for a home office, media room, or guest accommodations.Set on a well-proportioned lot, the property features inviting front and rear outdoor spaces ideal for alfresco dining, entertaining, gardening, or creating a customized outdoor retreat. A three-car garage offers valuable parking and storage, while the fully paid-off solar system adds the benefit of improved energy efficiency with no ongoing solar lease or payment.
The neighborhood feeds into highly rated Irvine schools and is only a short walk to multiple local parks. Conveniently located near shopping, dining, recreation, and major transportation routes, this home offers the space, flexibility, and established neighborhood setting that are increasingly difficult to find in Irvine. Enjoy all that Irvine living has to offer.

remarks: This is an international listing located in Cyprus. Set in one of Paphos' most sought-after locations, Elysia Blu is a thoughtfully designed residential community that blends contemporary architecture with the effortless lifestyle of the Mediterranean. Just a short 10-minute walk from the seafront, it offers the perfect balance between vibrant city energy and a serene, resort-like retreat.Comprising 10 architecturally striking buildings and approximately 200 elegantly designed residences, the development is centered around expansive landscaped gardens and curated communal spaces that create a true sense of connection and tranquility. Natural light, clean lines, and refined materials define each residence, delivering a modern yet timeless living experience.Elysia Blu is designed as a lifestyle destination. Residents enjoy resort-style pools, including dedicated children's areas, along with a full suite of wellness amenities such as a state-of-the-art fitness center, spa, sauna, jacuzzi, and yoga spaces. Outdoor areas are equally impressive, featuring a padel court, fitness pavilion, and thoughtfully designed recreational zones that encourage both relaxation and activity.At the heart of the community lies a curated selection of lifestyle conveniences, including a boutique market, caf-style dining, and social spaces that foster a sense of belonging. A vibrant kids' club and organized community experiences further enhance the living environment, making it ideal for both residents and investors seeking a well-rounded lifestyle offering.Located in the historic and culturally rich city of Paphos  a UNESCO-listed destination known for its heritage, coastline, and year-round appeal  Elysia Blu represents a rare opportunity to own within a modern, design-forward community in one of the Mediterranean's most desirable markets. MULTIPLE LISTINGS AVAILABLE starting at $395,000 for one bedroom. 2 & 3 bedroom options are available. Please, contact for pricing and square footage.

The neighborhood features a pool, dedicated storage unit and RV/boat parking at the east end of the subdivision. The star of this property is the view of the Valley from the back of the house. It includes two gas fireplaces, a central vacuum system, and dual HVAC systems.

remarks: Enchanting home near the lake featuring a unique multi/ split level floor plan. It's perfect for the home seeker who wants separation between rooms: the non-open concept fan who values quaint and cozy or who imagines an elegant country retreat close to the lake! With a first floor entry that opens into a spacious living space with a fireplace, wet bar, half bath and slider to the gracious deck overlooking Hidden Valley Lake. The next level, with solid oak floors, is where you'll find the kitchen and dining area, and also access to the garage and backyard. The three bedrooms are on the last level, all separated by steps going in different directions. The primary bedroom has peekaboo views of the lake and surrounding mountains, but with a few branches pruned from the shady oak trees, the view will transform from peek-a-boo to OMG! In addition to the attached bath, the primary has a sweet vanity area and a walk in closet. Other pleasant surprises include a newly redone balcony off the second bedroom, and a fabulous oversized closet in the third bedroom. Abundant storage throughout! The upstairs utility room would make a fabulous office or crafting room. This home's roof, electrical panel and HVAC unit are all newer, so it's just awaiting your vision and cosmetic upgrades to create an absolute dream home.

remarks:
Completed in 2023, this gated estate offers approximately 11,100 square feet of refined living space on a private, elevated 2.23-acre homesite exceptional privacy and refreshing coastal breezes. 

The property combines a single-level main residence with a fully appointed second-floor guest residence, ideal for multigenerational living, extended stays, or staff accommodations. Beyond two private gates, a long, tree-lined private driveway leads to an impressive motor court and grand entrance. Hand-forged iron doors open to interiors featuring Italian Carrara marble floors, marble columns, custom cherry wood cabinetry, decorative ironwork, stained-glass skylights, and Czech crystal chandeliers. Oversized arched windows fill the home with natural light while showcasing the privacy and openness of the grounds. 

The main residence offers a formal living room with marble fireplace, chandelier-lit dining room, and expansive family room. Additional spaces include a walnut bar with an Italian natural jade stone countertop, wine room, executive office with en-suite bath, and private cinema with massage seating. The chef’s kitchen features Italian marble flooring, custom cherry cabinetry, premium Miele appliances, abundant storage, and generous gathering space. The primary suite is a private retreat with a marble fireplace, wool carpeting, sauna, two walk-in closets, and separate bathrooms. Secondary bedroom suites provide comfort and privacy for family and guests. 

With its own entrance and assigned address, the attached second-floor guest residence includes two bedrooms, two bathrooms, a full kitchen, spacious living room, laundry room, and two private balconies. Outdoor amenities include a kitchen and barbecue area, covered entertaining spaces, expansive grounds, a fountain-centered motor court, and Belgard Eco Dublin permeable pavers. Garages accommodate up to six vehicles, with additional parking within the gated grounds. 

Additional features include a commercial-grade fire alarm system, security-camera monitoring and Nest climate controls. The property benefits from two addresses, with the second address assigned to the second-floor residence. Potential exists for an ADU, subject to required approvals. Some photographs include virtual staging in the balcony, garages, and pool areas. Renderings of the pool, hardscape, and fire pit area are conceptual only, differ from plans available for review, intended solely to illustrate potential improvements.

remarks: This beautiful California Landings home in Fontana, built in 1997, is designed for comfortable everyday living with room to gather, relax, and celebrate. With 2,648 square feet of inviting space, it offers the kind of layout that flows naturally where mornings start easily, afternoons unfold comfortably, and evenings feel just right.  This recently remodeled home has been designed for moder comfort.  Described as spacious, Flexible, and Made for Living, this home features 4 bedrooms and 3 baths, with a layout that balances privacy and togetherness. A laundry room adds everyday convenience, and the two-car garage, with a bonus storage area and the driveway provides parking for up to four cars.  Step into the open concept heart of the home where the kitchen and family room connect beautifully and ideal for hosting, homework, movie nights, and casual conversations.  The kitchen has been recently remodeled with stunning stone countertops, adding both style and function. Throughout the home you’ll find new laminate and tile flooring and fresh interior paint.  Upstairs you’ll discover a large family game room, perfect for a home office, game nights, play space, or a cozy retreat for everyone. Your large primary suite is a retreat of its own. Enjoy a separate tub and a walk-in shower, plus a private toilet area and a large walk-in closet. The double sinks in the primary bathroom add a touch of luxury and make mornings run smoothly.  Step outside on the balcony from the primary suite to enjoy a beautiful view of the mountains, the perfect backdrop for quiet mornings, evening breezes, or simply unwinding at the end of the day.  Outside, the backyard is ready entertainment, and comfortable quiet living when you don’t. Whether you’re hosting friends, creating weekend traditions, or enjoying a calm evening outdoors, this space is built for the moments you’ll look forward to.  This neighborhood offers close freeway access, plus shopping, grocery stores, and large retailers such as Costco and Home Depot, just minutes away.  The original owners of this house built more than a home; they built a life. With love, family, and countless friends celebrating special events, this home has been the setting for memorable beginnings and meaningful gatherings.  Now it’s time for the next chapter.  Welcome home, your new memories are waiting.

remarks:
Nestled in the heart of the San Bernardino Mountains, this well-maintained Forest Service cabin offers a comfortable mountain retreat with modern updates and convenient year-round access. Located approximately 20 miles from Redlands via maintained state and county paved roads, the property features a private driveway off Jenks Lake Road and includes the rare benefit of a garage for a Forest Service cabin.
The interior provides a functional and inviting layout, accommodating up to eight occupants. Features include two bedrooms with full-size beds, a loft with two twin beds, and a living room with a new pull-out sofa. Furnishings have been updated throughout, offering a cohesive mountain aesthetic with practical comfort. (Inventory list available). The kitchen combines character and utility with restored vintage elements and modern upgrades, including a refurbished cast-iron stove, (or use the new propane stove), farmhouse sink, and quartz countertops. The bathroom includes a claw foot tub with shower enclosure. Recent improvements include updated plumbing, electrical outlets, lighting fixtures, window screens and blinds, ceiling joist reinforcement in the kitchen/loft area and new underlayment and flooring in the loft. Additional features include HARDWOOD flooring throughout, interior and exterior paint, restored fireplace with new screen, and a temperature controlled exhaust fan in the loft.  Exterior features include front and rear decks that have been refinished and include new balusters. The back deck overlooks a creek, providing a natural setting for outdoor enjoyment. Utilities and added features include HughesNet service and a Ring doorbell system. This property is fully FURNISHED, move-in ready and represents a unique opportunity to own a Forest Service cabin while maintaining it's original character and will be suitable to pass down for generations to come. This is a Forest Service cabin on leased land. Some restrictions may apply. The Forest Service Handbook is available on request and these are cash purchases.

remarks: Welcome to The Rosy Boa, a one-of-a-kind High Desert retreat set across five pristine acres on the Mesa in Flamingo Heights, where sweeping views stretch toward Pipes Canyon and the mesas of Pioneertown and the desert puts on a show from sunrise to sunset. Thoughtfully designed and professionally curated, this two bedroom, two bath home captures the eclectic spirit that made the Hi Desert special in the first place. Warm, relaxed interiors, vintage details and views through nearly every window offer a refreshing departure from the cookie-cutter new construction found throughout the desert today. A cinema setup transforms the living room after dark, while two kitchens and a flexible floor plan create the potential to separate the home into two distinct living spaces. Outside is where this sanctuary truly comes alive. Rows of mature olive trees frame a professionally landscaped backyard filled with intimate gathering spaces and multiple decks, including an unforgettable bathing deck with two clawfoot tubs positioned beneath the open desert sky. At the center of it all is one of the largest custom-welded cowboy pools in the desert, fully filtered and functioning like a traditional pool while retaining the character that makes the property so unique. A completely restored vintage Airstream adds another layer of charm and possibility. Joshua trees dot the surrounding acreage, while the expansive five-acre setting offers privacy, unobstructed views and room to dream even bigger including ample space for a future in-ground pool and additional outdoor amenities. Just minutes from La Copine and within easy reach of Giant Rock, the Integratron, Pioneertown and Joshua Tree National Park, the Rosy Boa offers something increasingly difficult to find in the High Desert: acreage, personality, flexibility and a genuine sense of place. This is the kind of property people come to Joshua Tree hoping to find.

remarks: A warm, inviting Architectural in the Los Feliz Oaks capturing panoramic views stretching from Griffith Park across the city to the ocean. Unassuming and completely private from the street, the residence pairs volumetric interiors with expansive windows and doors, giving nearly every room a front row seat to the view. The architecture frames the city as a cinematic backdrop, inviting you to settle in and watch the view evolve with the shifting light throughout the day. The dramatic living room introduces the home's aesthetic with double-height ceilings, a handsome stone fireplace, and an abundance of natural light. Chic spiral staircase leads to the loft - a quiet retreat for meditation, yoga, or working from home. Throughout the home, interiors flow naturally onto outdoor terraces, each offering a distinct vantage point and extending the living spaces beyond their walls. Both the living room and adjacent oversized den/media room open to the upper dining patio. Nearby, the dining area connects to two view balconies and the kitchen, featuring a breakfast area and Sub-Zero, Gaggenau, and Bosch appliances. Solid mahogany flooring, custom window treatments, and tile by Ann Sacks and Walker Zanger lend warmth and texture throughout, complemented by Lutron smart lighting. A temperature-controlled wine closet with refrigerator and a chic powder bath complete the main level. The primary suite feels like a hotel retreat at home, with cityscape views, a tiled fireplace, and a custom walk-in closet. Its distinctive open concept bath features a deep soaking tub beside a corner window, dual vanities, a tiled shower, and radiant-heated limestone floors. The lower terrace serves as an outdoor extension of the suite - a peaceful place to start the morning or wind down at the end of the day, with ample space to gather with guests. Two well sized guest bedrooms, large hall bath, and a dedicated laundry area complete this floor. Well-loved and cared for by its owners for over 20 years, the home has benefited from thoughtful improvements, including two charging-ready 220V outlets in the garage, automatic shades, upgraded electrical and HVAC systems, tankless water heater, integrated security cameras, and smart home technology woven throughout. In the coveted Los Feliz Oaks, a welcoming community with a deep connection to nature is part of everyday life. Griffith Park's trailheads are minutes from your front door, while the shops and restaurants of Franklin Village and Los Feliz Village, along with Hollywood's studios, are just down the road.

remarks:
Truly a beach lovers delight.  This delightful expanded 2-bedroom 1-bathroom corner beach cottage is light, bright, and cheerful.  The beautiful leaded glass entry door has a retractable screen door added and opens into a spacious living room that features a built-in wall unit /book shelf with built-in electric fireplace, and a heat pump with air-conditioning. The formal dining room has a tile entry, window seat, ceiling fan and double pane sliding glass door that leads to a charming outside sitting area.  The kitchen has granite counters top, built-in electric appliances including a stove top, oven, microwave, and double-door refrigerator.  The kitchen also features a separate breakfast bar with extra storage, amazing pantry, extra-large skylight, and tile flooring.  The main bedroom has mirrored wardrobe sliding closet doors and a double pane sliding door to the patio.  The bathroom has granite counters, a cut down shower door for walk-in convenience, a skylight, and tile flooring.  The second bedroom has sliding glass wardrobe doors.  Enjoy the private front patio with a walk-in storage cabinet and wonderful relaxing ocean breezes.  This special property is close to the laundry room, has drive-up parking, and is walking distance to shopping and many of the main attractions Leisure World has to offer.  Leisure World is located in the City of Seal Beach and offers over 200 clubs, organizations and activities including a nine-hole three-par golf course, swimming pool, jacuzzi, gym, bocci ball, shuffleboard court, billiards rooms, woodworking shop, arts, crafts, and sewing rooms, amphitheater, library, health care center, a variety of cards and exercise groups, and so much more.  Enjoy the restaurants, shopping, sunsets, and gentle ocean breezes the coastal City of Seal Beach has to offer.

.

remarks: Privately gated and newly constructed, this architectural Mid-Century residence spans 4,838 square feet on a half-acre lot, blending warm contemporary design with a seamless connection to its natural surroundings. A generous motor court introduces the home, where oak, glass, and concrete are thoughtfully layered to create interiors that feel both refined and inviting. Walls of floor-to-ceiling glass frame lush greenery and canyon views, filling every space with natural light throughout the day. Additionally, a separate guest house offers exceptional flexibility with its own demi-kitchen, along with a spacious terrace overlooking the backyard.Designed for effortless indoor-outdoor living, the main level unfolds through a formal living room, dining area, and chef's caliber kitchen centered around an expansive breakfast bar island and appointed with top-tier appliances. The family room provides a more intimate gathering space, complete with custom built-in library shelving and direct access to the gardens beyond. Each space opens directly to the outdoor entertaining areas, where a resort-style pool, outdoor kitchen, dining terrace, elevated lounge, and recreation deck overlook a sprawling flat lawn. Architectural pergolas and canopies cast ever-changing patterns of light and shadow, becoming an integral part of the home's design language.The primary suite is a true retreat, wrapped in floor-to-ceiling glass and opening to a private balcony overlooking the surrounding landscape. The spa-inspired bath features dual vanities, a freestanding soaking tub, an oversized rainfall shower, and bespoke cabinetry, complemented by an expansive custom walk-in closet. Each secondary bedroom is finished to the same exacting standard, offering sleek built-in cabinetry, floor-to-ceiling windows, skylights that invite the outdoors in, and beautifully appointed ensuite baths that echo the same private luxury.Just minutes from the heart of Beverly Hills, the residence enjoys a coveted location within the Roscomare Road Elementary School district, offering an exceptional balance of privacy, convenience, and access to one of Los Angeles' most desirable neighborhoods.

Welcome to 38 Deer Creek Road, a spacious 3-bedroom, 3-bathroom home located in the beautiful and highly desirable Phillips Ranch community. From the inviting brick walkway and well-maintained front landscaping to the home’s distinctive multilevel design, this property offers wonderful character, generous living spaces, and thoughtful updates throughout.

Step inside to an expansive formal living room featuring soaring vaulted ceilings, exposed wood beam, abundant natural light, and an attractive bay-style window overlooking the front yard. The adjoining formal dining area provides plenty of space for hosting family gatherings and special occasions. Nearby, the generously sized kitchen offers ample cabinetry and counter space, stainless-steel appliances, a decorative tile backsplash, and a large window above the sink.

The lower level provides a second living space that is ideal for relaxing or entertaining. This comfortable family room features a beautifully remodeled fireplace with a modern tile surround, an adjacent wet bar, direct access to the two-car garage, and sliding glass doors that open to the backyard. A bathroom and separate laundry area are also conveniently located on this level.

Upstairs, you will find two additional bedrooms and a full bathroom. The spacious primary suite stands out with its unique split-level layout, creating a separate area that can be used as a home office, sitting room, reading retreat, exercise space, or private lounge. The suite also includes a walk-in closet with built-in organization and a recently updated primary bathroom featuring a double-sink vanity and a beautifully tiled walk-in shower.
The home has been freshly painted inside and out and includes updated flooring throughout the main living areas. Outside, the spacious backyard offers plenty of room to relax, entertain, garden, or create your own outdoor retreat. Features include a large wooden deck, a covered patio with lighting, mature trees, and a detached storage building with electricity. Offering flexible living spaces, attractive upgrades, and plenty of opportunity to add your own personal style, this Phillips Ranch home is ready to welcome its next owner.

Welcome to an exceptional White Fence Farms horse property that features a 2 bedroom, 2 bathroom guest house. Pride of ownership is evident inside and out. Situated on nearly 3 usable acres in desirable West Palmdale, this beautifully maintained property offers an impressive combination of comfortable living, multi-generational possibilities, resort-style amenities and extensive equestrian facilities.
The main residence features a bright, inviting floor plan with an updated kitchen that opens to the family room, creating an ideal space for everyday living and entertaining. The spacious primary suite includes two walk-in closets, while newer HVAC, Anderson windows and doors, and thoughtful updates throughout add to the home's comfort and appeal.
 A standout feature is the permitted attached guest/mother-in-law suite with its own private entrance. This exceptionally spacious living area includes 2 large bedroom, full bathroom, complete kitchen, living room and its own laundry area--perfect for extended family, guests or flexible multi-generational living while still providing privacy and independence.
Step outside to your own private retreat with a sparkling pool and spa, outdoor fire pit, mature trees and beautiful mountain views. Additional features includer, two water heaters, updated gate motors.

remarks: Located in the sought-after Little Tuscany neighborhood, this Casa de Oro residence is surrounded by Palm Springs' celebrated architectural and Hollywood history. Just five blocks from the iconic Kaufmann House widely regarded as the city's most photographed home and moments from the Elvis Presley Honeymoon Hideaway, Old Las Palmas, the Uptown Design District, restaurants, boutiques, and downtown Palm Springs, you'll enjoy one of the city's most walkable and bike-friendly neighborhoods, framed by quiet streets, spectacular mountain views, and mid-century architecture. Best of all, you own the land (fee simple), making this an exceptional value. First time on the market in 14 years, this 2-bedroom, 2-bath residence features a renovated primary bathroom, a versatile guest bedroom with a built-in Murphy bed that easily converts into a home office, in-unit laundry, a private south-facing patio for outdoor living, and an attached one-car garage. Lovingly maintained, the home offers the perfect opportunity to add your own cosmetic touches and create your ideal Palm Springs retreat. The property may also be available turnkey furnished. Casa de Oro is an intimate community of just 96 homes surrounded by lush, mature landscaping and resort-style amenities, including two pools, two spas, a sauna, clubhouse, tennis courts, and a pickleball court. Whether you're looking for a full-time residence, seasonal getaway, or investment property, this is a rare opportunity to own on fee land in one of Palm Springs' most desirable neighborhoods.

remarks: Bright, breezy and beautifully positioned, this corner residence at The Heights at Bay Park captures the ease of San Diego coastal living. Natural light pours in from multiple exposures, while the corner balcony creates an inviting outdoor retreat for morning coffee, evening unwinding and enjoying the fresh coastal air. The thoughtfully positioned kitchen sits just off the main living space with its own window, bringing in sunlight and coastal breezes while keeping the home feeling open, comfortable and connected. Light finishes and an easy-flowing layout add to the relaxed, airy feel from the moment you walk in.  Set in the heart of San Diego, this Bay Park location puts you close to everything people love about the city. Downtown San Diego, Mission Bay, the beaches, dining, shopping and neighborhood favorites are all just minutes away—and you can reach the bay and coast without ever getting on the freeway. Spend the morning by the water, meet friends downtown, enjoy an afternoon along the bay, then come home to your own bright corner retreat.  It is a rare combination of central location, coastal access and easy everyday living, with the freedom to enjoy more of San Diego and spend less time getting there. Perfect for anyone looking for a low-maintenance lifestyle without giving up light, outdoor space or location. Simple living. Elevated living. Coastal living. A fresh, light-filled corner home designed for the way San Diego is meant to be lived.

remarks: Set on a prominent corner lot, this distinctive single-story home pairs an updated interior with a garden setting. Mature cypress trees, dramatic agaves, succulents, and flowering plants frame the front elevation, while a wide driveway leads to the attached two-car garage. A covered porch introduces striking red double entry doors. Inside, engineered hardwood flooring extends from the foyer into the main living areas, complemented by crown molding and recessed lighting. The living room centers around a fireplace with a crisp white mantel and built-in cabinetry. A broad glass door opens directly to the backyard. Divided-glass architectural detailing provides a stylish transition into the kitchen. Designed with personality, the kitchen features turquoise cabinetry, expansive white countertops, a white subway tile backsplash, an apron-front sink, and a dark bridge-style faucet. A center island pairs a rich wood base with an oversized countertop and casual seating, while a second breakfast bar adds serving space. Bosch appliances include the refrigerator, dishwasher, and wall oven, joined by a gas cooktop and stainless steel vent hood. Hand blown pendant lighting, abundant storage, a built-in workstation, and windows wrapping two sides of the room complete this bright, functional space. Built-in hallway cabinetry with a dark stone counter leads to the bedroom wing. The primary suite offers crown molding, recessed lighting, two closets, a large garden-view window, and direct access to a remodeled bathroom. Finishes include a wood vanity, dark stone countertop, mosaic accents, and an oversized glass-enclosed shower with dual showerheads, a built-in niche, corner bench, and extensive stone tilework. Two additional bedrooms enjoy natural light and share a second bathroom with a wood vanity, dark stone counter, and a tub and shower surrounded by coordinating tile. The backyard defines the property. More botanical garden than conventional yard, it unfolds through meandering pathways bordered by mature palms, flowering plants, sculptural succulents, established trees, and layered garden beds. Multiple patios and intimate seating areas create inviting places to dine, entertain, garden, or enjoy the peaceful surroundings. The main patio connects easily with the living room and kitchen, reinforcing the home’s natural indoor-outdoor flow. Fully paid-off solar panels complete the property, offering the potential for long-term savings on monthly electricity costs.

remarks: Welcome to this thoughtfully expanded exquisitely designed modern residence offering approximately 2,900 square feet of refined luxury. Multiple 6" architectural bump-outs add dimension and eye-catching style throughout. Minutes from Whole Foods, Trader Joe's, Target and just 5 minutes to Downtown Culver City's nightlife, Apple and Amazon Studios. Nearby favorites include Erewhon, Salt & Straw, The Culver Steps, Jon & Vinny's and the acclaimed West Adams food scene (Cento Pasta, Alta, Chulita). Enjoy the 13-mile Park-to-Playa trail, Kenneth Hahn State Park and easy access to Metro lines and LAX.

remarks:
Downsizing doesn’t have to mean downgrading. Located in Valencia’s desirable West Creek community, this approximately 2,806-square-foot home offers one of its most sought-after features: a spacious downstairs primary suite, allowing you to enjoy your bedroom, bath, kitchen and main living spaces all on one level without giving up the extra space you still want. Three additional bedrooms and a versatile loft upstairs provide plenty of room for guests, family, a home office, hobbies or whatever comes next.

From the paver driveway and mature landscaping to the white roses lining the front walkway, classic siding and shutters create a warm and charming first impression. Inside, warm engineered wood flooring, abundant natural light and an open main level create comfortable spaces that flow easily from one to the next.

At the heart of the home is a generously sized kitchen designed for everyday living and entertaining, featuring granite countertops, a large center island with seating, double ovens, stainless-steel appliances, built-in refrigerator, abundant cabinetry and a convenient butler’s pantry. The kitchen opens to the casual dining area and inviting family room, where a fireplace and direct backyard access create an easy indoor-outdoor connection. A separate formal dining room provides additional space for entertaining.

The downstairs primary suite offers the convenience and privacy of first-floor living, while the upstairs bedrooms and loft keep additional living space comfortably separated.

Outside, the private backyard offers a peaceful place to dine, relax and entertain without the upkeep of an oversized property. Mature landscaping creates an established, inviting setting, while the paver-finished side yard is another thoughtful upgrade. Another important benefit: PAID SOLAR, providing energy efficiency without the burden of a solar lease or monthly solar payment.

Living in West Creek means enjoying more than just the home. Community amenities include a resort-style pool and spa, clubhouse, parks, paseos, and walking and biking trails, with Valencia shopping, dining, schools and commuter routes nearby.

Primary living downstairs. Plenty of space upstairs. Less to maintain outside. This is a home that lets you simplify without sacrificing the space you’ve worked hard to enjoy.

remarks: Welcome to this beautifully appointed new construction townhome nestled in The Heights at Ponte Vista, a thoughtfully designed gated community near the Palos Verdes Peninsula. The kitchen island provides generous seating for entertaining, storage, and style. The third floor showcases two secondary bedrooms and a soaring primary suite with a walk-in closet. An upstairs laundry closet adds everyday convenience with a washer and electric dryer already included. This home is extensively upgraded and ready to enjoy with all the appliances in place, window blinds throughout the homes, and owned solar panels. The attached 2-car garage is EV pre-plumbed for future charging needs. The resort-style common area amenities include a pool, spa, fire pit, rec center, fitness center, and outdoor BBQ areas with covered dining. Conveniently located near shopping, dining, recreations, and the coast.

remarks:
Some properties change the way you live. At 7227 Spigno Place mornings begin with light over the Agua Dulce hills and horses stirring in the barn. Coffee outside before the day gets going. Set on approximately 5.15 gated acres this established ranch offers space to roam and room to gather with what you love close to home.

The single story residence offers approximately 3168 square feet with five bedrooms and three bathrooms. Outside the pool and waterfall set the scene for long afternoons and summer dinners beneath the open sky.

A separate fully equipped farm kitchen offers approximately 750 square feet with a huge island and a walk in farm style pantry. There is room for everyone to lend a hand. Prepare a holiday meal or put up fruit from the orchard. Cook for a full table after a day on the ranch. A space made for generous meals and good company.

For the horses an approximately 6000 square foot barn with eight heated stalls is complemented by approximately 9500 square feet of mare stall facilities. A round pen and pipe fencing surround flat usable ground. A greenhouse with four coolers supports growing pursuits. The orchard includes almonds and peaches alongside nectarines and plums with figs and pomegranates adding to the harvest.

The infrastructure is already in place. Seller owned solar with no lease or payment to assume. A private well reported to produce 8 to 10 gallons per minute. Two water storage tanks totaling approximately 18000 gallons along with two 500 gallon propane tanks and septic. Furnishings and farm tools and equipment convey per the seller’s itemized inventory.

For those dreaming of bringing generations together the adjoining approximately five acre parcel offers an opportunity to explore a family compound. It has its own APN and address and entrance and is recognized separately by the HOA. Imagine a future home for adult children or parents nearby with space and privacy for each household. Shared ranch life and a place for everyone around the table.

Southwind is a community of ten custom homes on approximately five acre lots with access to Sierra Highway and the 14 Freeway and Santa Clarita. Vasquez Rocks is nearby.

A place to keep your horses and grow something of your own and build traditions that bring everyone home.

The listing price includes the improved approximately 5.15 acre ranch parcel. The adjoining approximately five acre parcel is available for separate purchase.

remarks: Transport yourself to a relaxing escape like no other in the gorgeous rolling hills of the El Pomar district outside of Paso Robles, in this magical estate-style property. Covering a fully-usable 83 acres, the gently-sloping grounds abound with over 200 majestic oak trees, a sizeable seasonal lake plus a pond, as well as ample space for future plantings.  At the top of the property are multiple ranch homes totaling over ~11,000 square feet of measured space - a plantation-style large main residence, 3-bed/1-bath 2nd residence, plus small 1-bedroom 3rd residence.  There are ~17,500 measured square feet in 2 warehouses, including a towering 30-plus-foot-high larger warehouse.  A newer large garage building features ~1,640 square feet to house up to 8 cars, plus 2nd-story storage across the entire building accessed by a commercial-size elevator.  These many residences, structures and spaces offer endless possibilities for full-time occupants, ranch getaway buyers, hobbyists and agricultural pursuits.  Fully decompress as you soak in the breathless panoramic views of the beautiful surrounding countryside from the view decks, and in a easily accessible location just ~10 miles equidistant from Paso Robles, Templeton and Atascadero.  Make an appointment to tour this one-of-a-kind recreational and/or agricultural property, and explore its many possibilities.

remarks: A Modern Masterpiece. Along a tranquil ridgeline in Hope Ranch, the land opens in three directions - the Santa Ynez Mountains to the north, the Pacific Ocean to the south, and natural Hope Ranch setting below. One roofline runs the length of the site. Below it, glass - the landscape held on every side. Designed by DesignARC and completed in 2023, the residence reinterprets midcentury modern principles in glass, stone, and steel - clean geometry, measured proportion, every line held to the same discipline. A U-shaped plan wraps a central courtyard and lap pool. Broad overhangs and clerestory glazing carry light deep into the interior.Corners disappear where the glass meets. In the great room, thirty feet of pocketing doors slide fully away, and the distinction between inside and out stops holding.Inside, the material palette is simple and consistent. Travertine runs from the courtyard walls to a full-height fireplace in the great room and again in the primary suite, laid in long horizontal courses that echo the roofline. White oak floors throughout. Venetian plaster and inset reveals set the rhythm. Clerestory windows carry a band of light above the room and hold the palm canopy in view.A gallery corridor runs the length of the plan, glass to the courtyard on one side, stone on the other, art along its length, ending in a wall of warm wood. It links the public rooms to the private wing and does the work of a gallery on the way. The kitchen opens to the great room beneath the same clerestory band. Elsewhere the house turns quieter and darker -- a den, a powder room -- proof that restraint isn't the only register available to it.Outside, a timber pergola on steel posts extends the roofline into a covered terrace, where a travertine fire table faces the tree line.The landscape, by Nicole Greer of CJM::LA, answers the architecture rather than decorating it -- sculptural olives, sandstone boulders, native grasses, structure without ornament. In the courtyard, a mature Canary Island date palm stands free in the gravel. The lap pool and spa sit level with the terrace, side by side.Built by Leonard Unander Associates and styled by KB Kim of Langoworks - 1045 Via Tranquila is a Santa Barbara house in the older sense of the term: sited first, built second, and quiet throughout.Design Awards & HonorsFeatured on the cover of Luxe Interiors + Design (July 2025 edition)Honored for architectural design excellence by the American Institute of Architects (2024)Recognized for visionary landscaping design by the American Society of Landscape Architects (2025)

remarks: Welcome to this charming 3-bedroom home in desirable Four Seasons 55+ community of Murrieta. Designed with comfort & functionality, this home features a spacious floor plan & inviting great room. You’ll appreciate the abundance of natural light. LVT flooring extends through most of the home, creating a clean, contemporary look & easy maintenance. Newer fixtures & appliances throughout the home provide modern touches. The primary bedroom suite offers plenty of room to relax & unwind. It features two closets, along with a well-appointed bathroom that includes dual sinks, a dedicated vanity area, a large soaking tub & a separate shower with new shower doors. At the front of the home, two additional bedrooms provide flexibility for guests, an office or additional living space. A convenient bathroom & hallway linen cabinet are located nearby for easy access & ample storage. A private guest bedroom offers pleasant views of the front yard, features a large closet, plantation shutters & newer carpeting. The additional bedroom features double-door entry, built-in oak cabinetry & shelving providing space to adapt to your needs. The modern kitchen with its large center island provides generous workspace. Abundant pantry & cabinet storage make it easy to keep everything organized, while stainless-steel appliances add a sleek, modern touch. Newer appliances complement the kitchen’s updated appeal. The kitchen opens to the great room creating an ideal setting for both everyday living, dining & entertainment. Outside, the stamped concrete patio creates an attractive, low-maintenance space for outdoor dining or morning. An Aluma-Wood-style patio cover provides shade & shelter for year-round use, plus no neighbors directly behind you. The Lodge is a wonderful place to meet neighbors, participate in clubs & activities or enjoy one of the community’s special events. Residents can choose from a variety of recreational & social amenities, including a swimming pool, spa, sauna, BBQ area, tennis courts, pickleball courts, putting green, library, card room, fitness center & more. The home’s location adds a layer of convenience, with grocery stores, restaurants, shopping & everyday services close by. The Temecula Promenade, 15 & 215 freeways, Old Town Temecula & Temecula Wine Country are all less than five miles away. Come discover the quiet comfort of this inviting Murrieta home & enjoy all that the Four Seasons lifestyle has to offer.

Welcome to 1741 Tustin Avenue #14D, a beautifully remodeled, single-level end unit tucked quietly in the hidden community of Orleans Townhomes, where privacy and convenience come together in one of Costa Mesa’s most sought-after Eastside pockets. With no neighbors above or below and just one shared wall, this home feels wonderfully removed while being just moments from everything.

Inside, the open living and dining spaces create an easy, inviting setting for entertaining, with thoughtful finishes that feel elevated well beyond the typical condo. Wide-plank LVP flooring, elegant Emtek door hardware, Shade Store window coverings, and custom cabinetry are carried throughout, creating a cohesive and timeless feel. 

The kitchen is both stylish and functional, featuring KitchenAid appliances, natural honed granite countertops, and custom cabinetry. The spacious primary bedroom offers a peaceful retreat with a beautifully finished ensuite bathroom. The secondary bedroom is currently styled as a nursery, but comfortably accommodates a queen-size bed and offers incredible flexibility. Custom California Closets built-ins include a dedicated desk and generous storage, making the space equally suited for a guest room, office, or nursery.

Open the door to your private patio and settle in for a quiet morning coffee or evening glass of wine, with convenient access to the private laundry closet. The end-unit location is also especially close to parking, with a detached one-car garage space, plus one onsite community parking tag for two total parking spaces.

Beyond your front door, the community feels like a retreat with greenbelts, a pool, and clubhouse, yet its location puts you right at the center of the neighborhood. Walk to 17th Street for a casual dinner, coffee, or a quick evening pick-up, with Erewhon and Bear Flag soon adding more favorites to the mix. Weekend mornings can mean strolling over to the farmers market near 16th Street, while the best of both Costa Mesa and Newport Beach is just minutes away.

It’s a rare combination: a thoughtfully remodeled home with high-end finishes, tucked into a peaceful community that feels private and removed, yet close enough to enjoy everything the Costa Mesa/Newport Beach border has to offer. Welcome yourself home to 1741 Tustin Avenue #14D.

remarks:
Welcome to this spacious and inviting 2,200+ sq. ft. home situated on an expansive 0.89-acre lot, offering a rare combination of space, privacy, character, and indoor-outdoor living.

The home features three official bedrooms plus a versatile BONUS ROOM with convenient outdoor access—ideal for a home office, guest space, hobby room, gym, or additional living area. The bright, open interior offers generous living and dining spaces, complemented by beautiful, imported tile flooring and a statement fireplace that adds warmth and character to the heart of the home.

The kitchen offers abundant cabinetry and counter space along with newer appliances, including a refrigerator, dishwasher, and microwave approximately one year old.

Outside is where this property truly shines. The large backyard feels like your own private retreat, complete with an in-ground swimming pool, mature landscaping, patio and lawn areas, and plenty of space for entertaining, relaxing, gardening, or simply enjoying the outdoors.

The established property is also home to an impressive variety of fruit and nut trees and vines, including orange, grapefruit, lemon, fig, almond and pomegranate trees, along with grapevines—bringing a wonderful garden-to-table element to the property.

Additional features include both city water and access to well water, solar panels, an attached garage currently configured with an additional removable storage/utility room, as well as a detached garage/storage structure that provides even more flexibility.

With nearly an acre of land, 2,200+ square feet of interior space, a pool, established trees and landscaping, multiple flexible-use spaces, and room to spread out, this property offers something increasingly difficult to find: space, privacy and versatility without sacrificing the comforts of home.

Whether you're gathering around the fireplace, spending summer afternoons by the pool, picking fruit from your own trees, or simply enjoying the peaceful surroundings, this is a property designed to be lived in and enjoyed.

remarks: The Franklin Otis Booth Jr Hacienda. Built in 1949 by and for Franklin Otis Booth Jr., philanthropist and great-grandson of Gen. Harrison Gray Otis, founder of the Los Angeles Times, this single-story hacienda with detached casita and pool is situated in Pasadena's leafy Oak Knoll neighborhood, a stone's throw from the Robert R. Blacker House and the Langham Hotel & Spa. Completely gated and perfectly sited, the property offers usable front and rear grounds, a large rear lawn, specimen trees, water features, and exceptional privacy. The home was completely renovated and restored in 2015, incorporating modern design and conveniences while preserving and accentuating its defining architectural features. Restored poplar wood paneling, steel and leaded-glass windows, and antique light fixtures complement thoughtful updates throughout. More recently, the Booth Hacienda has been subtly refined through the re-landscaping of the gardens to enhance privacy and form, the brightening of interior spaces with updated design elements, and the reconfiguration of select rooms for greater livability.  A rare opportunity to own a home among some of the most significant architectural residences in Pasadena, the Booth Hacienda is ideal for those seeking to simplify their lives while maintaining privacy, security, and the ability to entertain family and friends, whether intimately or on a grand scale. Features: *3BR/4BA main house. *330 sf, 1BR/1BA Casita w/AC, not included in overall SF. *Entry controlled drive & pedestrian gates. *Two-car attached garage w/motor court for five. *Front, rear and pool water features. *Seismically upgraded. *72-bottle Sub-Zero wine fridge, Sub-Zero fridges/freezer, Wolf 8-burner range, Bosch dishwasher. *Lutron/Savant Pro. *New HVAC 2024. *New roof 2025.

MAIN LAKE WATERFRONT on Hidden Duck Cove! This beautifully updated single-story home offers the perfect combination of comfort, style, and year-round recreation. Step inside to a bright, open floor plan featuring soaring vaulted ceilings and a seamless flow between the living room, dining area, and remodeled kitchen, creating the perfect space for everyday living and entertaining.

The newer remodeled kitchen showcases granite countertops, updated cabinetry, recessed lighting, and tile flooring. The spacious primary suite features an updated bathroom with a beautifully remodeled shower. Tax records reflect 2 bedrooms; however, the home includes a permitted 3rd bedroom plus an additional 10' x 23' bonus room on the waterfront level that has been used as a 4th bedroom and includes its own heating and air conditioning, providing exceptional flexibility for guests, a home office, game room, or hobby space.

Step outside onto the deck just off the living room and enjoy peaceful lake views while relaxing with your morning coffee or evening sunsets. Located just minutes from the ski area, you'll have quick access to all your favorite water activities. The oversized front yard offers abundant off-street parking for boats, trailers, RVs, golf carts, and all your recreational toys.

With its modern upgrades, flexible floor plan, durable finishes, abundant parking, and energy-efficient features, this home truly stands out and is completely move-in ready. Combined with its desirable waterfront setting, this is an exceptional opportunity to enjoy lake living at its finest.

Located within the gated community of Canyon Lake, residents enjoy a low 1.1% tax base with no Mello-Roos and resort-style amenities including a private 384-acre waterski and fishing lake, 16 parks (most with beaches and playgrounds), an 18-hole golf course, tennis and pickleball courts, baseball fields, basketball courts, an equestrian center, community pool, dog park, golf cart-friendly streets, a slalom course, ski jump, waterfront restaurants, year-round community events, and so much more.

Whether you're searching for a full-time waterfront residence or the perfect weekend getaway, this exceptional home is a rare opportunity to experience the best of Canyon Lake living.

remarks: Welcome to effortless Sierra foothills living with some of the most breathtaking views in the region. This beautifully updated single-level condo offers 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, and 1,008 square feet of thoughtfully designed living space — all with sweeping, unobstructed views of New Melones Lake and the stunning Sierra foothills. The updated kitchen features gorgeous stone countertops and flows seamlessly into the dining area and on into the light-filled living room — creating an ideal open layout for everyday living and entertaining alike. Step through the living room onto your private back deck and take in the kind of views that simply never get old. Located just minutes from the charming downtown Sonora, you'll have easy access to boutique shopping, dining, and all the amenities the Gold Country has to offer — while coming home to your own private piece of paradise overlooking New Melones Lake. If you've been searching for a low-maintenance retreat with views that take your breath away, this is it.

remarks:
Own a piece of Menifee history. Originally built in the 1960s, this one-of-a-kind home offers a rare opportunity to step back in time with beautifully preserved vintage interiors that celebrate the charm and character of a bygone era. From its classic 1960s décor and original finishes to its nostalgic ambiance, this home is a true time capsule—perfect for buyers who appreciate mid-century design, authenticity, and timeless craftsmanship. Homes like this rarely come to market, making it a unique piece of Menifee’s heritage.  An estate of this scale, privacy, and potential rarely become available in the highly sought-after Menifee/Murrieta corridor. Spanning more than 32 usable acres with breathtaking panoramic views of the valley and surrounding mountains, this original-owner property offers an exceptional opportunity to create a premier rural retreat while remaining just minutes from city conveniences. The expansive 4,900+ square-foot custom residence features 5 bedrooms, a bonus room, 4.5 bathrooms and has been thoughtfully maintained throughout. Rich Desert Rose stone flooring and select stone accent walls provide timeless character, while wood laminate flooring enhances the spacious primary suite. Offering solid construction and an ideal layout, the home presents an outstanding opportunity for cosmetic updates to reflect your personal style. A truly unique feature of the property is the underground fallout shelter, which maintains an approximate year-round temperature of 62 degrees and includes a dedicated well with booster pump. Plumbing was also installed for a potential future bathroom (buyer to verify). The shelter is not included in the home's stated square footage and is not taxable, per seller.
Designed to embrace its spectacular setting, the home features multiple patios and balconies that capture sweeping mountain and valley views. A connected 1-bedroom, 1-bath guest suite offers flexibility for multigenerational living, private guest accommodations, or potential separation for independent use. Completing the estate is an approximately 2,800-square-foot attached garage, providing exceptional space for multiple vehicles, recreational equipment, workshop needs, collections, or additional storage. With expansive usable acreage, remarkable privacy, and endless possibilities for customization or future expansion, this one-of-a-kind property awaits you. Buyer to verify square foot, lot size, zoning, property use and property condition.

remarks: Set at the oceanfront edge of Hope Ranch, the residence known as Vera Villa holds one of the more uninterrupted coastal frontages in the area -- roughly 170 feet of shoreline across 2.5 acres, where the Pacific defines the property from first light through dusk. Whales pass offshore and dolphins move through the surf, and the water carries its shifting moods into the home throughout the day. A gated entry opens to grounds planted with an orchard of varied fruit, the approach unfolding past the trees toward the south-facing villa beyond. The residence comprises just over 4,700 square feet under roof, its orientation composed to draw the coastline inward and to live as much with the ocean as beside it.Once a gathering place where an earlier generation of Hollywood marked the close of the day, the home now holds a rare opening for its next chapter.The grounds are arranged for a life lived outdoors as much as in -- room for horses, a tennis court, a pool pavilion, or another vision entirely, each held within the same expansive frontage and southern exposure. Positioned along one of Hope Ranch's few true oceanfront parcels, Vera Villa is a rare opportunity to reimagine an estate at the edge of the continent.

remarks: *A Private Escape * City Close *  Above the road, past tiered and terraced landscaping, this 3-bedroom, 2-bath, 1,684 sq ft mid-century modern home delivers what's hard to find, real privacy, real views, and real room to live outdoors.  The living room opens straight to the backyard through a full glass wall, while French doors lead to a front view deck overlooking the hills, a quiet, elevated perch above the everyday. Glass walls, and clerestory windows fill the home with natural light, blurring the line further between indoors and out. A block fireplace with a screened firebox anchors the living room and looks straight through to the open kitchen, which offers generous storage, granite counters, a tiled backsplash with a charming motif over the stove, and durable tile flooring throughout. Outside is where this home really shines: in back,  a patio deck built for gathering, an outdoor fireplace, and a separate deck shed for storage or projects and in the front  a second pergola-covered deck framed by mature palms, cactus, and bougainvillea.  A nostalgic breeze-block screen fence and newer white perimeter fencing secure this home while drought-tolerant landscaping — agave, kalanchoe, cactus, and citrus trees — keeps upkeep simple. Recent updates include newer windows, a renovated kitchen and bath, hardwood floors, and A/C and leased solar. The 14,400 sq ft lot fits up to 10 vehicles.  The 2-car garage has a rare separate closed storage area for hobbies, guests, or gear.  Centrally located near freeway access and several interchanges, with convenient access to multiple San Diego-area military installations.

remarks: Welcome to this exceptional five-bedroom, three-bathroom residence tucked away on a peaceful cul-de-sac in one of Cloverdale's most sought-after neighborhoods. Ideally located just moments from Vintage Meadows Park, this home combines timeless craftsmanship, thoughtful design, and resort-style living. The spacious floor plan features a main-level bedroom and full bathroom ideal for guests, an office, or multigenerational living alongside unique architectural accents like an interior hallway feature wall with a vintage window sash. Engineered hickory flooring spans the main level, while solid hickory continues upstairs. At the heart of the home is a remodeled kitchen equipped with a pool-side view window, open shelving, a new built-in dishwasher, and an expanded island with stone composite and walnut countertops, custom heavy-duty drawers, and a farmhouse apron sink with a countertop pressure-switched disposal. Highlights include an extendable pot filler, a custom knotty alder swing door, and reclaimed wood accent walls from San Francisco's historic Ferry Building, complemented by elegant lighting like a parlor chandelier and dimmers throughout. Step outside to a private retreat enclosed by a tall redwood privacy fence with a secure one-way gate latch. The grounds feature a winding stone path, mature citrus trees (three lemon, one orange), raised planter boxes, automated irrigation, and pet-friendly artificial turf beneath a cooling shade sail. Enjoy year-round entertaining under the gazebo-covered patio or relax by the sparkling, fully fenced pool and spa upgraded with a 399,000 BTU Jandy heater, Pentair HydroBoost pump, new cartridge filtration, replaced actuators, and an outdoor shower. Additional highlights include a commercial-grade water heater, whole-house water softener with carbon filtration, MERV 13 air filtration, energy-efficient screens, custom bamboo shades, a generator-ready panel with dual propane tanks, an organized garage with built-in cabinetry, and a powered garden shed all just minutes from downtown Cloverdale, Geyserville, and Healdsburg.

remarks: An oasis in the heart of town without noise, this turnkey 3-bed/3-bath home leaves no detail overlooked, from spectacular curb appeal to smart home features throughout. The home has 2,566 sq ft of living space, 120 sq ft bonus structure (2,686 sq ft total) & a 445 sq ft garage. A whole house vacuum system adds convenience. Abundant storage keeps everything organized, while a shed in the side yard provides space for gardening equipment. This home is close to restaurants, harbor, parks, grocers, & more, all without getting on the freeway.

remarks: KLAMATH RIVERFRONT RANCH WITH STUNNING MOUNTAIN AND RIVER VIEWS. Experience the beauty of Northern California on this exceptional 12.74-acre ranch property in Hornbrook, California. Set atop a private hilltop overlooking the Klamath River, the property offers panoramic mountain views, riverfront pasture, and the peace and privacy of true country living. The 1,600-square-foot home features two bedrooms, three bathrooms, open-concept living spaces, beautiful myrtle wood floors, and a wraparound deck offering remarkable views from multiple vantage points. Large glass slider doors open to the deck and showcase the surrounding mountain, bridge, and river views. The property is served by a private well, providing water for the home. The well-appointed kitchen features custom maple cabinetry, Brazilian quartz countertops, and stainless-steel appliances, with a dedicated living and dining area creating a natural space for meals and entertaining. Energy-efficient windows enhance the home's comfort, while a wood-burning stove adds warmth and character. A large utility and storage room with dedicated laundry space provides valuable everyday functionality. An oversized 812-square-foot garage, complete with a toilet and shower, offers exceptional flexibility as a multiuse bonus space. The substantial garage provides ample room for vehicles, equipment, workshop use, recreational gear, and storage. Included in the sale is a like-new Branson 3725H red tractor with approximately 200 hours of use and attachments, providing added convenience for property maintenance and ranch operations. The 12.74 acres features usable riverfront pastureland with a working irrigation pump, Klamath River frontage, livestock access to the river, and multiple gated entry points providing convenient access to both the riverfront and pasture areas. Whether you are seeking a full-time residence, recreational retreat, or working ranch, this property offers a rare combination of acreage, river frontage, and natural beauty. Conveniently located approximately three miles from Interstate 5, offering easy access to Yreka, Mount Shasta, Ashland, Medford, and Rogue Valley International Medford Airport. The Klamath River is known for fishing, while nearby Mount Shasta and Ashland offer premier hiking, skiing, and year-round outdoor recreation. This is a rare opportunity to own riverfront acreage, usable pastureland with a working irrigation pump, and breathtaking mountain and river views along with distinctive interior finishes, a substantial multiuse garage, and exceptional outdoor living space in one remarkable Northern California setting.
