remarks: A Single-Story Modern Adobe Sanctuary atop a Private Knoll Rarely does a property of such distinction and architectural soul become available in Walnut Creek. A sanctuary perched atop its own private knoll on nearly 3/4ths of an acre, this one-of-a-kind, single-story adobe estate offers views in almost every direction, including Mt. Diablo, Las Trampas, and Walnut Creek city lights. Originally constructed with custom adobe bricks pressed directly on-site, the main home underwent a comprehensive renovation (2019–2020), seamlessly blending historic craftsmanship with modern luxury and a pleasing aesthetic lift.  Inside, cool polished concrete floors lead you through architecturally impressive living spaces featuring four bedrooms and two full baths. Step outside into a resort-style paradise with distinct wine country aesthetic meets adobe vibes - right down to the 200+ year old olive tree and beautiful towering oaks that surround the property. The newly renovated swimming pool equipped with an automatic pool cover, a shaded southern dining pavilion, an outdoor kitchen, and two outdoor fire experiences- one to frame Mount Diablo and an oversized fire pit showcasing sunsets over the Las Trampas hills.  Attached via breezeway, an upscale 1 bed/1 bath guest suite—ideal for an executive office, guests, or a private retreat. Beyond the pool, a private rear gate provides direct, exclusive access to Mount Diablo’s open space and miles of scenic hiking trails.   Living here means you are always just moments to downtown. Walnut Creek offers no limit to the luxury lifestyle, high-end gyms and niche fitness studios, a vast array of dining options, the beautiful Broadway Plaza with extensive shopping, as well as The Lesher Center for theater & arts.   This special location offers easy access to freeways yet the feeling of being miles away from it all. Truly a singular residence with no equal in Walnut Creek or perhaps, the greater East Bay.  Property Highlights: * Architectural Heritage: Renovated single-story adobe construction with bricks crafted on-site; contemporary metal roof and sleek polished concrete floors throughout * Extensive Renovation: Comprehensively updated in 2019–2020 with high-end designer finishes * Unmatched Setting: Perched atop a private knoll offering breathtaking views  * Oasis Backyard: Brand-new pool with automatic cover, outdoor kitchen, shaded southwestern dining area, terraced gardens, as well as east and west fire pits for sunrise & sunset Views:  Downtown

This property qualifies for a $20,000 grant through City National Bank! The grant can be applied toward the down payment or closing costs. For more details, contact Josh Kazee (NMLS #447797) at City National Bank. Call or text: 661-733-3202 
Unique rural retreat on approximately 1.1 acres in East Palmdale offering a rare blend of comfortable living and workspace. This property is designed for those seeking space, functionality, and self-sufficient living.

The main home features beautiful high-beam wood ceilings, a cozy wood-burning stove, and a spacious primary suite with a large walk-in closet. One bathroom has a pedestal sink and walk-in shower, while the other has a jetted soaking tub with tile countertops and flooring.

The converted garage expands the property’s versatility, offering two private offices and an upstairs studio apartment with a bedroom, bathroom with a walk-in shower, and a kitchenette. Additional living areas include two more bedrooms and a loft space, offering flexibility for guests, hobbies, or extended living.

Step outside and experience the property’s true lifestyle appeal featuring three custom koi ponds (approximately $30,000 value) fully stocked with fish, two chicken coops, a greenhouse, and a large storage shed. The land is cross-fenced and ideal for gardening, animals, or outdoor recreation.

For hobbyists or mechanics, the property includes a 40' x 8' steel container shop with an attached 12' x 40' permitted workspace with electricity, plus a car lift that stays with the property.

Energy efficiency and reliability are key highlights with one fully paid-off solar system (approx. $30,000 value), an additional Tesla solar lease with approximately 10 years remaining ($339.91/month), and a Generac backup generator for peace of mind.

Additional features include city water service, insulated garage doors, all appliances included, and plenty of space for RVs, equipment, or outdoor projects.

This one-of-a-kind property offers space, flexibility, and a unique lifestyle opportunity rarely found in the Antelope Valley.

What matters most when buying a home—Location? Views? Lifestyle? Quality? What if one home could bring them all together?

Welcome to this extensively remodeled Walnut residence offering 4 bedrooms, 2.5 bathrooms, approximately 2,265 sq. ft. of living space on an expansive 8,621 sq. ft. lot.

QUALITY: A warm modern interior showcases carefully selected finishes throughout, including natural Taj Mahal quartzite countertops, slim oak cabinetry, premium appliances, wood-look luxury vinyl flooring, double-pane windows, and beautifully coordinated details. The designer kitchen, remodeled bathrooms, two separate living spaces with electric fireplaces, and dry bar with wine cooler create a home designed for both everyday living and entertaining.

VIEWS & LIFESTYLE: Step outside to a newly replastered private pool and spa with new pumps, complemented by a composite deck and beautiful hillside, mountain, and sunset views—an inviting setting for relaxing, gathering with family and friends, and enjoying Southern California living.

MORE TO VALUE: A metal tile roof on four sides, a newer garage door, an epoxy-coated 2-car garage floor, a spacious primary suite with walk-in closet, and thoughtful improvements throughout add function and appeal beyond the home's beautiful finishes.

LOCATION: This particular home is ideally positioned in southern Walnut near Diamond Bar and Rowland Heights, offering convenient access to popular Asian markets, restaurants, shopping, parks, schools, and major transportation routes. Its location combines the residential setting of Walnut with convenient access to the amenities and lifestyle of the surrounding communities.

Location. Views. Lifestyle. Quality. Why choose just one when this home brings all four together?

The two-residence configuration provides flexibility for personal use, furnished rentals or occupying one while renting the other, subject to applicable regulations and the final TIC Agreement. Designated parking and outdoor areas complement access from Bishops Lane.  The proposed Rear Interest includes approximately 2,600 SF of designated exclusive-use land area, including the building's footprint and assigned rear areas. The property remains one legal parcel/APN containing this duplex and a separate detached front residence. The buyer would acquire an undivided ownership interest in the overall property, with contractual exclusive-use rights to the duplex and its assigned areas established by the final TIC Agreement. This is not a separately subdivided parcel or condominium.  Enjoy a Village setting near La Jolla's beaches, restaurants, shopping and galleries.

remarks:
Some homes give you a place to live. This one gives you room to create a life around it. And at around $600,000, it offers an opportunity that is increasingly hard to find: a private, gated property surrounded by impressive custom homes, many valued well into the $1 million range.

Welcome to 40325 Pageant Place, where open land, mature fruit trees, elevated views, and a unique multi-level design create a setting that feels like your own retreat.

Pull through the gate and up the long driveway, and the pace immediately begins to change. There is space between you and the street, peach, orange, and tangerine trees growing on the property, and open land out front. It is the kind of arrival that makes coming home feel different.

Inside, the multi-level floor plan unfolds through short stair transitions, creating separation without losing connection. Bedrooms are spread throughout the home, offering space for kids, guests, a home office, or quiet corners to retreat to as life changes.

The main living level is where everyday life comes together. A flexible nook could become the spot where mornings begin with coffee, a cozy reading corner, or a breakfast table where the day gets planned.

In the updated kitchen, waterfall quartz countertops, updated cabinetry, a five-burner stove, pot filler, and a view from the sink make everyday routines feel special. Cook while everyone gathers nearby, move into the formal dining and living areas for dinner, then step onto one of the home's most memorable spaces: the expansive deck.

Imagine slow weekend mornings with coffee and a view, summer dinners outside, friends gathering as the sun goes down, or quiet evenings surrounded by the landscape. The deck feels like another living room, only outdoors.

Direct outdoor access from multiple levels keeps you connected to the property. Vinyl plank flooring, updated bathrooms, generous storage, a skylight, two-car garage, and carport add everyday function, while six bedrooms provide flexibility to make the home your own.

40325 Pageant Place is for the buyer who wants more than rooms and square footage. It is mornings on the deck, fruit growing outside your door, space for family and friends, room to spread out, and a home where each part of the day can unfold in its own space.

Here, home can feel a little more like an escape.

remarks: With defining architectural elements and a profound connection to its landscape, this recently transformed mid-century residence unfolds as a series of light-filled spaces where every room feels beautifully curated. Enveloped by gardens conceived by Garrett Carlson and Mark Levine, the property offers a rare sense of calm, with mature greenery, sculptural plantings, and carefully framed sight lines creating an atmosphere that feels worlds away from the city beyond.Venetian plaster introduces a warm, tactile palette that continues throughout, while expansive walls of glass dissolve traditional boundaries, allowing the surrounding gardens to become an integral part of the architecture. The principal living room is centered around a sculptural bronze mirrored fireplace, its generous scale extending effortlessly outdoors through disappearing glass. The entertaining spaces transition naturally from one to the next. The kitchen is appointed with custom cabinetry, stone surfaces, a Wolf range, and a complete suite of Miele appliances. An integrated display for glassware and a bespoke bar create a natural focal point before opening to a more relaxed family living area. Nearby, a dedicated wine lounge with its own full bath and thoughtfully positioned laundry room reinforce the home's functionality. Privately positioned, the primary suite continues the home's dialogue with nature, opening directly onto the gardens through walls of glass. A dramatic two-level dressing room offers boutique-like proportions, while the bath introduces richly veined Italian onyx vanities, a rainfall shower, and a palette selected to evoke the atmosphere of a private wellness retreat. A spacious secondary suite and an adaptable third room provide flexibility for guests, an office, fitness studio, or creative space depending on lifestyle. Outside, the grounds are thoughtfully arranged around a pool and spa, outdoor kitchen, dining terrace, and fire lounge, all surrounded by layered landscaping that creates exceptional privacy. Completed between 2020 and 2023, the home's extensive renovation reached well beyond aesthetics, incorporating upgraded mechanical systems, new HVAC, and solar infrastructure to complement its architectural transformation. The result is a residence where timeless mid-century principles have been thoughtfully reinterpreted through contemporary craftsmanship, creating a home that feels enduring, highly livable, and quietly exceptional.

remarks: Welcome home to Countrywood Village East! Newly remodeled and located in a highly coveted community, this bright and inviting townhome boasts an open floor plan with 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms. The home is also near many grocery stores like 99 Ranch Market, 168 Market and H Mart, as well as many popular restaurants and easy access to public transit.

remarks: On a quiet Hollywood Hills street and tastefully renovated, 6837 Cahuenga Park Trail offers two bedrooms plus a dedicated office, each with its own ensuite bath, filled with natural light, hillside views, and multiple outdoor spaces. The main level is open and bright, with solid white oak floors running throughout. Windows wrap the living space, bringing the surrounding hills into view and framing the Hollywood Sign and Griffith Observatory. The renovated kitchen pairs warm wood cabinetry with European tile, Kohler brass accents, and a broad peninsula, while the office with ensuite bath provides a separate place to work. The openness of the floor plan makes the space equally suited to a quiet evening or a house full of friends. Upstairs, the primary suite opens through French doors to a large private patio with views of the Hollywood Sign, Griffith Observatory, and the surrounding hills. The renovated bath features European tile and Kohler brass detailing, and a walk-in closet provides generous storage. The second bedroom and bath occupy the lower level, giving guests privacy from the primary suite. Outside, there is more than one place to settle in. The broad terrace off the primary suite, rooftop garage deck, and private rear patio each offer a different view and atmosphere - morning coffee, dinner outside, or an evening beneath the string lights and trees. Original details preserve just enough of the home's 1920s character, including a cast-iron claw foot tub, a few original windows, and a built-in safe downstairs. Central air, a tankless water heater, LED lighting, laundry, and a two-car garage, a rare find in the hills, round out the modern comforts. There is a certain romance to living here, surrounded by hills and changing light while still closely connected to the city. Major studios, Hollywood Bowl, Runyon Canyon and more are only 15 minutes away, Cahuenga Boulevard and freeway access are easily reached from a street that feels quiet and removed.

remarks:
Welcome to 18821 Ridgeview Circle, a beautifully reimagined single-level ranch-style residence on one of Villa Park’s most prestigious streets. Reconstructed from the studs in 2019 and extensively redesigned throughout, this 5-bedroom, 3.5-bathroom home offers approximately 4,884 square feet of refined living space plus an impressive 1,400 square feet of covered outdoor living. With its single-level design, the home offers both comfort and long-term functionality, creating an ideal setting to age gracefully without compromising style or luxury.
The home features wide-plank French white oak flooring, new windows and doors, retextured walls, custom lighting, updated plumbing, and thoughtfully curated finishes throughout. The heart of the home is the expansive entertainer’s kitchen with soaring ceilings, quartzite countertops, Calacatta Gold marble backsplash, Thermador appliances, a large island, butler’s kitchen, coffee bar, and walk-in pantry.
The primary suite offers a private retreat with a fireplace and spa-inspired bathroom featuring marble finishes, brass hardware, a freestanding tub, steam shower, bidet, and custom walk-in closet. Secondary bedrooms and bathrooms have been tastefully updated with premium finishes, custom closets, designer tile, and luxury fixtures.
The resort-style backyard has been completely transformed with a redesigned pool, PebbleTec finish, Baja entry, integrated jacuzzi, waterfall feature, putting green, low-maintenance landscaping, and mature privacy greenery. The expansive California room includes a built-in barbecue, quartzite counters, seating for 12, outdoor fireplace, heaters, fan, recessed lighting, and space for a TV, creating the perfect setting for year-round entertaining. Above it all, the rooftop deck offers a beautiful place to take in sunset views, the surrounding hills, and views stretching toward Newport Beach.
Additional upgrades include redesigned front landscaping, custom privacy fencing, new driveway, updated garage doors, exterior stone accents, and extensive indoor and outdoor improvements. The property also offers a 4-car garage with room to park four additional vehicles in the driveway, providing exceptional parking and storage flexibility.

remarks: Welcome to coastal living at its best in Ventura, California. Located just three doors from the Surfer's Point Promenade and mere steps from the sand, this ocean-view condo offers breathtaking views of the ocean and pier, along with the soothing sound of waves throughout the home. In fact, you can hear the surf from every room.FLEX SPACE! We all want it--and we all need it! Designed with versatility in mind, this condominium can easily be converted into a second bedroom. So how will you use this spacious ocean-view room with direct access to the deck? A home office? Gym? Media room? Library? The possibilities are nearly endless.Thoughtfully designed to maximize the coastal setting, the unit features two balcony access points and strategically placed wall-sized mirrors that reflect the ocean views deep into the living space. Additional views overlook the beautifully maintained pool and courtyard.The updated kitchen blends style and functionality with abundant Shaker soft-close cabinetry, seeded-glass cabinet doors, convenient pots-and-pan drawers, an LG French-door refrigerator, a farmhouse sink, and durable Dekton countertops. A charming porthole opening to the living room enhances the open-concept layout and keeps the space feeling bright and connected.Start each day with ocean views from the spacious primary bedroom, where the coastal scenery makes mornings feel effortless. The primary bath features Dekton countertops and updated hardware, while the attractive 3/4 guest bath is conveniently located for residents and visitors alike.Residents enjoy an impressive collection of amenities, including a year-round heated pool, spa, fitness center, clubhouse, and two saunas. The gated garage provides two assigned side-by-side parking spaces along with ample storage.Adding to the convenience and excitement of the location, the building sits adjacent to the Ventura County Fairgrounds, home to year-round events, the Derby Room, and the Players Poker Club. Ventura's historic downtown district--with its restaurants, nightlife, galleries, boutiques, and entertainment--is also just a short walk away.Every day feels like a seaside staycation. If you've dreamed of living where flip-flops count as formal wear, you've found your place.

remarks:
Beautifully updated and ideally positioned within the gated Stratford Collection at Valencia Summit, this turnkey 3-bedroom, 2.5-bath residence offers approximately 1,850 square feet of light-filled living space and captivating canyon views.

The thoughtfully redesigned main level features an open-concept layout connecting the kitchen, dining and living areas. Crown molding, newer laminate flooring downstairs and fresh paint in select rooms add to the home’s polished, move-in-ready appeal.

The spacious primary suite features a private view deck—an ideal vantage point for taking in the beautiful canyon surroundings. Outside, the landscaped and hardscaped backyard offers a peaceful setting where expansive views and natural scenery create a wonderful sense of privacy and tranquility.

Additional highlights include a dedicated laundry room, two-car garage with overhead storage and a newer A/C condenser. Residents of Valencia Summit enjoy scenic walking trails, clubhouse facilities, an Olympic-size pool, additional pools and spas, tennis courts and more.

Turnkey, beautifully maintained and set against an impressive canyon backdrop, this exceptional home captures the best of the Valencia Summit lifestyle.

remarks: Sophisticated luxury meets timeless elegance in this exceptional Clancy Lane estate in one of Rancho Mirage's most prestigious addresses. From the moment you arrive via the circular drive and enter the gated courtyard with its tranquil fountain and grand custom doors, the home sets a tone of refined desert living. A dramatic foyer leads to the formal living room, where a stacked-stone fireplace, soaring ceilings, and French doors showcase sweeping south-facing mountain views. The chef's kitchen is a culinary masterpiece, featuring illuminated mahogany cabinetry, granite surfaces, a generous prep island with counter seating, 100-bottle wine cooler, and elite appliances including buit-in Sub-Zero refrigerator, Dacor Range top, Miele Dishwasher, Wolf double ovens, and a warming drawer. Seamless flow connects the kitchen to both the intimate dining area and the inviting family room. Designed for effortless indoor-outdoor living, the residence features an expansive entertainment pavilion complete with built-in gas BBQ, mini refrigerator, mini dishwasher, sink, granite counters, ceiling fan, and outdoor TV. The resort-style half acre plus backyard offers a PebbleTec pool and spa, each with independent heating systems plus a new 'Estate Green' putting green, Sonus outdoor speakers, automatic landscape lighting, and a cooling misting system for warm desert days. The thoughtfully designed floor plan provides exceptional privacy with two primary suites and an additional ensuite guest bedroom, each with patio access and electric roller shades. Additional highlights include a finished 3-car garage with extensive cabinetry and refrigerator, a spacious interior laundry room with office niche, and a host of significant upgrades: double insulation, owned new solar panels, four new A/C condensers, two new furnaces, two new tankless water heaters, and a new Kinetico water softener and filtration system, plus a built-in lighting control system . The home is also equipped with a security system 8 exterior and 2 interior Ring cameras. 20 Clancy Lane Estates is a rare offering of elegance, comfort, and impeccable craftsmanship. This Clancy Lane estate embodies the pinnacle of Rancho Mirage luxury living.

This remarkable property offers privacy, character, space, and views that simply cannot be duplicated. It is ready for a buyer with vision who appreciates distinctive architecture and untapped potential. With some TLC, cosmetic updates, and personal touches, this hillside gem could become an extraordinary private retreat or rewarding investment opportunity.

Bring your imagination, unlock the possibilities, and experience what it means to live life at the top!

Escape to your own private retreat on approximately 5.10 acres bordering the Cleveland National Forest, where incredible 360-degree views, privacy, and self-sufficient living come together in a truly special setting. This spacious 5-bedroom, 5-bath, two-story residence offers an exceptional combination of comfort, functionality, and wide-open space, all reached by a picturesque drive beneath a canopy of mature oak trees.

A standout feature of the property is the impressive 80' x 35' fully insulated shop, equipped with approximately 160 amps of power, copper air lines, an incredible space for the enthusiast, collector, craftsman, or anyone needing substantial workspace and storage. 45 solar panels located on the shop roof supply power to both the residence and shop, while a private well, two 5,500-gallon water holding tanks providing 11,000 gallons of total storage, propane, and a newer backup generator further enhance the property's self-sufficient capabilities.

Inside, the home has been refreshed with new luxury flooring, soft neutral interior paint, pet-friendly carpeting, and ceramic tile in the guest bathrooms. The upgraded kitchen features high end newer appliances by Decor and Kitchen Aid, while custom iron entry doors invite the mountain breeze inside. The spacious primary suite opens to a newly tiled private deck showcasing a truly spectacular view of the surrounding forest. 

Outdoors, enjoy a gorgeous swimming pool with beach entry, newer pool equipment, relaxing spa, shaded hammock sitting area, and drought-resistant, fire-conscious landscaping designed with limited water needs in mind. The property also features 1.5-inch fire-water hookups around the residence and shop with hoses and nozzles, adding another valuable feature to this mountain setting.

With panoramic mountain and forest views, a remarkable shop, 45-panel solar system, private well and substantial water storage, pool, acreage, and direct proximity to the Cleveland National Forest, this is a rare opportunity to experience the beauty and independence of Ortega Mountain living.

With panoramic mountain and forest views, a remarkable shop, 45-panel solar system, private well and substantial water storage, pool, acreage, and direct proximity to the Cleveland National Forest, this is a rare opportunity to experience the beauty and independence of Ortega Mountain living.

remarks: Laguna Beach living is redefined at this stunning residence in the highly desirable neighborhood of Woods Cove. Just three blocks from the sand, this newly upgraded Mid-Century Modern masterpiece blends period-perfect character with modern-day amenities in approximately 2,873 square feet. Mature privacy hedges create a secret sanctuary for indoor/outdoor living on a large corner homesite that spans approximately 7,500 square feet. Open the gate and a gorgeous courtyard with outdoor seating areas reveals itself and makes all feel welcome upon arrival. Sumptuous landscaping embellishes special times with friends and loved ones, and a driveway allows for ample guest parking beyond the home’s two-car garage. Overlooking the courtyard, a covered and heated deck that is perfect for entertaining features double entry doors that lead to the interior of the residence, where a heightened level of privacy, comfort and warmth embraces everyone who enters. A double-height foyer with impressive floating staircase flows effortlessly to living areas that are bathed in natural light. Oversized picture windows and glass doors create a seamless living experience that beautifully enriches entertaining. Three ensuite bedrooms and three- and one-half baths, each with its unique high-end style, are joined by a great room with dramatic floating fireplace that opens to an exquisite chef’s kitchen. A vaulted ceiling with large skylight crowns the space, complementing an abundance of frameless wood cabinetry and a double-waterfall island with seating. Thermador, Miele, Bosch and Dacor appliances, including a built-in cabinet-matched refrigerator, ensure ease of meal prep in the kitchen, which joins an intimate fireplace-warmed living area, a dining space, and access to outdoor dining on the deck. Upstairs, a chic primary suite with brilliant natural light and a custom fireplace opens to a generous ocean-view sundeck. Displaying brand new upgrades to the primary and guest bathrooms, the primary bath shines with an oversized shower, Schluter heated flooring, double vanity with custom riff-cut oak cabinetry, and a walk in closet. Private grounds beckon with a BBQ patio off the kitchen, a lush lawn and manicured gardens. Best of all, the acclaimed schools, restaurants, shops and galleries that Laguna Beach is famous for are just a stone’s throw away, ensuring year-round enjoyment of California’s quintessential beach-living experience.

remarks: AGENTS...This Home offers the buyer the opportunity to assume a 2.5% FHA Loan.  Welcome to 264 Tanglewood Drive to an immaculate and move in ready beautiful home in JP Ranch.   This home provides refined living in the prestigious gated community of JP Ranch in scenic Calimesa surrounded by breathtaking mountain views.    Residents of JP Ranch enjoy a gated community with Club House, Pool, Spa, BBQ Area, Playground and much more.  This exceptional home offers the perfect blend of elegance, functionality and location. From the moment you enter the home you feel impressed by its informal wide entry way and the spaciousness which welcomes you The home features 4 bedrooms and 3 full bathrooms.   The thoughtfully designed floorpan includes 1 down stairs bedroom with full bathroom ideal for guests, multigenerational living or a home office setup.  The layout flows naturally from the main living area into the kitchen which highlights granite counter tops, an island with raised breakfast bar, stainless appliances, ample white cabinetry and counter space along with a pantry.  There is upgraded laminate flooring in the living areas downstairs, tile in all the bathrooms and laundry room with carpet in the bedrooms.  From the kitchen area as you step outside the slider you notice the beautiful mountains and hills surrounding JP Ranch.  There is a full size patio and alumawood raised patio cover for your enjoyment and comfort.  The patio includes 3 specially selected fans for your relaxation.  As you proceed upstairs you enter the oversized loft/great room which offers plenty of outside lighting and views.  The primary suite is generously sized and features magnificent views of the mountains from the windows.  The upgraded master bathroom features a walk in shower, dual vanities, and a walk in closet.  There are two additional bedrooms upstairs offering privacy for everyone.  The Laundry is off the loft/great room and includes a washer and dryer already hooked up and ready to go.  As a bonus there is an additional room for storage off of the laundry room.  The front and backyards were designed for minimal maintenance so you can spend time enjoying the home.  The irrigation system is on a timer as an added feature.  Do not miss this opportunity to secure one of the best values in JP Ranch.

remarks:
Woodridge community of La Habra. Tucked away along a lush, tree-lined walkway, this move-in-ready home offers the perfect combination of privacy, comfort, and modern style.
Step inside to a bright, open floor plan featuring a spacious living room highlighted by a cozy fireplace and a custom built-in entertainment wall that adds both character and functionality. The expanded dining area flows effortlessly into the remodeled kitchen, creating an ideal layout for everyday living and entertaining. Thoughtfully updated with granite countertops, soft-close cabinetry, recessed lighting, a generous walk-in pantry, abundant storage, and crisp white appliances, the kitchen is both beautiful and highly functional.
An oversized sliding glass door opens to your own private patio, extending the living space outdoors and providing the perfect setting for morning coffee, weekend BBQs, or relaxing after a long day.
The spacious primary suite offers generous closet space and a private en-suite bath, while the secondary bedroom and adjacent full bath provide flexibility for family, guests, or a dedicated home office. Patio-level washer and dryer hookups, along with an additional community laundry facility, offer added convenience.
Perfectly positioned within the community, this desirable interior location overlooks a peaceful greenbelt and is just steps from the covered carport with private storage. Residents enjoy resort-style amenities including a gated pool, cabana, volleyball court, expansive grassy areas, and beautifully maintained walking paths.
Conveniently located within walking distance of La Habra's newest shopping, popular restaurants, grocery stores, and everyday conveniences, this exceptional home offers low-maintenance living in one of the area's most desirable communities. Whether you're a first-time buyer, downsizing, or simply looking for a turnkey home in a fantastic location, this is one you won't want to miss.

remarks: Perched above the Pacific with sweeping ocean and Channel Islands views, this reimagined 1955 Midcentury Modern compound offers privacy, luxury, and versatility on about 1/3 acre in Midtown Ventura. Behind a fully fenced and walled perimeter with electric gated entry, the property includes a remodeled 4BD/3BA single-story main residence and a separate luxury 697 sq ft guest house with its own address- two homes on one APN.Inside, the ocean view kitchen anchors the great room with stainless Bertazzoni appliances, a marble waterfall island, quartz countertops, and custom cabinetry, opening through an oversized slider to indoor/outdoor living and Ventura sunsets. The primary suite occupies its own wing with Channel Islands views, a private patio, a custom closet with built-in storage, and a spa-style bath with heated floors. The opposite wing offers a living area, two bedrooms, and a bath, a flexible space for today's work-from-home buyer, guests, or extended family.The separate single-story guest house is a luxury retreat with a full kitchen featuring Brazilian Blue Azul quartzite, Bertazzoni appliances, and a wine refrigerator, plus a Murphy bed, freestanding soaking tub, and Western red cedar sauna.The grounds are planted with grapefruit, tangerine, blood orange, apricot, lemon, lime, fig, and avocado trees. The three-car garage, expanded with a third bay in the recent remodel, includes one drive-through space with doors on both ends for easy yard and guest house access, plus room for additional parking and storage, and EV chargers in each garage bay. Other amenities include RV parking with hookups behind the gate for extra security, owned solar, whole-house filtered water, surfboard and kayak storage, and a fully wired Tuff Shed with island views, ideal for an art studio, workshop, or office. The home is already wired for holiday lighting.The expansive front grounds offer room for a pickleball or basketball court, a pool, more outdoor entertaining space, or a potential additional 3rd ADU, subject to approval. With two residences, three garage spaces, gated privacy, island views, and real flexibility, 3310 Foothill Rd is a rare chance to own a private coastal compound in the heart of Ventura.

remarks: Escape to mountain time with this thoughtfully crafted, low-maintenance cabin in peaceful Long Barn. Situated on a spacious double lot (two separate parcels with two APNs), this property under the pines offers ample parking with multiple access points, and room for future development. While the main home features a cozy, efficient footprint, the interior and property is designed to feel incredibly accommodating. The main living space features custom framing and unique natural log posts that deliver a charming, modern-rustic aesthetic. The layout includes a comfortable main-level bedroom and bathroom, plus a built-in loft area overhead perfect for an additional bed. Step outside onto either of the two spacious Northern or Southern facing decks—perfect for relaxing and grilling in the fresh mountain air—or take advantage of the steps-away access to scenic local walking trails.  Property also features a bonus 10x12 detached sleeper cabin, providing the perfect overflow space for guests, a quiet home office, or a hobby studio. An included heavy-duty storage container also serves as an excellent secure workshop. Built for relaxation and easy upkeep, this home is the ultimate four-season launchpad: just 10 minutes to Pinecrest Lake for summer boating and hiking, and a short drive to Dodge Ridge Mountain Resort for winter skiing and snowboarding. Low-maintenance, high-character, and loaded with potential—come make your mountain memories here!

remarks: Rarely does a residence of this scale, privacy, and individuality become available in one of Beverly Hills' most sought-after boutique buildings. Set across the top two floors of an elegant Mediterranean-style building completed in 2002, this extraordinary front-facing penthouse townhouse offers approximately 2,158  square feet, three bedrooms, two-and-one-half baths, three side-by-side parking spaces, and expansive terraces extending along both levels. With only 20 residences in the building, controlled access, elevator service, additional storage, and exceptionally reasonable monthly HOA dues of approximately $971, this is a truly distinctive opportunity in the heart of Beverly Hills. The story begins on the upper level, where a gracious formal entry introduces a dramatic, light-filled floor designed for living and entertaining. The living room is centered around a striking custom fireplace created from two full slabs of premium marble and opens to a terrace with lovely city and neighborhood views. The adjoining dining room, custom bar area, and beautifully upgraded kitchen flow together effortlessly, creating an inviting environment for intimate evenings or larger gatherings. The kitchen features exotic blonde burlwood cabinetry, smooth roll-out drawers, black marble countertops and backsplash, glass-front display cabinets, extensive lighting, and newer appliances, including a refrigerator, dishwasher, and microwave. A stylish powder room and custom lighting designed specifically to showcase art complete this level. A wide staircase leads to the private bedroom floor below, where the generous primary suite opens directly to another exceptionally long terrace and includes a customized walk-in closet and a fully redesigned marble bathroom with a separate tub and shower, wraparound mirrors, extensive cabinetry, roll-out drawers, and an upgraded toilet and bidet. Two additional bedrooms offer flexibility for guests, an office, studio, or art room, and share a beautifully remodeled second full bathroom. Throughout the residence, marble flooring has been installed over a one-inch cork underlayment for enhanced soundproofing, while extensive flush LED and specialty art lighting, custom built-ins, upgraded closets, UV-protected windows, privacy shades, Phantom screens, and a newer Nest climate-control system reflect years of thoughtful improvements. Outdoor living is one of the home's most remarkable attributes. Enormous terraces span nearly the entire length of both floors, offering multiple places to relax, entertain, display sculpture, or enjoy the open views. Additional features include a separate laundry room with marble flooring, new cabinetry, a deep stainless-steel utility sink, and newer washer and dryer; two secured storage spaces; and three side-by-side parking spaces in the gated subterranean garage. Former MLS records also confirm the residence's rare two-story penthouse configuration, front-facing location, private roof deck, open floor plan, city views, and terraces extending across both levels. More than a condominium, this is a private Beverly Hills townhouse in the sky- an artful, highly customized home offering exceptional interior volume, extraordinary outdoor space, a deeded rooftop retreat, and a combination of privacy and convenience that is exceedingly difficult to duplicate.

remarks:
Welcome to this one bedroom, one bath split-level loft condominium in the Orange Lakes community which immerses you in mature trees, forest-like views and a soothing stream only feet from your patio.  This streamside "end-unit" benefits from only one common wall and no one above or below you.  The unit is close to the pool/spa and tennis courts and the patio has direct unobstructed views of the main wildlife refuge lake.

Adding to this unit's desirability and easy living feel, its dedicated covered carport is located mere steps from the front door providing the home with comparative "best-in-complex" ingress and egress to and from the unit. The condo is quickly and easily accessed from S Solana Drive, a quiet side street on the east side of the Orange Lakes instead of through the main driveway entrance.   

This unit had a full renovation in May 2020 including many upgrades: new kitchen appliances and stacking washer/dryer, upstairs loft area received a complete renovation of the upstairs bathroom including custom made shower control valves, custom handmade floating bathroom vanity, custom handmade double-wide barn-door leading into bathroom, and the bathroom mirror has built in lighting and heating so it won’t fog.  All downstairs outlets and switches were upgraded, all lighting was replaced, original wood cabinetry was updated with new hardware, interior stairs were re-capped with solid oak treads leading to a luxury vinyl plank second floor. The entire second story was insulated with modern R-19 to maximize energy efficiency and reduce noise.  The sewer was snaked clean from second story down to city main.  All air vents were replaced, and a new modern  electrical panel was installed.  The patio storage shed was fully rebuilt and new floor-to-ceiling wood shelving installed. 

Added features and upgrades include a whole home 3 stage water filter installed in the utility cabinet outside, a Large Volume Ceiling fan installed on second floor (capable of moving 1300 cfm, remote control lets you adjust speed and direction of air), and also a remote controlled window blind above the rear patio sliding glass door.

The Orange Lakes is close to Peters Canyon Regional Park, Irvine Park, walking and hiking trails, Irvine Lake and historic Old Towne Orange, with small town shopping and dining experiences. 

Don't miss out on the opportunity to enjoy life in this exceptionally located condominium in the Orange Lakes.

Lovingly maintained by only two owners, the 2-bedroom, 2-bath residence features approximately 1,445 square feet of living space with an attached 2-car garage, vaulted ceilings, and a bright, open layout that creates a seamless indoor-outdoor connection.

The home features beautiful maple hardwood flooring throughout the main living areas, new luxury vinyl plank flooring on the lower level, and fresh interior paint throughout. The main living area is designed to feel open and welcoming, with a fireplace, abundant natural light, and access to a private patio overlooking the greenbelt. The dining area flows naturally into the kitchen and breakfast nook, making the home ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. remarks: An architecturally unique home with a Zig Zag Butterfly roof. Design and landscaping by DIGBAR Interiors and Architecture. Like New-completely reconstructed in 2025, down to the studs, featuring all new materials and modern finishes throughout. The high-ceiling entryway with window seat welcomes each day with morning sun. The backyard meadow of native bent grass seldom needs mowing, and orange, apricot and fuyu persimmon trees produce fresh fruit. A large master suite with an office area has access to the grassy backyard and patio where you can enjoy afternoon sun and soothing daily breeze from the ocean. Wonderfully located with easy access to the Ballona Bike Path, minutes to LAX and Downtown Culver City, biking distance to Playa Vista, Marina Del Rey and the beach. remarks:
Welcome home to easy living in this vibrant, 55+ gated community! Step through the charming brick entryway, accented by attractive landscaping and distinctive tiki-inspired wood spindles, and discover this desirable corner end-unit condo—ready for your personal touches and priced accordingly.
Inside, an open-air atrium brings in natural light, while ceiling fans throughout the main living areas provide year-round comfort. The spacious eat-in kitchen offers abundant cabinets, tiled countertops and backsplash, and a sunny window above the sink. Best of all, all appliances are included. The open-concept living and dining area features a cozy gas fireplace and a sliding glass door that leads to a private covered patio, creating the perfect setting for morning coffee or relaxing evenings.  Additionally, there is a side-yard access gate from the patio and a laundry area, which includes a washer and dryer. The primary bedroom offers a peaceful retreat with an attached bathroom and dual mirrored closets. A second bedroom at the front of the home is ideal for guests, a home office, or hobbies, complete with mirrored closet doors and access to the inviting atrium. A full hallway bathroom provides added convenience for visitors.  Beyond the home, enjoy resort-style living in one of the area's premier gated 55+ communities. Residents have access to an impressive array of amenities, including a recently refurbished pool and spa (2023), clubhouse, auditorium, fitness center, game room, woodworking and ceramics studios, shuffleboard, horseshoe courts, basketball court, picnic and BBQ areas, lawn bowling, and not one but two golf courses. The HOA provides exceptional value by covering trash, sewer, exterior building and roof maintenance, landscaping, insurance, a special cable TV package, and more. The community also offers the peace of mind of a guarded entrance with 24/7 gate attendants and security patrols. This is an exceptional opportunity to create the home you've always wanted while enjoying an active, secure, and amenity-rich lifestyle.

remarks: Welcome to the best value in all of South Palm Springs for a premiere home in a premiere neighborhood. This beautifully crafted contemporary home in Luminaire is an intimate pueblo-inspired enclave where desert modern architecture meets genuine privacy. Designed to be a sanctuary, inside nearly 3,000 square feet of light-filled, architecturally distinct living space impresses with clean lines, sleek finishes, modern tile flooring, and high ceilings. The gourmet kitchen anchors the home with Cambria Quartz countertops, a generous island, gas cook-top, and premium stainless appliances, equally suited for quiet weeknight cooking or effortless entertaining. The spacious dining area flows into the Great Room with a gas fireplace, all opening to the private backyard. Outside, mature trees frame a sparkling saltwater Pebble Tec pool and spa, while the waterfall feature creates a calming ambiance. Remote-controlled Sunbrella awnings provide cool shade, a built-in BBQ makes entertaining a breeze, and the trellised courtyard with its fireplace, fountain, and built-in lighting and misting system extends your living space beautifully into the desert evenings. Sited within the quiet neighborhood of Araby Cove, with easy access to Route 111, this quiet location provides easy access to downtown Palm Springs, the airport, gourmet groceries, a pharmacy, and pet care.  Upscale shopping and dining at El Paseo is just 20 minutes away.  Thoughtfully designed to leave the outside world behind, Luminaire also enjoys a notably sheltered position, quieter from the desert wind that affects much of the valley. The crown jewel is the upstairs guest casita; a fully self-contained retreat with mini kitchen, bath, Sleep Number Murphy bed, and a private patio commanding the best mountain views in all of Luminaire. Additional highlights include a fully warranted solar system, Apex water conditioning, and multi-zone Lennox AC with electrostatic air filtration -- cool, quiet, and energy efficient year-round. This is the Palm Springs lifestyle at its most complete; private, polished, and priced to move.

Come experience this exceptional Anaheim Hills gem for yourself.

remarks:
Tucked into a quiet Quartz Hill neighborhood, this beautifully maintained single-story home blends classic contemporary style with true turnkey comfort. A tile roof and stucco exterior set the tone from the curb, opening into a bright, functional layout built for everyday living and easy entertaining.

Step through the front door into a welcoming living room, then flow back through an open kitchen and dining area — granite counters, a center island, and a gas range make this the kind of connected space where conversation never has to stop for cooking. On the far side, the family room anchors the back of the home with a cozy fireplace and a sliding door out to the backyard, giving the layout an easy, natural flow from front to back. Tile and carpet flooring carry through with easy-care style.

The primary suite offers a private bath with double sinks, and ceiling fans throughout help keep things comfortable year-round with central air and heat. Block wall construction and matching perimeter fencing add durability and privacy.

Step outside and the backyard is the showstopper: a lush, manicured lawn, mature trees, and a concrete patio made for relaxing evenings or weekend gatherings, all wrapped by block walls for added privacy. A three-car garage offers direct home access and plenty of extra storage, and the driveway provides even more room to park.

Set on public water and sewer with no HOA, this Quartz Hill gem is move-in ready and waiting for its next owner.

remarks: Beautifully maintained, single story home in the desirable Eagle Point neighborhood, located just a few blocks from the lake. This turnkey, custom home offers 3 bedrooms, 3 baths, plus a versatile bonus room with a pot-belly stove—perfect for an extra bedroom, office, den or hobby space. The spacious living room features an energy-efficient, floor-to-ceiling brick fireplace, hardwood flooring, built-in shelving and a pass-thru window with eat-in bar. The kitchen had a recent facelift with granite countertops, cabinet upgrades and stainless steel appliances. The spacious primary suite includes a generous walk-in closet and walk-in shower with custom tile work. Other amenities include hardwood flooring throughout the dining room, entryway and hallways, fresh interior and exterior paint, separate laundry room with door to backyard and wood accents throughout. Situated on a large level lot, the nicely treed and fully fenced backyard provides a sense of privacy and plenty of space to relax or entertain. Enjoy the large covered patio, outdoor spa and two spacious storage sheds - one used for gardening and one currently used as an art studio. Additional features include oversized two-car garage with pull-down attic access and room for a workshop, several fruit trees, plus raspberry and blackberry bushes in front and back yards, and a whole-house generator for added comfort and peace of mind. And you're just a few short minutes away from the lake, stores and ski slopes. From its attractive street appeal to its secluded backyard retreat, this property offers an ideal combination of class, comfort and convenience. Don't miss this excellent opportunity to make it yours!

remarks: Be the first to experience the joys of living, entertaining and relaxing at this modern ocean-view masterpiece behind the guarded entry gates of The Strand at Headlands in Dana Point. Under construction and scheduled for completion in 2026, the light-filled custom residence presents a prized second-row location that affords stunning Pacific Ocean, Catalina Island, sunset and beach views from four levels, which include a rooftop patio with kitchen and open-air fireplace. A testament to sophisticated modern architecture showcasing the talents of Geoff Sumich Design, Tiffany Harris Design and built by Genova Construction, the exceptionally designed home will welcome all with a phenomenal foyer centered around a floating circular staircase that accesses all levels. An elevator is also featured, and high-end natural stone and wood finishes, custom-caliber lighting and plumbing fixtures, and wide open proportions combine to create a refined living environment. Approximately 8,237 square feet, the generous floorplan includes six ensuite bedrooms, an ensuite office, seven full baths and two half baths. The main entry level showcases an open design with a dining room, massive living room with high ceiling, a fully appointed island kitchen and a secondary butler’s pantry/catering kitchen. This entire space opens to an ocean-view deck via slideaway glass doors. Bedrooms are located on the third floor, complete with a luxurious primary suite that will reveal an entry vestibule with coffee bar, an ocean-view deck, sitting area, walk-in closet, soaking tub, separate shower and two vanities. Play, refresh and reinvigorate on the lowest level, which hosts a gym with bath, a walk-in bar, play/media room, and an after-swim changing room. Slideaway glass doors open to a terraced ocean-view backyard with pool and spa. Additional highlights will include a three-car garage, golf cart garage, two laundry rooms, and rooftop planters. The Strand at Headlands is one of the most coveted oceanfront communities in California and offers more than one mile of coastline, 70 acres of parks, scenic trails, a beach club and easy access to resorts, shops, restaurants and outstanding schools.

A testament to sophisticated modern architecture showcasing the talents of Geoff Sumich Design, Tiffany Harris Design and built by Genova Construction, the exceptionally designed home will welcome all with a phenomenal foyer centered around a floating circular staircase that accesses all levels. An elevator is also featured, and high-end natural stone and wood finishes, custom-caliber lighting and plumbing fixtures, and wide open proportions combine to create a refined living environment. Approximately 8,237 square feet, the generous floorplan includes six ensuite bedrooms, an ensuite office, seven full baths and two half baths. The main entry level showcases an open design with a dining room, massive living room with high ceiling, a fully appointed island kitchen and a secondary butler’s pantry/catering kitchen. This entire space opens to an ocean-view deck via slideaway glass doors. Bedrooms are located on the third floor, complete with a luxurious primary suite that will reveal an entry vestibule with coffee bar, an ocean-view deck, sitting area, walk-in closet, soaking tub, separate shower and two vanities. Play, refresh and reinvigorate on the lowest level, which hosts a gym with bath, a walk-in bar, play/media room, and an after-swim changing room. Slideaway glass doors open to a terraced ocean-view backyard with pool and spa. Additional highlights will include a three-car garage, golf cart garage, two laundry rooms, and rooftop planters. The Strand at Headlands is one of the most coveted oceanfront communities in California and offers more than one mile of coastline, 70 acres of parks, scenic trails, a beach club and easy access to resorts, shops, restaurants and outstanding schools.

remarks: Great Palisades Location first tier John Muir Rd. A wonderfully distinctive Lake Arrowhead retreat where mountain charm, timeless architecture, and an exceptional lake lifestyle come together. Tucked among towering pines and mature greenery, this beautifully maintained 5-bedroom, 4-bath home is filled with a character and craftsmanship that are nearly impossible to recreate. From the moment you step inside, the home sets itself apart. The dramatic great room serves as the heart of this John Muir Lodge, featuring a stunning floor-to-ceiling fireplace as its centerpiece, soaring vaulted ceilings, exposed timber trusses, rich tongue-and-groove paneling, and walls of windows framing beautiful views of Lake Arrowhead. It is a space made for long holiday weekends, fireside evenings, family gatherings, and peaceful mountain mornings. Adjoining the living room, the spacious family room offers a second granite-faced wood-burning fireplace, wet bar, icemaker, and beverage refrigerator, creating an ideal setting for entertaining. A generous dining room and classic kitchen flow easily into the surrounding living spaces. Throughout the home, thoughtful architectural details and unexpected touches, such as built-in, woodwork, and brickwork, give each room its own personality.  Upstairs, five bedrooms and three bathrooms provide ample space for family and guests, including a spacious primary suite with own fireplace and built-in cabinetry. Outside, multiple decks and patios are nestled among the trees, offering peaceful settings for morning coffee, summer dinners, and afternoons spent beneath the pines. A two-car garage adds to this turnkey, full furnished home. Best of all, lake days are just steps away. For additional $$, a single-slip  S-358 dock completes the ultimate Lake Arrowhead experience. Simply walk out the door, cross John Muir Road, and you can be at your own single-slip dock. Spend the afternoon swimming, boating, or paddling on the lake, then wander home to your private retreat. Come view this wonderful Lake Arrowhead Home and make it yours.

Welcome to 7608 Ani Way, a beautifully upgraded detached single family residence built in 2016, offering 4 bedrooms and 3 bathrooms within an exclusive gated community in North Hollywood. Thoughtfully designed for today's lifestyle, this move in ready home features a highly desirable floor plan with a full bedroom and bathroom on the main level, ideal for guests, multigenerational living, or a private home office.

The bright and inviting interior showcases Bamboo Toasted Almond flooring, quartz countertops, slow close cabinetry, crown molding, custom closet systems throughout, Nest climate control, a security camera system, Samsung stainless steel appliances, and a newer washer and dryer conveniently located upstairs. Ideally located near the 170 and 5 freeways, Burbank Airport, major studios, shopping, dining, and entertainment, this home offers convenient access to everything the San Fernando Valley and Greater Los Angeles area have to offer.

7608 Ani Way is located within a private gated enclave of only 15 detached single family residences. Every home within the community offers no shared walls, creating a true single family home experience, complemented by a low HOA, community park access, and the privacy, convenience, and newer construction that are increasingly difficult to find in North Hollywood.

remarks: Welcome to 1587 Dawnview Drive, an exquisite blend of luxury, elegance, and resort-style living located in the highly desirable Stonebrook estates neighborhood of Brentwood. Spanning 3,302 square feet of meticulously designed living space on a generous 0.21-acre lot, this home offers fine craftsmanship and high-end upgrades throughout. Step into the grand, light-filled formal living and dining space complete with French doors that lead to the outdoor sitting area in the side yard. Continue into the open-concept family room framed by massive wall-to-wall windows that seamlessly bring vibrant outdoor scenery inside. At the heart of the home is a chef’s dream kitchen featuring a large central island, custom cabinets, granite counters, an expansive breakfast bar, and an informal eat-in kitchen area. Also outfitted with a custom pantry and high-end finishes. Upstairs, the grand primary suite serves as a private sanctuary with a spa-inspired bath and a spacious primary retreat that can easily convert into a 4th bedroom. Generously sized secondary bedrooms and a full bath complete the upper level. French doors off the kitchen lead to your private backyard paradise, designed with low-maintenance landscaping including realistic artificial turf, surrounded by lush, vibrant flowering plants. Relax or entertain under the covered sitting patio, cool off in your private sparkling pool, or utilize the standalone She-shed / versatile workshop space—ideal for hobbies, home office, or extra storage. Complete with a 2-car garage and NO HOA fees, this home represents Northern California living at its finest.

remarks: Set between Park Boulevard and Dimond Park, this two-bedroom bungalow pairs original craftsmanship with the warmth and character of a well-loved home.  Carefully tended over many years, the drought-tolerant front garden sets an elegant tone, drawing butterflies, birds, and bees and giving the stately five-sided bay window a peaceful view as neighbors stroll by. Sit a while to have a quiet chat on the generous and private front porch over morning coffee or as the sun sets.  Inside, natural light moves easily through the living and dining rooms, bringing the inlaid hardwood floors and original woodwork to life. The living room centers around a wood-burning fireplace, while the dining room - with its original gumwood paneling, built-in sideboards, and generous windows with clathri metalwork - feels especially warm and inviting.  An updated kitchen with generous space and abundant cabinetry offers plenty of room to cook, gather, and share meals. Two comfortable bedrooms and a bathroom thoughtfully updated to complement the home’s original character round out the well-planned layout. A generous linen cabinet and roomy closets provide ample storage throughout.  In back, the level yard hosts established California native plantings and a trio of mature Japanese maple trees, creating a private setting for outdoor dining, gardening, or unwinding in the sun. A detached flex space expands the possibilities, offering potential as  a playroom, home office, creative studio, or guest cottage.  Dating to 1916 and featured on an Oakland Heritage Alliance tour, this home has retained the craftsmanship that makes Glenview bungalows so beloved. Within walking distance of Glenview Elementary School, the cafés, restaurants, and neighborhood favorites along Park Boulevard, as well as Dimond Park, Lions Pool, Sausal Creek, and the trails into Dimond Canyon, this is a home that feels connected - to nature, to community, and to the best of Oakland living.

remarks: Huge Price Correction! Extraordinary opportunity to own a Ranch in Ranchita Estates offering 53 acres, two residences, and premier equestrian amenities with direct access to private and public horse and hiking trails—accessible directly from your own property. A rare blend of refined single-level living, multi generational living, functional ranch infrastructure, and breathtaking natural surroundings. The main 3/4 residence is thoughtfully designed on a single level with soaring ceilings, recessed lighting, tile and carpet flooring and functional floor plan. The private primary wing features expansive windows, two walk-in closets, carpet and laminate flooring, dual vanity areas, jetted soaking tub and walk-in shower. From most of the main living spaces, you can sit and enjoy peaceful views of horses grazing in the pastures and the rolling hills beyond. Living and family rooms showcase a fireplace, open-beam wood ceilings, custom built-ins, and sliders opening to a screened and covered patio ideal for alfresco dining. The backyard blends seamlessly into acres of open land, allowing you to ride or hike directly from your property into miles of scenic trails. The home also includes a formal dining area w/ built-ins, kitchen with tile countertops and floors, pantry, casual dining nook surrounded by windows and pasture views, two additional ensuite bedrooms with walk-in showers, a half bath, laundry room with abundant cabinetry and backyard access, and a three-car garage with built-in storage and utility sink. A charming guest house built in 2018 (unpermitted) offers approx. 1,300sq ft (not included in the sf. above) with 3 bedrooms and 1 bath. Rustic in style, it features cement floors, oak shaker cabinets, tile countertops, handmade built-in wood table, barn doors, high ceilings w/ exposed wood beams & sliders to the backyard. This is a true horse property including a pole barn with 2+ stalls, tack room, arena, top electric fencing, two large paddocks with potential for expansion, four large pastures (three with water), chicken coop, and electricity throughout most of the property.  Additional features include two wells, two septic systems , 5,000-gallon water storage tank, tankless water heater, A/C w/ upgraded ducting, leased propane, owned and leased solar components and even a seasonal creek that accents the properties peaceful setting. Endless opportunity to live, ride, and roam—where luxury meets land, trails, and the timeless beauty of ranch living.

remarks: Meet your new favorite Silver Lake address. Brand-new ground-up construction at 2309 Cove Ave brings together striking modern architecture, serious square footage, incredible Downtown LA views, and an indoor-outdoor setup made for both everyday living and entertaining.   Just moments from the Silver Lake Reservoir, this 2026 construction offers 4 bedrooms, 4 bathrooms, and a remarkably flexible two-level floor plan.  The expansive living, dining, and kitchen area is framed by soaring 14-foot ceilings and a wall of multi-panel glass doors that open onto a private view balcony, creating an effortless connection between the interior and sweeping views of the Downtown LA skyline. The kitchen is a standout, with crisp flat-panel cabinetry, a dramatic gray stone backsplash, floating wood shelving, pot filler, built-in wine fridge, and a generous center island with bar seating.  The primary suite feels like its own private retreat, complete with a private balcony, oversized custom walk-in closet, and a beautifully finished bathroom with a double vanity, floor-to-ceiling marble-style tile, glass-enclosed shower, and deep soaking tub. Three additional bedrooms complete the home, with two bedrooms on each level, making it easy to create privacy.  A separate bonus space on the lower level adds even more possibilities, whether you need a home office, creative space, or want to add a kitchenette and create an almost entirely independent living area. The home also has laundry on both levels, adding an extra layer of everyday convenience.  And then there's the outdoor space. The lower level opens directly to a fully fenced private oasis with a bamboo-lined side yard, low-maintenance landscaping, built-in planter boxes, and a fire pit lounge. It's the perfect spot for morning coffee, an evening glass of wine, entertaining friends, or letting the dog have some room to roam; an unusually generous outdoor component for a home of this size.  Because this is a true ground-up 2026 build, everything is brand new, from the foundation and mechanical systems to the finishes and technology. Smart lighting, NEST thermostats, built-in Wi-Fi boosters, surround sound, integrated security with eight cameras, steel entry doors, tempered shatterproof glass, thermal insulation, and a wall-mounted iPad control station bring a decidedly modern layer to the home. The attached two-car garage features epoxy flooring, frosted glass doors, and EV charging.  Stylish without trying too hard, seriously spacious, and designed for the way people actually live, 2309 Cove Ave is a fresh take on Silver Lake living. Take the Mattachine Stairs directly down to the Silver Lake Reservoir, grab a drink at the iconic Red Lion Tavern, enjoy easy access to your local Whole Foods or honestly, just stay home and stare at those incredible views.

UNIQUE MIXED-USE OPPORTUNITY – TWO SEPARATE BUILDINGS ON ONE LOT! Located in Corona, this versatile property offers an excellent opportunity for an owner-user, investor, small business owner, or buyer looking to combine residential and commercial space at one convenient location.

The property features a 3-bedroom, 1-bath residential home along with a completely separate approximately 1,366-square-foot commercial building. The commercial building offers an open and flexible floor plan, its own restroom, and plenty of space to accommodate a variety of professional, office, retail, studio, showroom, or service-related uses, subject to City approval.

A major advantage is the property's dedicated street-front parking, including a designated ADA/handicap parking space, providing convenient access for customers, clients, employees, and visitors.

The two separate structures create tremendous flexibility. Live in the residence and operate your business next door, lease the residential and commercial spaces separately, or use the entire property for your own operations. The separation between the buildings allows each space to function independently while remaining on the same parcel.

Conveniently located in Corona with easy access to the 91 and 15 freeways, shopping, restaurants, and surrounding businesses. Properties offering a combination of residential and commercial improvements are difficult to find. Whether you're an investor looking for multiple potential income streams or a business owner who wants to own rather than rent, this property deserves a closer look.

Welcome to 3966 Laguna Blanca Drive, a rare opportunity to own a classic Hope Ranch estate that blends timeless Santa Barbara charm with exceptional potential. Privately set on just over an acre of lush, mature landscaping, this Spanish-style residence offers nearly 4,000 square feet of light-filled living space with serene garden and hillside views.

Built in 1970, the home combines authentic craftsmanship with the relaxed sophistication that defines Hope Ranch living. Vaulted wood-beamed ceilings, arched openings, and natural light create an inviting sense of warmth and space. The living room features a striking fireplace and opens to the outdoor terrace, while the formal dining room overlooks the pool and gardens. The kitchen and breakfast nook serve as the home’s comfortable hub and offer an ideal opportunity for modernization or full redesign.

The residence includes five bedrooms and four and a half baths, thoughtfully designed for privacy and easy flow. The primary suite enjoys vaulted ceilings, a generous en-suite bath, and views of the surrounding landscape. Several guest bedrooms open directly to the outdoors, creating flexibility for multi-generational living, guest quarters, or work-from-home setups. Throughout the interior, original details and quality construction offer a strong foundation for personalization and updates.

Outside, the property feels like a private retreat. A sparkling pool and spa are surrounded by patios, shaded sitting areas, and established gardens. The gently sloping lot allows room for potential expansion, such as a guesthouse, ADU, or enhanced outdoor living spaces. A three-car attached garage and broad motor court add convenience and ample parking.

In good condition and ready for a new vision, this home provides the perfect canvas—whether refreshed in its current style or transformed into a contemporary showpiece.

Hope Ranch offers a rare combination of privacy, prestige, and natural beauty. Residents enjoy 22 miles of equestrian and walking trails, a private beach with lifeguards and kayak storage, tennis courts, and 24-hour neighborhood security—all just minutes from La Cumbre Country Club, downtown Santa Barbara, and the coast.

3966 Laguna Blanca Drive is more than a home—it’s an opportunity to create a lasting estate in one of California’s most exclusive coastal communities, where the timeless beauty of Spanish architecture meets the enduring elegance of Hope Ranch living.

remarks: Perched on a promontory in the Riviera, one of Pacific Palisades' most coveted enclaves, this newer architectural residence captures the true character of its European namesake: light, air, and a horizon that never stops moving. The hillside setting delivers what the neighborhood is famous for and what few homes actually achieve, with nearly every room fronting the rolling Santa Monica Mountains as they spill into the Pacific. The house was designed around a single idea, that a home should feel like a permanent vacation. Nowhere is that clearer than on the main living level, where living room, dining area, and kitchen flow together beneath soaring ceilings and open through a disappearing wall of glass to a level grassy yard and an infinity pool that reads as though it pours straight into the ocean. Indoors and out become one room, and the yard becomes an extension of the living space rather than something to look at from behind a window. Evenings here are the reason people buy in the Riviera. The kitchen is built for both quiet mornings and large gatherings, anchored by an oversized island that keeps the cook in the conversation and the view in full frame. The primary suite occupies its own wing and lives like a residence unto itself, with a private office area, an oversized walk-in closet, a dedicated gym, and a spa bath positioned so the freestanding tub looks out to open water. It is a rare arrangement, one where a morning routine is measured in coastline rather than square footage. Secondary bedrooms are generously scaled, each with a walk-in closet and en-suite bath, accommodating family, guests, and staff without compromise. A commercial-grade elevator serves every level, so the full house lives as easily as a single floor, an uncommon and genuinely valuable feature on a hillside of this pitch. Materials are restrained and modern, polished concrete floors, stone, and expanses of glass chosen to frame the view rather than compete with it, and the level of finish reflects a build far more recent than most of what trades in the neighborhood. Beyond the gates, a world-class hiking and biking trailhead sits directly adjacent to the property, and the Riviera Country Club is just down the hill. The recently reopened Palisades Village, the bluffs, and the beach are a short drive, with Brentwood, Santa Monica, Beverly Hills, and the 405 all easily reached via Sunset Boulevard, an address that keeps the Westside within reach while feeling a world removed from it. The Riviera came through the January 2025 fire largely untouched, and the neighborhood remains almost fully intact.

remarks: Welcome to an exceptional opportunity in the sought after Sandpiper neighborhood of Aviara. Offered for the first time on the resale market since being purchased new from Warmington Homes, this beautifully maintained Lagoon Plan 4 residence offers approximately 2,806 square feet, five bedrooms, three full baths and a three car garage with 220V outlet. Thoughtfully cared for by its original owners and updated over the years, the home combines a highly functional floor plan with a wonderfully peaceful setting. Situated on a quiet cul-de-sac and well removed from busy road noise, the property enjoys a generous, private, pool sized backyard along with attractive front landscaping, including turf and fresh plantings that create a welcoming first impression. Inside, spacious living areas provide an inviting setting for both everyday living and entertaining. A full bedroom and full bath on the main level offer excellent flexibility for guests, multigenerational living or a private home office. Hardwood flooring adds warmth and character throughout portions of the home, complemented by recently installed carpeting, fresh interior paint and updated LED flush mount lighting for a clean and refreshed feel. The kitchen has been enhanced with new quartz countertops, while the downstairs full bath features a new quartz countertop and newly remodeled shower. Primary bath includes custom vanity with granite countertops and  new large format porcelain tile flooring. The centrally located kitchen connects easily with the breakfast nook, dining and family room spaces, while the overall floor plan provides an appealing balance of openness and separation. Upstairs are four additional bedrooms, including the spacious primary suite and a notably generous fifth bedroom, offering even more flexibility for family, guests, hobbies or work from home needs. Beyond the home itself, Aviara offers one of coastal Carlsbad's most distinctive lifestyles. Numerous nearby trails wind through the community and toward beautiful Batiquitos Lagoon, providing wonderful opportunities for walking, hiking and enjoying the natural surroundings. At the heart of Aviara is the AAA Five Diamond Park Hyatt Aviara Resort, Golf Club & Spa, where eligible Aviara homeowners enjoy select resident benefits. The community is also home to the renowned Arnold Palmer designed Aviara Golf Club, along with exceptional dining, spa and recreational experiences. Aviara is served by the acclaimed Carlsbad Unified School District, with Aviara Oaks Elementary and Aviara Oaks Middle School conveniently located within the community. Beaches, shopping, dining and the coastal communities of Carlsbad and Encinitas are all just minutes away. With five bedrooms, three full baths, a three car garage, a downstairs bedroom and full bath, a generous private yard and an exceptionally quiet cul de sac location, this lovingly maintained original owner home offers a rare combination of space, privacy and the signature Aviara lifestyle.

remarks: The lowest-priced condo in 90013 and one of Downtown LA's best values. Unit 231 is priced aggressively for a timely sale as the owners relocate back to the East Coast. Located inside the historic Little Tokyo Lofts, originally built for the Westinghouse Electric Company and converted to residences in 2007, this spacious live/work studio combines industrial architecture with a clean, flexible layout made for living, working, and creating. Tucked quietly within the building, the loft features approx. 12-foot ceilings, hardwood floors, white walls, and thoughtful built-in storage for an open, gallery-like feel. Dual entry provides access from both the interior hallway and landscaped courtyard, with a small private outdoor area adjacent to the unit. Stainless steel appliances, Murphy bed, projector, and additional storage are included. Little Tokyo Lofts offers 24-hour gated security, a heated pool and spa, a fitness center, BBQ and lounge areas, a dog run, and bike storage. Unit 231 includes one assigned parking space conveniently located near the elevator, plus approximately 25 guest parking spaces. HOA dues include water, gas, and sanitation. Close to Little Tokyo, the Arts District and Gallery Row, with restaurants, museums, galleries, shopping and entertainment nearby. At this price, Unit 231 offers a rare opportunity to own a distinctive historic loft in Downtown Los Angeles.
