remarks:
Welcome to 8 Del Rey — a beautifully reimagined home in the heart of Irvine that has been redesigned with today's buyer in mind. Every surface, system, and finish has been thoughtfully upgraded, so all that's left to do is move in. Soaring vaulted ceilings and an open, light-filled floor plan set the tone the moment you walk through the door, with wide-plank flooring flowing seamlessly from the entry through the main living spaces. This is the largest of the floor plans in Turtle Rock Pointe.

The heart of the home is a stunning great room anchored by a floor-to-ceiling stacked-stone fireplace, opening effortlessly to a dedicated dining area framed by an arched picture window and sliding glass doors that pour in natural light and frame views of the lush, park-like greenbelt beyond to Strawberry Farms. The chef's kitchen is outfitted with a professional-grade six-burner range and hood, sleek two-tone cabinetry, quartz countertops, a full-height tile backsplash, and a large center island with bar seating — all designed for effortless entertaining.

A striking wood-and-iron contemporary staircase leads to a private upstairs landing and generously sized bedrooms, including a serene primary suite with vaulted ceilings, oversized windows, and a spa-inspired en-suite bath featuring a freestanding soaking tub, frameless glass shower, and dual-sink vanity. Additional bedrooms offer flexible space for family, guests, or a home office, and a well-appointed hall bath complete the upper level.

This home's remodel goes well beyond the surface: brand-new HVAC system, all-new dual-pane windows and sliders throughout, and a newly tiled patio ready for outdoor dining and relaxing evenings. Located in a sought-after community with access to an HOA pool and spa, and just minutes from University Town Center, UC Irvine, top-rated schools, shopping, and dining — 8 Del Rey offers the rare combination of a true turnkey remodel in an unbeatable Irvine location.

remarks:
A private hillside estate where panoramic views, exceptional space, and resort-style amenities come together. Perched high in Panorama Heights, this distinctive North Tustin residence captures sweeping 180-degree vistas stretching from the Newport Beach coastline toward Los Angeles, creating an ever-changing backdrop from daytime views to spectacular sunsets and sparkling city lights.
Set on over half an acre, the 6-bedroom, 6-bath estate offers more than 5,400 square feet designed for both everyday living and memorable entertaining. Double doors introduce the home, where multiple living spaces unfold across the hillside. The gourmet kitchen features stainless steel appliances, gas cooktop, double ovens, beverage cooler, apron-front sink, generous center island, and casual dining area, with a nearby wet bar serving the surrounding entertaining spaces.
At the heart of the home, an expansive family and dining area is wrapped in a dramatic curved wall of windows, bringing the views into the architecture itself and opening the home to its remarkable setting.
Five bedrooms are en-suite, including a spacious primary retreat with its own curved wall of windows, fireplace and sunken sitting area, wraparound terrace, and a bright primary bath with soaking tub, walk-in shower, and dual vanities. An elevator connects the garage with the principal living and bedroom levels, while a sauna and several flexible rooms provide space for a home office, fitness studio, creative pursuits, or additional needs.
Outside, the property takes on the feel of a private resort. Expansive terraces and view decks overlook the newly refinished pool and spa, generous poolside entertaining areas, and a pool house with full bath. A newly resurfaced full-size lighted tennis and pickleball court completes the setting—an increasingly rare amenity in a private residence.
Whether gathering around the pool, playing an evening match, entertaining against a sunset backdrop, or simply enjoying the privacy and views, this is a property created to be experienced.
12286 Circula Panorama offers a rare combination of scale, privacy, recreation, and commanding Southern California views—an exceptional estate in the hills of North Tustin.

Perfect as a 2nd home, retirement retreat, or base for hunting. With the advent of StarLink, you can work remote and avoid the commute while being in serene surroundings. The possibilities are endless!

remarks: Attention all Golfers! Need extra storage or a parking space for your golf cart? This home is also Known as 8446 Valle Vista Place. A story of a home waiting to welcome you. The house sits at the edge of a friendly cul-de-sac, where morning light drifts through the windows like a gentle hello. Inside, 1742 square feet of comfortable living unfold as a quiet, inviting chapter just begging to be written by you. A generous, open feel that guides you from entry to everyday living with ease. The Flow of Comfort from the moment you step in, the house invites you to linger through roomy, brightly lit rooms that encourage conversation and calm. The thoughtful layout that supports cozy evenings and effortless entertaining alike. This two-story condo with 3 bedrooms, 2 baths, double front doors and with a beautiful entryway for receiving guests. The primary suite includes a walk-in closet, two sinks, a private step-in shower, and a toilet room. Also includes a sliding glass door to the back patio. The guest rooms are quite large and have large closets for clothing and storage. Also, they feature carpet and ceiling fans for comfort. The laundry area is near the bedrooms and supplies large a storage area. The extra closets and linen cabinets make for great storage. The large living room with high ceilings and has several windows for natural light. This includes a wet bar in the living room and a gas fireplace to enhance your entertaining experience. The large dining room has space to accommodate family and friends with a patio/balcony outside for extended social space. This is a great area to start your day with coffee or unwind after the day. This kitchen has ample cabinets for storage and sufficient countertops for food prep and is complete with dishwasher, stove, and microwave. Along with a window over the sink for bright and natural light. The private golf course, Red Hill Country Club in the neighborhood includes golf, a golf practice facility, tennis courts, pickle ball, and swimming pool. There is also a community pool and spa for sun and fun. Parking is never an issue with a two-car garage plus a separate garage for a golf cart. The large driveway with space for guest parking. Condo was painted and reroofed in 2018. HVAC system is approximately 2 years old.

Enjoy all that The Preserve at Chino has to offer, with convenient access to community amenities, parks, schools, shopping, dining, and major freeways.

remarks: There's something rare about a home that feels both rooted in its landscape and ahead of its time. This mid-century modern gem in Twentynine Palms delivers exactly that 2,100+ square feet of architectural soul sitting on 1.44 acres of high desert serenity, just 5 minutes from both downtown and the north entrance of Joshua Tree National Park. Inside, the home strikes a balance between warmth and wow. Polished concrete floors anchor the space while walls of glass pull the outside in think golden-hour light spilling across open living areas and framing those iconic desert mountain views. Two fireplaces give the home a cozy, intimate feel no matter the season. The kitchen is a genuine gathering spot, thoughtfully designed with a built-in dining table and window seating that make everything from slow weekend breakfasts to dinner parties feel effortless. Step outside and the property opens up beautifully. The fully fenced grounds are both private and full of personality 7 Manzanilla olive trees, citrus, native desert flora, and a patio built for lingering with a firepit, built-in BBQ, and smoker ready for action. The mountain backdrop doesn't hurt either. A 2-car garage and shop round out the practicality, while the space itself sparks imagination a future pool, a creative studio, a thriving short-term rental. The possibilities here are genuinely wide open. There are solar panels that allow low expense during the months and year to create more income and less expense! They can be paid for or bought outright! Three bedrooms, two bathrooms, and a location that puts one of the world's most beloved national parks at your fingertips. Whether you're chasing adventure, creative solitude, or a smart investment in one of the desert's most sought-after communities this one checks every box.

remarks: Timeless charm meets a truly rare setting at this four-bedroom townhome overlooking the iconic San Luis Rey Training Center, where the daily rhythm of morning horse training creates a one-of-a-kind backdrop. Located within the private, gated community of The Terraces, residents enjoy beautifully maintained grounds and access to two sparkling community pools.  A formal gated courtyard entry welcomes you into a light-filled residence defined by soaring vaulted wood-beam ceilings, expansive windows, and an open-concept layout that feels both warm and airy. The living and dining areas flow effortlessly toward the rear of the home, where walls of glass frame sweeping green views of the track and surrounding hills.  The updated kitchen blends charm and function, featuring generous cabinetry, ample counter space, and a picture-window vantage point overlooking the racetrack—perfect for morning coffee or casual entertaining. Just beyond, a large open-air deck spans the rear of the townhome, offering front-row views of the training grounds and an ideal space for dining, relaxing, or simply enjoying the serene, ever-changing scenery.  The primary suite is privately situated upstairs, creating a peaceful retreat with separation from the rest of the home. Downstairs, three additional bedrooms provide flexibility for guests, family, or creative use, complemented by an additional office or flex space ideal for working from home, hobbies, or overflow living.  With its architectural character, vaulted ceilings, indoor-outdoor living, and one of the most unique views in North County, this residence offers a relaxed yet elevated Bonsall lifestyle—something truly special and rarely available.

remarks: Perched high within the legendary hills of Trousdale Estates, where architecture becomes art and the horizon feels endless, a residence conceived by visionary architect Harry Gesner takes form. Bold, sculptural, and unmistakable, 624 Cole Place is a master expression of mid-century modern design, positioned to capture panoramic jetliner views from Beverly Hills to Catalina Island and across the valley. From arrival, the home emerges from the hillside with quiet authority. Signature rooflines soar overhead, and walls of glass dissolve into the horizon as natural light moves freely from dawn to dusk. Gesner believed architecture should live in conversation with nature, and here the skyline becomes a permanent part of the interior experience. Each space unfolds with intention, offering its own perspective and relationship to the view. From intimate corners to grand entertaining spaces, the city reveals itself in layers, constantly shifting, always spectacular. Daily living becomes cinematic. Hosting feels effortless. Even silence feels elevated. Outside, expansive terraces float above the landscape, while the pool provides a front-row seat to Los Angeles by day and a glittering sea of lights by night. It is Southern California indoor-outdoor living at its most refined. Offered for the first time in over two decades, the residence reflects a level of architecture that tends to be held, not traded.

remarks: Experience elevated desert living in this beautifully upgraded, move-in ready home designed for effortless indoor-outdoor living. From the moment you arrive, the extensive custom paver hardscaping set the tone for a low-maintenance yet highly refined outdoor environment.The backyard is a true private retreat, showcasing a saltwater pool and spa with a stunning flagstone beach entry-creating a rare, resort-inspired setting perfect for both relaxation and entertaining. An outdoor shower with handheld fixture, set against a striking stacked-stone wall, adds a spa-like touch, while professionally designed landscaping features mature palm and citrus trees, including Meyer lemon and lime, and ambient lighting for magical desert evenings. A remote-controlled retractable awning provides shaded comfort, allowing you to enjoy the space year-round. Inside, the home is thoughtfully upgraded for both comfort and style, featuring wide-plank laminate flooring throughout (no carpet), crown molding, LED recessed lighting and surround sound speakers in the great room. Natural light fills the home through well-placed solar tubes in the kitchen, laundry and primary closet, enhancing the bright and welcoming atmosphere.The kitchen is designed to impress with quartz counters, full-height 42-inch cabinetry, an upgraded tile backsplash, and stainless steel KitchenAid appliances-perfectly blending functionality with modern design.The primary suite offers a peaceful retreat with a sliding glass door providing direct access to the pool and backyard, along with a barn door entry to the en-suite bath.  Additional features include custom wood shutters, room-darkening window treatments and ceiling fans throughout.Practical upgrades provide peace of mind, including a newer Lennox HVAC system (approx. 2 years old), a tankless water heater (approx. 1 year old), and a mini-split system in the garage-ideal for added comfort and flexibility.  The garage is equally well appointed with epoxy finished flooring and overhead storage.This home seamlessly combines modern upgrades, energy efficiency and a resort-style outdoor living-offering the ultimate desert lifestyle. Residents of Sun City Shadow Hills enjoy resort-style amenities including golf, clubhouses, fitness centers, pools, tennis, pickleball, dining, and a vibrant social lifestyle--all with low HOA dues.

remarks: Beautifully maintained 5-bedroom, 3-bathroom custom home on a private 3-acre lot in a quiet cul de sac. Fully remodeled in 2015 with a two-bedroom and one-bathroom addition completed in 2024, the interior features an open-concept living area and vaulted ceilings. The kitchen features timeless shaker cabinetry and concrete countertops, with a 16-foot island, a walk-in pantry, two farmhouse sinks, and two dishwashers. Outside, the property includes a 650-square-foot wraparound Trex deck, a two-door metal shop, and a newly built pole barn. The land is fully fenced and cross-fenced for livestock, featuring a custom gabled entry gate, a secondary gate for RV or boat parking, and a large deer-fenced terraced garden. The Calaveras River is located at the end of the court, and the property has two seasonal creeks, making wild deer and turkey frequent visitors. Located minutes from town, La Contenta Golf Course, and New Hogan Lake, the home offers hilltop privacy minutes from town amenities. All appliances are included in the sale.

remarks: ONE OF ONE. OVER ONE ACRE. ONE HOUSE. ONE LOCATION. THERE ARE NO OTHERS THAT COMPARE.  Exclusive coastal retreat tucked away on one of the most coveted streets in Encinitas, this private sanctuary feels like every day is a vacation. Framed by ocean and golf course views, along with unforgettable sunsets that melt into the horizon, completed in 2022 this custom-built modern masterpiece was thoughtfully designed to bring warmth, sophistication, and effortless living together in perfect balance.  Inside, every space was curated with intention — where clean architectural lines meet rich textures and natural light pours through expansive windows, creating an atmosphere that feels both elevated and inviting. The primary suite, privately positioned in its own wing serves as a peaceful sanctuary with a spa like bath featuring a soaking tub, walk-in shower, dual vanities, and an oversized walk-in closet. While two additional en-suite bedrooms provide comfort and privacy for family and guests alike. A spacious office or optional fourth bedroom filled with natural light offers flexibility to fit a variety of functionality.  At the heart of this home the chefs kitchen, overlooks the pool and is appointed for both daily living and entertaining; featuring an oversized island with seating, wine fridge, and premium Thermador appliances including a built-in refrigerator/freezer, 6-burner range with griddle, and double ovens with a steam oven. Folding glass doors span both sides of the great room, creating seamless indoor-outdoor living. The floor-plan is designed for both intimate living and grand entertaining blending modern convenience with timeless design.  Outside, the experience becomes even more captivating. This home is designed to embrace the natural rhythm of the day. Open the eastern side of the home in the morning to enjoy serene views and warm sunrise light by the pool, then in the evening transition to the western side to take in glowing ocean view sunsets and cool coastal breezes. A resort-inspired pool with an oversized Baja shelf and integrated spa invites long afternoons in the sun, while the outdoor kitchen complete with a 48” built-in grill and refrigerator creates the perfect setting for effortless entertaining. As the evening cools, gather around the outdoor fireplace and take in the glow of the sunset as the ocean breeze rolls through.  Adding to the property’s versatility is a beautifully appointed 2-bedroom, 2-bath pool house/ADU, thoughtfully designed for effortless indoor-outdoor living and entertaining. Expansive glass doors open the main living area directly to the pool area, creating a seamless connection between the indoor spaces and outdoor retreat. Complete with a full kitchen, open-concept living area, and convenient exterior-access bathroom door for pool guests, this guest house is ideal for entertaining, multigenerational living, hosting guests, or additional income potential.

remarks: 421 Escobar St is a custom-designed home rebuilt in 2003. The rare 5BD/4BA floor plan includes 3 private suites: a ground-level 1BD/1BA suite, one additional upstairs suite, and a 750 sqft primary retreat with jacuzzi tub, oversized shower stall, generous vanity space, and excellent storage. Thoughtful bedroom zoning supports multi-generational living, guests, WFH needs, or kids at different ages, including two upstairs secondary bedrooms connected by an optional interior door. The main level offers a vaulted front living room, separate media room with fireplace, formal dining room, breakfast area, and a large kitchen with oversized granite island, abundant cabinetry, and high-end Thermador, Miele, and Monogram appliances. Solid wood French doors, a wrought-iron curved staircase, and layered recessed lighting add warmth and quality. Additional features include a long-lasting tile roof, two AC systems serving upstairs/downstairs, built-in projector wiring with custom screen, smart bath fixtures, lit walk-in storage, closet systems, finished epoxy garage, and overhead storage. Outdoors: fountain courtyard, covered patio, turf, stone landscaping, roses and fruit trees. Walkable to MSJ Elementary and Stratford; minutes to MSJ High, BASIS, Central Park, Mission Peak, 680 and 880.

A dramatic staircase with custom railing and designer chandeliers sets the tone at the entry, opening into light-filled living and dining spaces. The chef's kitchen is the heart of the home, featuring quartzite countertops, marble tile, and a full suite of GE Monogram and Bosch appliances, alongside a custom-built wine bar with dual-zone wine fridge, the kind of space made for slow mornings and long evenings alike. remarks:
OWNED SOLAR, a low-maintenance yard, and thoughtful energy-efficient upgrades make this spacious home an exceptional find. Designed with room for everyone, the floor plan includes a convenient main-floor bedroom and full bath. Abundant natural light fills the home, highlighted by a vaulted entry and 9-foot ceilings throughout the main level.

Luxury vinyl plank flooring, trimmed with 5-1/4-inch baseboards, keeps heavy-traffic areas neat and tidy. The open-concept kitchen features sleek White Sand quartz countertops, beech cabinetry with an ebony stain, a reverse osmosis system, a 2022 Bosch dishwasher, and a generous pantry.

Energy efficiency was top of mind with upgrades including OWNED SOLAR, a tankless water heater, dual-pane low-E windows, a cool roof with radiant barrier decking, redundant fiber optics, and pre-plumbing for EV charging in the garage. Additional features include a Culligan water softener, Graber top-down/bottom-up blinds, and a whole-house fan.

Outside, the low-maintenance yard offers easy upkeep, allowing more time to enjoy all this home and its location have to offer. Just around the corner from Hartley Park and DeGarmo Park, you'll have convenient access to parks, playgrounds, and ballfields, along with exciting nearby developments such as Beyond Golf and the upcoming Chico Aquatics and Recreation Center.  Comfort, efficiency, flexibility, and easy outdoor living come together in a home designed to make everyday life a little easier.

remarks: A rare opportunity in one of East Oakland’s most strategically positioned corridors. This 3 bedroom, 1 bath home sits on a large, entirely usable lot with a backyard garden and entertainment space framed by sweeping views of Oakland and the Bay Area — downtown Oakland, the Bay Bridge, and the Golden Gate Bridge all from your own yard. Mature fruit trees, generous storage throughout, and a two-car garage round out the practical side. A separate private entrance opens up significant ADU potential for multigenerational living, guest quarters, or additional income. Buyer to verify all development possibilities with the City of Oakland. The location puts you at the center of Oakland’s next chapter. The long-planned Oak Knoll development is moving forward at the former Naval hospital site off Mountain Boulevard — 918 homes plus a village center with retail, restaurants, and open space. New commercial and multifamily construction is reshaping the Bancroft Avenue and 73rd Avenue corridor. And the 112-acre Coliseum complex is in the process of transferring to a development group with plans for housing, retail, and entertainment. The Oakland Zoo and Knowland Park are minutes away, with Anthony Chabot Regional Park, Lake Chabot Golf Course, and miles of East Bay Regional Park trails just up the road. Mills College at Northeastern University, Merritt College, and Holy Names are all nearby, along with Eastmont Town Center, Lincoln Square and Montclair Village for everyday shopping. Open House Saturday 9/19 at 11-1pm.

remarks: Make a smart move with this turnkey Duplex in the up-and-coming Wilmore district of Long Beach. Live in one unit and rent out the other to cut your mortgage payment in half and reap the benefits of becoming a new landlord or add an impressive R-4 property to your existing portfolio. Each unit comes with a two-car garage, as well as a tandem parking space off the alley. There are numerous upgrades, including a new roof, complete exterior stucco, dual-pane windows, keyless entry doors, two water heaters, fresh landscaping with a 6-foot white vinyl fence, exterior and interior painting, and three TCL brand mini-split systems per unit. Inside, you’ll enjoy vaulted ceilings, SPC oak floors by Republic, baseboards, modern chandeliers, and wall sconces. The back unit features high-end stainless-steel appliances and includes a washer and dryer, as well as a wall-mounted television. The kitchens boast Knotty Alderwood cabinetry, high-end Acacia butcher block counters, a 3D tile backsplash, a stainless-steel sink, dishwasher, microwave, and recessed lighting. Finally, the bathroom is outfitted with beautiful veinous Carrera marble and a floating vanity featuring an LED mirror with a built-in defogger. It makes sense to buy two completely renovated units, with the potential to add more, rather than being stuck with just one, as a home should always be considered an investment that holds the key to your future.

remarks:
Welcome to Unit 220 at Country Club Condominiums, where Sherman Oaks living reaches its full potential at a wonderful value. At 904 square feet, this is the largest one-bedroom floor plan in the building, complete with a bonus den perfectly suited to a home office, creative studio, or flexible space of your own design.

Sliding glass doors draw natural light into the open living area and lead out to a private balcony, screened by a bamboo hedge for a rare and welcome sense of seclusion. The remodeled kitchen, finished with quartz countertops and crisp cabinetry, flows seamlessly into a dedicated dining area, equally suited to quiet nights in or effortless entertaining. The bedroom offers a true retreat from the day, while the bathroom has been reimagined with a clean, modern finish. An in-unit washer/dryer and updated central heat and air complete the picture: a home that is entirely turn-key.

Tucked toward the rear of the building's second wing, the unit enjoys added privacy and quiet, along with one assigned parking space and ample guest parking. The building itself is professionally managed, with an on-site maintenance crew, pool, gym, and recreation room rounding out the amenities.
And then there's the location: a quiet, residential street just steps from Ventura Blvd, placing the neighborhood's finest restaurants, cafés, and shopping within easy reach. A polished, low-maintenance home in one of Sherman Oaks' most sought-after pockets.

remarks: Silver Lake Living Has Never Been More Attainable. Welcome to 2348 Ewing Street! Tucked behind private gates at the rear of a beautifully maintained four-unit complex, this tranquil, modern townhome-style condominium is a quiet, well-kept secret  and it's been waiting for you. Rare among its kind, the complex features four fully stand-alone structures with no shared walls, offering the privacy of a single-family home with the ease of condo living.At 2,636 square feet, this striking split-level residence makes an immediate impression. Enter through a private, secluded outdoor patio into a gracious mezzanine overlooking a breathtaking, light-filled living room below. Soaring fourteen-foot ceilings and a gas-burning fireplace anchor the space, while sliding glass doors open to mature trees and a lush, landscaped backyard  with wonderful potential to add a deck or screened-in porch. The generous eat-in kitchen and dining area, equally bathed in natural light, offers seamless flow perfect for entertaining or cozy everyday living, with its own sliding glass doors opening to the same serene outdoor space. A tucked-away hall leads to in-unit laundry and a lovely powder room. All three bedrooms are thoughtfully situated together on the upper floor. The large, bright primary bedroom is a true retreat, featuring an ensuite bath, a spacious walk-in closet, and a sliding glass door to a Juliet balcony. The second equally spacious bedroom enjoys its own private balcony and generous closet space. Both it and the third light-filled bedroom - ideal as a nursery or home office - share a well-appointed Jack-and-Jill ensuite bathroom with dual sinks. A two-car garage and abundant storage round out this wonderfully livable floor plan, all with a remarkably low $150/month HOA. Just moments away from the Silver Lake Reservoir, the Dog Park, and the beloved Mattachine Stairs. Silver Lake Village's eclectic boutiques - OK, Lake, and The Velvet Poppy - and celebrated dining destinations - LA Mill, Botanica, L&E Oyster Bar, and Bar Besito - are all within easy reach, along with top-tier fitness at Sapphire Pilates and the Silver Lake Recreation Center. 2348 Ewing is much more than a condo. It's your next home!

remarks: Reduced $500,000 and ready for your offers. This is the least expensive single-family move-in ready home   on Point Dume with a beach key offered at this time. Tucked behind private gates in coveted Point Dume, this sparkling single-level modern residence captures the essence of the Malibu beach lifestyle with rare access to one of the area's most treasured amenities - a deeded beach key to Little Dume Beach. Finished in 2020 by its current owners and curated by ERW Design, the home blends warm modern minimalism with an intentional focus on elevated coastal living and elemental resistance. Bathed in natural light, the open-concept interiors are framed by walls of tempered glass that dissolve the line between indoors and out, overlooking serene park-like grounds and a private courtyard designed for effortless indoor-outdoor living. Stained concrete and European white oak floors, custom white oak built-ins, and thoughtfully selected luxury finishes create a refined yet relaxed atmosphere that feels distinctly Malibu. The chef's kitchen pairs clean contemporary design with exceptional functionality, opening seamlessly to the living and dining spaces anchored by a dramatic fireplace. The tranquil primary suite evokes a boutique resort retreat, opening to a private beach-inspired patio complete with an outdoor shower and sitting area. A spa-like primary bath features a dual vanity and a sunlit wet room with soaking tub and shower, while a custom-built closet adds both elegance and practicality. Two additional guest suites enjoy oversized windows and peaceful garden views, while a versatile bonus space functions beautifully as a gathering room, office, gym, or creative studio with storage and laundry area. The property includes City of Malibu Administrative Plan Review Approval for a 13' x 45' pool and spa with deck and associated development, offering a rare opportunity to further enhance the home's inviting outdoor experience and create an exceptional private coastal retreat. Beyond its sophisticated design, the residence was rebuilt with a comprehensive approach to long-term fire resilience and modern coastal durability. Thoughtfully engineered after the Woolsey Fire, the property incorporates a layered system of protective features that complement the home's organic coastal aesthetic. Offering the rare combination of modern design, thoughtful resilience, walking distance to shops and restaurants, and coveted Little Dume beach access - this residence represents an exceptional opportunity to experience the relaxed luxury and enduring lifestyle that define Point Dume living.

remarks: In the heart of the Santa Monica Mountains, where the only sound is wind through the trees, lies Paradise Lodge, a fully reimagined 2.1-acre Topanga estate and a study in Rustic Modernism: utilitarian, elegant, and rooted in its rugged surroundings. Completed as all-new construction in 2021 by architect Steven Fernandez AIA, its design carries the lineage of Richard Neutra, Edward Niles, and Frank Gehry. The property is arranged in two distinct areas across its 2.1 usable acres: the three-bedroom main house at the top, and a lower area with separate street access consisting of a one-bedroom ADU, a workshop, and a restored one-bedroom Spartan trailer. A tree-lined private road brings you to a large rolling gate and an extra-wide circular drive that gives a true sense of arrival. At the top of the property, the main house opens to light-filled, open-plan living, floor-to-ceiling Fleetwood glass, and a see-through fireplace of steel, board-form concrete, and Yosemite stone that warms the living room and poolside lounge at once. The chef's kitchen carries Wolf, Sub-Zero, and Bosch appliances and passes through to an outdoor prep station and grill. A ground-floor bedroom with its own outdoor entrance and ensuite works easily as a guest room or office. Upstairs, two ensuite bedrooms sit among the treetops. The primary is a treehouse in all but name, its private Ipe deck set into the canopy of a mature ash, open to a wide view of the hillsides. Outside, a PebbleTec saltwater pool is ringed by fruit trees, with sunset and canyon views beyond, a setting so striking that it has been featured in global campaigns for Mercedes-Benz and Lexus. The gardens were shaped by landscape designer Suzanne McKevitt with an earth-first, drought-tolerant approach. Charming garden paths meander through the intentionally landscaped grounds, planted with fruit-bearing trees including Fuji apples, Sumo mandarins, and Meyer lemons. The pathways create a tranquil connection down to the lower area, set well apart from the main house. There, a 650-square-foot ADU offers a lofted bedroom with ensuite bath, its own outdoor sitting area built from a converted shipping container, and strong income potential as a rental or guest suite. Beside it, a workshop with 25-foot ceilings is well suited to an artist's studio or recording space. Nearby, the restored 1950s Spartan trailer keeps its own private setting and outdoor bathroom, a retreat under the stars. Together they form a self-contained artist's retreat and bring the estate to a functional five bedrooms and six baths. The estate is wildfire-hardened, clad in DensGlass sheathing and corrugated steel, with an exterior sprinkler system, on-site fire hydrants, and a whole-property backup generator. Located in one of Topanga's most accessible neighborhoods, a place where time seems to have stood still in the best way, the estate has miles of pristine trails for hiking and biking through the Santa Monica Mountains from the front door. The Topanga Farmers Market and Will Geer's Theatricum Botanicum sit about half a mile away, the property is in a desirable school district, and Malibu is 20 minutes out, Calabasas 15, and the Westside 30.

remarks:
Charming Lake Arrowhead Retreat with Lake Rights & Peek-a-Boo Views!
Ideally located in the heart of Lake Arrowhead, this inviting mountain home offers a rare combination of convenience, charm, and value. Enjoy a peek-a-boo lake view and walk to the lake in under 5 minutes, or reach the Village in less than 10—perfect for dining, shopping, and year-round activities.
This turnkey property includes full lake rights and comes mostly furnished (seller to provide an inclusion list), making it ready for immediate enjoyment or rental potential. The home features 3 bedrooms and 3 bathrooms (one bathroom unpermitted), including a convenient main-level bedroom and two upstairs bedrooms. The spacious living room showcases soaring beamed ceilings, rich hardwood floors, and a stunning limestone wood-burning fireplace, creating the perfect cozy mountain atmosphere. The renovated kitchen is equipped with modern appliances and soft ambient lighting, flowing seamlessly into the dining area where a large table comfortably seats eight—ideal for entertaining family and friends. Upstairs, you’ll find two bathrooms, including one with an oversized soaking tub—perfect for unwinding after a day on the lake or trails. A dedicated laundry room with washer and dryer adds everyday convenience.
Additional highlights include:
Parking for up to 4 vehicles
Unfinished build-up area for ample storage
Recently added tiered retaining wall, creating usable outdoor space for gardening, relaxing, or entertaining
With its unbeatable location, lake rights, and move-in-ready condition, this home is an exceptional opportunity to own a piece of Lake Arrowhead at a great value.

remarks:
Welcome to the guard-gated 55+ community of Terramor in Temescal Valley. Situated at the end of a quiet cul-de-sac on just shy of 11,000 sq. ft. lot, this expansive IronTree II model, the largest of its kind, offers one of the neighborhood's most private and generous homesites. Featuring 2 bedrooms + an office that can be used as a 3rd bedroom (buyer to install closet), 2 upgraded bathrooms, over 1,900 sq. ft. of thoughtfully designed living space, the home blends comfort and function.

The open-concept floor plan features soaring 10-foot ceilings, a striking 10-foot quartz kitchen island, thick quartz countertops, a farmhouse sink, fresh Designer Flat White interior paint, paid solar, an epoxy-coated two-car garage, and an extended driveway with parking for up to six vehicles.

The property is embraced by nature with surrounding hillsides, seasonal winter greenery, wildflowers, hummingbirds by day, and owls at night. Morning sunlight fills the home from the east while northern exposure provides afternoon shade.

The home is positioned with its back facing the ascending hills, offering sweeping skies and sunset views toward the Santa Ana Mountains. Sitting approximately four feet higher and five feet farther back into the lot than neighboring homes, it enjoys natural light, added privacy, and unobstructed views.

The property also includes numerous fire safety and resilience features, including a modern tile fire-retardant roof, an upgraded indoor fire sprinkler system with steel piping, an exterior fire hose spigot, and a fire hydrant located approximately 20 feet from the home. The adjacent emergency access road is designated exclusively for fire department use and serves as a fire access route, creating a quiet dead-end setting with no through traffic. Additional exterior features include brick perimeter walls and Terramor's community water storage system. The current homeowner paid under $1,001.15 annually for homeowners insurance during the last three years.

Residents of Terramor enjoy resort-style amenities including indoor and outdoor pools, a clubhouse with a bar and entertainment lounge, fitness center, spa, sauna, pickleball, tennis and bocce courts, fire pits, craft and game rooms, a community garden, scenic walking trails, dog parks, and additional recreational spaces.

remarks:
Where Coastal Living Finds Its Rhythm

There's a rhythm to 1216 Vista Cantora, felt before it's named. This renovation didn't just chase beauty. It chased ease, the kind that lets a home fade into the background of your life so all that's left is the living.

Walk in, and the light softens against Chantilly Lace walls, warmed by engineered hardwood running room to room. Solid-core doors close with quiet weight; satin-nickel hardware catches the eye without asking for it. In the main living room, a fireplace wrapped in fluted concrete-look tile and crowned with a new mantle holds court, not loud, just present. Beyond it, sliding doors part wide enough that the pool and ocean seem to lean into the room.

The kitchen is where the house exhales. White double-Shaker cabinetry frames the perimeter, while a natural oak island anchors the center, warm, sturdy, made for gathering. Quartz counters catch the pendant light, and a vertically stacked backsplash adds quiet texture. A full Thermador suite, 36-inch range, panel-ready refrigerator, hood insert, dishwasher, waits for whatever you're in the mood to make.

Upstairs, the primary bath feels like a pause button: oak cabinetry, marble underfoot, quartz surfaces, champagne-bronze fixtures, dual showers. Just beyond it, the walk-in closet holds an open invitation, room for an island, jewelry display, dedicated lighting,  a dressing space waiting to become entirely its own.

Some of the best parts of this home you'll never see, but you'll feel them daily. A Lennox Elite system keeps the air just right through every season. A Navien tankless heater means hot water arrives the moment you ask. An EcoWater system works quietly behind the walls, protecting pipes and fixtures for years to come. Smart Thermador connectivity and an LG Sensor Dry laundry system round out a home that runs smoothly, mostly out of sight.

Then there's the yard, wood decking underfoot, a pool catching the afternoon light, landscaping that feels considered rather than manicured, and room enough for a dinner, a celebration, or nothing at all.

This isn't just a house with an ocean view. It's a place built quietly, thoughtfully, for the way life should feel,  unhurried, well-lit, and always a few steps from the water.

Among the many amenities to this property is a large green house, a 588 sq. ft. garage with a dry steam sauna located in the back of the garage. This property is zoned for animals, and has a circular driveway. The list goes on and on and is a must see property.

remarks: Set behind a private gate above Sunset Plaza, this reimagined mid-century residence pairs classic California modernism with the refined architectural vision of internationally acclaimed architect Dan Brunn, AIA. Sculptural curves, soaring ceilings, wide-plank white oak floors, and expansive walls of glass create a seamless connection between the interiors, grounds, and sweeping jetliner views. The chef's kitchen, family room, and primary suite are oriented toward the lawn and pool, filling the interiors with natural light and framing the city beyond. The private quarters include a serene primary suite and three additional en suite bedrooms, offering comfort and privacy for family and guests. Outside, an expansive grassy yard, pool, and multiple entertaining areas create a secluded, resort-like setting. Thoughtfully adapted for contemporary living while preserving its mid-century character, the residence is a compelling expression of architecture, landscape, and the cinematic allure of the Hollywood Hills.

remarks: Offered for the first time in 50 years, this single-story South Whittier home has been held and carefully maintained by the same owner for five decades. The 3-bedroom, 1-bath floor plan lives comfortably and the major items have been addressed — updated roof, upgraded electrical panel, and refreshed kitchen and bathroom finishes — so a buyer can move in and personalize from there. The back yard shows the same long-term attention, with a mature guava tree and established rose bushes, and a detached structure at the rear provides additional flexible space with a bathroom, not reflected in the assessor's records. The property sits on a quiet residential stretch of Telechron Avenue and within the California High School area, close to the shops, markets, and restaurants along Whittier Boulevard and Whittwood Town Center, with the 5 and 605 freeways minutes away for an easy commute into downtown Los Angeles and/or Orange County.

remarks: FEE LAND. NO HOA.  Set above the city in Palm Springs' sought-after Araby Cove, beneath Steve McQueen's former Rimcrest residence, this private hillside villa captures sweeping views across the valley, surrounding mountains, the tram, and distant wind fields. From sunrise to the last light over the desert, the outlook shifts constantly. At night, the city glows below while the hills behind remain quiet and protected. Just 10 minutes from Palm Springs International Airport, the home offers both privacy and immediate access to the best of Palm Springs. Approximately 3,453 square feet, the home offers five bedrooms and four baths with a floor plan designed for both daily living and entertaining. Grand arched entry doors open to formal living and dining spaces with vaulted wood-beamed ceilings, multiple fireplaces, stone and quartzite flooring, and a custom open staircase. French doors throughout connect the interior to expansive outdoor terraces, balconies, pool and spa areas, and multiple places to gather or retreat. The kitchen features custom cabinetry, stone counters, gas cooktop, double ovens, breakfast nook seating, and direct views to the garden and pool terrace. A nearby family room with built-in wine storage opens seamlessly to the outdoor entertaining areas and custom barbecue space. Two guest suites are located on the main level, while the upstairs primary suite occupies a private wing with cathedral ceilings, hardwood floors, a walk-in wardrobe, spa-style bath, and balcony overlooking the valley below. Two additional guest bedrooms complete the upper floor. The property has been extensively upgraded with integrated smart home systems including cameras, alarm, Wi-Fi-enabled lighting, smart locks, thermostats, pool controls, sprinklers, and LED lighting throughout. Additional improvements include upgraded pool equipment, fire suppression system, on-demand hot water, new window treatments, and fresh interior and exterior paint. Since the last sale, the current owners have added a 55 panel (17.04 kw) solar energy system and two Tesla backup batteries, effectively eliminating the home's electric bill. Privately positioned against the hillside yet only minutes from downtown Palm Springs, dining, shopping, and hiking trails, this is a rare offering in one of South Palm Springs' most established and luxurious enclaves. No showings September 3 to 9. The property is rented.

remarks: Welcome to Ravenhill Park! This delightful 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom, 1,253 sq. ft. single-family residence is nestled in one of Hidden Valley Lake's most tranquil neighborhoods, offering a perfect blend of peaceful living and community amenities. Built in 2002, this one-level home features a light and airy layout, beginning with a vaulted ceiling living area and an abundance of natural light streaming through tons of windows. The wide open great room and breezy floor plan create an inviting space perfect for entertaining and everyday living. Enjoy a spacious great room that opens directly to the backyard for seamless indoor-outdoor flow. Beautiful kitchen which is open to the living and dining area provides ample storage as well as a pantry for additional storage. Find enjoyment in the serene surroundings from the partially covered rear patio and newly stained concrete patio that features a garden area and a large level area for entertaining. This home's terrific location is just around the corner from the local park. HOA amenities include a private swimming lake, community pool, tennis courts, dog parks, equestrian trails and stables, and so much more! Don't miss this wonderful opportunity to own a piece of this desirable community! Enjoy the best of Northern California! You'll be just a short drive from beautiful Clear Lake and only forty minutes from Calistoga and the world-renowned Napa Wine Country. Perfect for day trips boating on Clear Lake or Lake Berryessa, or wine tasting along the Silverado Trail.

remarks:
Spacious Home with Flexible Living Space and Great Potential,

set back from the road on a large lot, this spacious home offers privacy, plenty of living space, and room to personalize. The home features tall ceilings and crown molding throughout, with tile flooring in the entry, kitchen, and living room and vinyl plank flooring in the bedrooms and hallways.

The kitchen includes custom cabinetry, an island cooktop, and a reverse osmosis water system, with an open connection to the dining and living areas. The den/library features beautiful built-in cabinetry and can be used as a third bedroom, office, library, or hobby space.

The generously sized primary suite includes a large walk-in closet and a large private bathroom.

Outside, the fully fenced yard includes both front and rear decks along with a greenhouse. A large bonus room off the garage provides additional storage and could serve as a workshop or be converted in the future, subject to the necessary approvals.

The home also has a leased 7.54 kW solar system. Also, the long driveway offers tons of parking alongside for boats, RV's, trailers, etc.

This property needs some TLC and is priced accordingly, offering an opportunity for a buyer seeking a spacious home with a large lot, flexible living areas, and room to improve over time.

remarks: Set within the guard-gated Woodlands community, this extensively remodeled Carmelita detached home has been thoughtfully reconfigured to create a more open, polished living experience. Walls were removed to expand the kitchen and improve the flow into the main living area, while the bathrooms were redesigned as part of the renovation. Engineered wood flooring runs throughout, including custom flush transitions where the upstairs wood floors meet the bathroom tile. The gourmet kitchen features quartz countertops with a substantial 2-inch edge, mosaic glass-and-stone backsplash, warm wood cabinetry with glass-front details, an oversized single-basin stainless sink, Bosch dishwasher, Thermador 6-burner cooktop, custom low-profile vent hood with LED rim lighting, U-Line wine and beverage cooler, and an island with seating, crystal chandelier, and additional under-counter refrigeration space. LED accent lighting is integrated beneath the island and throughout the cabinetry, while recessed and dimmable LED lighting enhances nearly every room. The kitchen opens directly to the living area, anchored by a custom linear fireplace with crystal media. Premium silhouette light-filtering shades downstairs and Hunter Douglas shades upstairs complement the home’s custom window treatments. The downstairs powder room includes a bamboo vanity and vessel sink. Upstairs, the primary suite opens to a private balcony and features a remodeled bath with handmade travertine vessel sinks, a soaking tub, walk-in rain shower, and walk-in closet. The secondary bath offers an oversized shower with glass tile, dual shower heads, and custom extra-thick glass enclosures with protective coating. Double French doors lead to a private, low-maintenance backyard with lush landscaping, ideal for outdoor dining or a quiet morning coffee. Additional features include an attached two-car garage, no Mello-Roos, and access to The Woodlands’ Junior Olympic-size pool, tennis courts, sport court, hiking trails, BBQ and picnic areas, and playground, all close to Valencia Town Center, shopping, dining, entertainment, and freeway access.

remarks: Welcome to 211 Martha Place, a charming 1947-era home nestled on a beautiful, tree-lined street in Fullerton. This inviting 3-bedroom, 2-bath residence has plenty of potential and offers approximately 1,341 square feet of living space on a raised foundation and a spacious 6,480-square-foot lot, combining classic character with plenty of opportunity to make it your own.  A large primary bedroom and attached bath was added to the property (included in the square footage). The Comp roof is 1 year old, Termite fumigation was completed a year ago as well. Stove top, oven, sink and countertops are all newer.  Set in an established and welcoming neighborhood, the home enjoys a wonderful location just moments from a nearby park, providing an easy opportunity to enjoy outdoor recreation and green space. The generous lot offers room to relax, entertain, garden, or create your own private backyard retreat, with an enclosed patio for relaxing. The home’s vintage-era charm and comfortable floor plan provide a great foundation for those looking to preserve its character or bring their own vision and updates to the property. A detached 2-car garage at the back of the property adds convenience, parking, and storage. Ideally located with easy freeway access and close proximity to shopping, dining, schools, parks, and everyday conveniences, 211 Martha Place is a wonderful opportunity to own a home in a desirable Fullerton neighborhood in the Sunny Hills School District.  A classic home, a great street, and a location that makes everyday living convenient—this is one you won’t want to miss!

remarks: PRICED TO SELL! At $1,699,000, 87 Kingston Ct offers a fully renovated ground floor waterfront home priced in line with recent unrenovated sales in the same village. Enjoy the sound of halyards on the bay, crashing waves from the Pacific, and seabirds from this fully renovated and ADA accessible split floor plan in the Coronado Cays. This condo offers designer cabinetry, stainless appliances, and luxury vinyl plank flooring throughout, with an open-concept great room where the kitchen, dining, and living areas flow together. The west-facing corner position opens onto an oversized waterfront patio. The master-suite wakes up to the same water views, with walk-in closet and private owners' storage rounding out the layout. Step outside and you're a short walk from the tennis and pickleball courts, the neighborhood dog park, the Coronado Cays Yacht Club, and a casual lunch at Calypso Café. Grand Caribe Isle sits at the end of the peninsula for morning walks, evening fishing, and launching a paddleboard into the flat water. And when it's time to head out on your own boat, a 32.5-foot slip, included with your HOA, and long enough for a center console, day cruiser, or small sportfisher, is waiting steps from the unit. A single car attached garage provides for additional storage for all of your beach toys Fully renovated Cays waterfront homes at this price point are the exception, not the rule. At $1,699,000, this one won't wait long.

Perfectly positioned as a premium corner unit, this beautifully maintained tri-level townhome offers exceptional privacy, easy access in and out of the community, and an unbeatable location surrounded by some of the city's best amenities.

Built in 2022, this modern residence features 3 spacious bedrooms, 3 full bathrooms, and approximately 1,330 square feet of thoughtfully designed living space. Every bedroom includes a walk-in closet, creating the storage and functionality today's buyers are looking for. A paid-off solar system helps keep energy costs low while adding long-term value.

As you enter, you'll immediately notice the waterproof laminate wood flooring, recessed lighting, dual-pane windows, and contemporary finishes throughout. The heart of the home is the open-concept second floor, where the beautifully appointed kitchen showcases a large center island, shaker cabinetry, stainless steel appliances, and seamless flow into the dining and living areas. Upstairs, you'll find a convenient laundry area, a secondary bedroom with its own ensuite bathroom, and a spacious primary suite complete with a large private bathroom designed for comfort and relaxation.

Just steps away from Rosewood Park, the Commerce Library, City Hall, Community Center, and the renowned Brenda Villa Aquatic Center, you'll enjoy a lifestyle centered around convenience, recreation, and community. Whether you're taking the kids to the park, attending community events, or enjoying nearby shopping and dining, everything you need is right outside your door.

Commuters will appreciate being just minutes from Downtown Los Angeles, the Citadel Outlets, and major freeways including the 5 and 710, making travel throughout Southern California quick and convenient.

This is more than a home—it's an opportunity to create lasting memories, build your future, and enjoy the comfort, security, and convenience of modern living in one of Commerce's most desirable communities. Don't miss your chance to make this exceptional home yours. Schedule your private showing today.

remarks: First time on the market: the prestigious Rotohouse, in the exclusive Monument Manor neighborhood of Joshua Tree, California. This organic architectural treasure is just a mile to the entrance of the popular Joshua Tree National Park, sitting between two large mounds of boulders enhanced by spectacular sunset vistas. House designed by world-class architect Michael Rotondi in 2007 and renovated over the course of 10 years.  The main entrance is through a custom glass door entering a fun open-air atrium. The sophisticated floorplan incorporates 2 stories 1,845 sq feet, with 10ft. ceiling in the upstairs bedroom and 14ft. high opening on downstairs bedroom, three bathrooms, two in the master suite, his and hers.  Characterized by simple forms and open volumes, the main addition is a cube 25 feet on each side. Adjacent to that is a long, narrow storage building with a roof deck pointing to a phenomenal spectacle of heaped rocks and sexy Pinto Mountains. Raw and handcrafted, the rugged exterior wrapped in corten steel set the trend for hi-desert buildings. Mondo central air eases extreme desert climate offering perfect comfort throughout.  Every custom window frames extraordinary and enchanting wild desert scenery. The included adjoining 2.5 acre parcel is priceless on it's own. It offers the perfect location for a potential second epic dwelling; perhaps on piers, so as to offer infinite vistas east and west. With this purchase you are not just buying a house but the true character that inspires the Joshua Tree nature and lifestyle.

remarks:
Welcome to Seaside Heaven, a newly constructed South Sand Section townhome offering a refined blend of modern luxury and relaxed coastal living. The opportunity to own new construction in Manhattan Beach’s coveted South Sand Section is increasingly rare—particularly at a price point remarkably below today’s estimated replacement cost.
This elegant 3-bedroom, 3.5-bath residence features architectural plans by veteran architect Doug Leach, construction by 40-year local builder JRO Construction, and thoughtfully curated finish selections by esteemed Wendy Word Interiors. Crafted by one of Manhattan Beach’s most seasoned builders, no detail has been overlooked. Every finish, fixture, and architectural element has been intentionally considered to deliver exceptional quality, functionality, and timeless coastal appeal.
Ideally positioned in a true “Goldilocks” Sand Section location—perfectly situated between Hermosa Beach and downtown Manhattan Beach—Seaside Heaven puts you close to everything while maintaining a relaxed residential feel. Enjoy exceptional walkability to the beach, shops, dining, cafés, and the best of both downtown districts, creating a location that feels just right for the quintessential Manhattan Beach lifestyle.
Seaside Heaven pairs sophisticated design with everyday functionality, featuring a premier Thermador appliance package with a panel-ready French door refrigerator and 46-inch 6-burner dual-oven range, Taj Mahal quartzite countertops, a soapstone wet bar with integrated sink, natural slab surfaces throughout, rift-cut white oak cabinetry with custom architectural detailing, and bespoke stain-grade hemlock exterior wood siding.
The private primary suite provides an elegant retreat complete with a custom-designed closet, while an innovative covered third-level patio with skylights and infrared heat creates a seamless indoor-outdoor living experience designed for year-round coastal enjoyment.
Offering new construction, refined design, top-tier finishes, exceptional walkability. Seaside Heaven represents a rare opportunity to own an exceptionally crafted home in one of Manhattan Beach’s most desirable beachside neighborhoods.

remarks: Woodland Cabin Retreat with Private Guest Suite and Nature All Around! Cradled beneath a canopy of trees, this enchanting home offers a rare blend of comfort, beauty, and natural serenity. Set on a spacious mostly level double lot with a fenced backyard for privacy, it feels like your own hidden retreat in the woods. The entire property is truly turn- key, with thoughtful upgrades and pride of ownership throughout. Inside, hardwood floors run throughout the light-filled living spaces, where a cozy wood-burning fireplace invites you to unwind. The living room and primary bedroom both open directly onto a wraparound composite deck—anchored by a magnificent oak that rises through the center, seamlessly merging indoors with the surrounding forest. A fully finished lower level offers versatile space ideal for guests, a home office, or residential income while a backup generator adds peace of mind and helps ensure comfort during unexpected outages. Located in a quiet, family-friendly neighborhood, you'll enjoy easy access to two golf courses, swimming pools, and the trails of Boggs Mountain for hiking and mountain biking. Whether you're escaping for the weekend or putting down roots, this is a place to breathe deeply, live simply, and reconnect with what matters most.

remarks: Not your typical newer-construction condo. Residence 5005 at Domaine 39 has been transformed from standard builder finishes into a warm, intentionally layered home that blends Parisian and mid-century sensibility while offering the modern conveniences of a newer luxury building.Thoughtfully redesigned throughout, the interiors feature European oak flooring, custom wall treatments, elevated lighting, and a beautifully reimagined kitchen with quartzite countertops and backsplash, lacquered cabinetry, and upgraded hardware and fixtures. Every detail was carefully considered to give the home character, warmth, and depth rarely found in newer construction.The brilliant floor plan lives beautifully, with high ceilings, an open kitchen, and generous living and dining areas that flow to a large east-facing patio. From inside and out, breathtaking views stretch across Pasadena's iconic architecture to the San Gabriel Mountains from Colorado Blvd. and beyond, grounding a wonderful sense of this cherished city with a stunning backdrop for daily living.The residence also offers two parking spaces, including one with an electric vehicle charging station, plus UV-blocking film on all windows and numerous thoughtful electrical and plumbing upgrades.Set in the heart of Pasadena, Domaine 39 offers the ease of newer luxury living just moments from Old Town Pasadena, the historic Pasadena Civic Auditorium, buzzy new eateries and shops, and everything the city has to offer.For the buyer who dreams of newer construction with soulful and expert design, Residence 5005 is a truly unique offering: a sophisticated, elevated, and functional home with warmth, outdoor living, and unforgettable Pasadena mountain views.

remarks: Welcome to this charming 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom home with 1,580 square feet of living space, sitting on a corner lot with RV access! As you walk in, you’re welcomed into an open floor plan with a cozy family room featuring a large brick fireplace that gives the space so much character. The primary bathroom has been upgraded with vinyl flooring and features both a dual shower and tub. The other two bedrooms are nicely sized. Outside, the backyard offers plenty of potential with RV access, existing concrete, a storage shed, and lots of open space to make it your own. Whether you want to create an outdoor entertaining area, add a pool, or design your dream backyard, there’s plenty of room to work with. Conveniently located near the freeway, schools, the outlets, shopping, and restaurants, this home offers plenty of space, and a little bit of history and charm.

remarks: Enjoy effortless single-level living in the heart of Westlake Village in this beautifully maintained 2-bedroom, 2-bath residence with an attached 2-car garage and lake access. Located in the desirable Westshore community, the home shares just one wall yet offers the privacy, space, and feel of a single-family home.Westshore offers a wonderful lake-oriented lifestyle with access to Westlake Lake, a community dock, and a pool and spa exclusively for residents and their guests. Inside, vaulted ceilings, a central atrium, and an abundance of windows and sliding glass doors bring in beautiful natural light and create an airy, open feel throughout. Dual-pane windows, plantation shutters, and custom blinds complement the interiors, while the thoughtful floor plan offers both comfortable everyday living and easy entertaining.The sunny eat-in kitchen features granite countertops, a mosaic tile backsplash, stainless-steel appliances, travertine flooring, generous counter space, and ample cabinetry with pull-out storage. There is also room for a breakfast table, in addition to the home's spacious living room and formal dining area.The primary suite opens directly to the private rear garden and features dual closets and an en suite bath with a double vanity, separate dressing area, and abundant natural light. Located on the opposite side of the home, the second bedroom offers excellent separation and flexibility for guests, a home office, or den.Outside, the thoughtfully landscaped rear yard creates a peaceful extension of the living space, with a generous patio for dining and entertaining, a garden pathway, mature landscaping, and colorful plantings. A dedicated laundry room and direct-access two-car garage add everyday convenience, and the refrigerator, washer, and dryer are included.The HOA maintains the community's common areas, landscaping, building exteriors and roofs, private streets, and community dock, and also provides trash service, common-area utilities, limited exterior pest control, and exterior fire and earthquake insurance. The community has recently undergone significant improvements, including new tile roofs, fresh exterior paint, and new fencing--adding to its beautifully maintained and cohesive feel.A wonderful opportunity to enjoy easy, single-level living with private outdoor space, an attached two-car garage, and the unique lake lifestyle that makes Westshore such a special Westlake Village community.

remarks: Views Forever! Zoned Equestrian! Nestled in the sought-after Lake Hodges area, this exquisite custom home on a generous 1.33-acre lot offers views of the lake, rolling hills & majestic mountains. Inside-outside living is possible on three levels of this thoughtfully remodeled home. The property features luxurious upgrades & high-end finishes throughout. Enjoy sunny days by the oversized pool and hot tub or dine al fresco on the charming patio adjacent to the living area. The gourmet chef’s kitchen is equipped with top-of-the-line finishes, including quartz countertops, a Sub-Zero refrigerator, a Wolf range, and a Fisher & Paykel dishwasher. The kitchen, upper bathroom cabinets, and multiple built-ins are custom-crafted by a master cabinetmaker while the lower-level bathroom includes a floating vanity and vessel sink from Native Trails. The recently remodeled kitchen and bathrooms include high end Kohler fixtures. The property also includes a La Cantina kitchen window offering a seamless pass-through perfect for entertaining. The custom-designed laundry room offers ample storage and additional bespoke cabinetry with hidden extras such as a pull-out ironing board, extra power outlets, and an oversize stainless sink. Work from home? No problem in a private allocated office on the mezzanine level with more sweeping views. The primary bedroom features a custom walk-in California Closet and a beverage bar with a Zephyr refrigerator perfect for late-night beverages or early morning coffee or tea.  The private deck situated off the master is ideal for enjoying sunsets and sunrises! The master bath is equipped with a soaking tub, a rain shower, body jets, and a custom floating dual vanity with a powered hair dryer storage drawer. The backyard hosts a variety of fruit trees including apples, limes, multiple varieties of oranges, grapefruit and avocado as well as olives, loquats and figs. Zoned irrigation ensures all plants will thrive. Space abounds to keep animals, build an ADU, park your boat or RV, toys, or work truck. Experience the perfect blend of elegance and tranquility in this exquisite retreat, providing a serene atmosphere while being only a five-minute drive from the 15 freeway, shopping mall, schools, and parks. This location offers convenient access to both nature and urban amenities, making it an ideal spot for those who appreciate both. Enjoy beautiful views and outdoor activities nearby while remaining close to essential services and entertainment options.

remarks:
Highly sought-after residence in The Landing at Tustin Legacy! This top-floor (3rd level) home features beautiful sweeping views and boasts an enormous oversized private balcony, creating an incredibly comfortable outdoor living space. The functional layout offers 2 bedrooms, 2 full bathrooms, plus a versatile den and dedicated office space.
Proudly brought to the market for the very first time by its meticulous original owner, this stunning home features over $150,000 in high-end custom upgrades throughout every room. The entire home is finished with luxurious designer details, including artistic multi-stone accent walls, premium upgraded flooring, and a fully refined gourmet kitchen.
Every living area receives bespoke cabinetry upgrades with elegant integrated LED lighting, covering the living room, formal dining area, private office den, walk-in closet, and custom vanity makeup station. Thoughtful, high-quality built-ins elevate storage functionality while delivering a modern, sophisticated ambiance across the entire floor plan.
Loaded with premium smart-home and efficiency features: whole-home solar system, advanced air purification system, full smart home automation, and 24-hour building gate surveillance system. The home includes elevator access, a private two-car garage pre-installed with a Tesla charging station for ultimate convenience.
Residents enjoy access to resort-style amenities including a pool, BBQ and fire pit areas, tennis and pickleball courts, parks, and walking trails. Conveniently located near The District at Tustin Legacy, The Market Place, Irvine Spectrum, South Coast Plaza, John Wayne Airport, and major freeways, this home offers easy access to some of Orange County's best shopping, dining, and entertainment.
A rare turnkey opportunity in one of Tustin Legacy’s most competitive and hard-to-find communities.

remarks: Recently updated, this exceptionally private, walled and gated residence is available for the first time in 27 years. Spectacular panoramic views stretch from Downtown to the ocean and, on clear days, to Catalina, while mature trees and lush landscaping create a secluded, romantic, storybook setting above the city. A former celebrity retreat, the residence is tucked away on an intimate street shared by just four homes, moments from the heart of Beverly Hills. The 3,274-square-foot residence offers four bedrooms and four baths, with character-rich interiors featuring beamed and paneled ceilings, abundant natural light, and sweeping views from its principal rooms. The main level features a remodeled two-level kitchen designed for both cooking and gathering, with a Viking range, generous preparation space, abundant cabinetry, and an elevated seating area that encourages connection and interaction. The living room features exposed beams, a wood-burning fireplace, concealed drop-down projection screen, and dramatic city views, with French doors that open directly to a spacious wraparound terrace ideal for dining and entertaining. A formal dining room and two en-suite bedrooms complete the main level. One of these bedrooms is a window-wrapped room with views of the garden, city, and ocean, and is currently used as an office/den. Upstairs, the primary suite is a private retreat above the city, with a vaulted wood-paneled ceiling, wood-burning fireplace, and two walk-in closets. A beautifully remodeled primary bath features a dual vanity, walk-in steam shower, and jetted soaking tub, each positioned to take in sweeping city and city-light views. A second en-suite bedroom with a sitting area overlooking the view completes the upper level. The outdoor spaces are equally compelling, with lushly landscaped grounds, multiple areas for dining and lounging, and a sparkling swimming pool with sweeping views. With exceptional privacy, inspiring vistas, and flexible spaces for work and creative pursuits, the property offers a rare live/work retreat just minutes from the heart of Beverly Hills.

remarks:
Set on a premier cul-de-sac with enhanced privacy, 102 Balance is Cadence Park's most extensively upgraded estate, delivering over $600,000 in custom improvements across 4,834 square feet of architecturally refined living. At nearly 800 square feet larger than the average home being constructed in Great Park, this opportunity will not return.
The crown jewel is a $400,000 resort-style backyard unlike anything else in Irvine - a custom-built elevated spa with cascading waterfall features, ambient LED lighting, premium stone finishes, and a custom putting green. Designer lighting illuminates a tranquil Buddha feature wall, while built-in seating, modern retaining walls, mature landscaping, and high-end hardscape create a true private sanctuary. The expansive California Room and upgraded sliding doors dissolve the boundary between indoor and outdoor living.
Inside, 5 bedrooms, 5 full bathrooms, and 2 half bathrooms are arranged across an open-concept floor plan flooded with natural light. The gourmet chef's kitchen features modern cabinetry, premium appliances, a spacious center island, and an oversized walk-in pantry. A coveted main-level bedroom, a flexible loft, and multi-purpose spaces accommodate a home office, gym, or extended family living.
The primary suite is a true sanctuary, featuring a spa-inspired bathroom, custom walk-in closet, and a private balcony with sweeping mountain views where every morning begins with a breathtaking sunrise. Every additional bedroom enjoys ensuite privacy.
Custom closets throughout, new hard-surface flooring, statement wall paneling, premium window coverings, enhanced pantry and mudroom, dual EV charging stations, a Ring security system, and a pre-wired backyard sound system.
The lifestyle here is irreplaceable. Served by two of California's top-rated public schools, Cadence Park K-8 (ranked in the top 20% in California) and Portola High School (10/10 GreatSchools, A+ on Niche), both are within walking distance. Residents enjoy resort-style Cadence Park amenities including pools, spa, clubhouse, parks, and trails.
The neighborhood is also accelerating. The Canopy at Great Park opens just steps away in late 2026, bringing In-N-Out, Philz Coffee, H&H Bagels, T&T Supermarket, and a 10,000-seat amphitheater to your doorstep, transforming Cadence Park into Orange County's most coveted lifestyle address. Buyers seeking this level of size, finish, and location in Great Park will find no equivalent being built today.

remarks: Thoughtfully refreshed and beautifully renewed, this Cape Cod-inspired Montecito estate offers an elevated expression of East Coast character and coastal California living on more than 2 ocean and mountain view acres. Recent improvements, including fresh paint, updated finishes, enhanced garden fencing, and a refreshed presentation throughout, add a renewed sense of polish while preserving the home's timeless architectural character. A long-gated drive leads through mature trees and landscaped grounds to the shingled residence, where a columned entry and expansive stone motor court set a gracious tone. Inside, soaring ceilings, polished wood floors, detailed millwork, arched passageways, and abundant natural light create a warm and refined atmosphere. The living room makes a memorable impression with its vaulted ceiling, mezzanine balcony, fireplace, built-in window seating, and outlooks that carry across the gardens toward the ocean. The formal dining room features a fireplace, graceful windows, and French doors opening to the wraparound veranda. Nearby, the kitchen offers an inviting setting with new high-end appliances, generous cabinetry, a center island, skylights, and an easy connection to the home's everyday living spaces. The floor plan includes two-bedroom suites on the main level, a lower-level room for additional living, work, or leisure, and a private upstairs primary suite with a fireplace, sitting area, intimate loggia, dual closets, and treetop views toward the ocean and islands. Beyond the main residence, the estate includes a studio above the two-car garage, a separate guest cottage, and a storybook treehouse. Lush lawns, native boulders, mature trees, flowering gardens, exotic plantings, and rare botanical specimens surround a crescent-shaped pool with in-pool spa and a covered dining pergola with built-in grill. Altogether, the estate offers a rare sense of privacy, character, and ease, with layered gardens, ocean-view moments, and inviting spaces for both refined entertaining and relaxed everyday living.

Just a quick hop to the lake, UCLA conference center or out hwy 173 for some hiking or off-roading, this home offers the perfect location for all your needs. This home has been well maintained & recently had a full exterior paint job including the decks & railings.  There is a fenced dog run behind the house & access into the 2 car insulated garage from that area. Surrounded by lots of beautiful oak trees which will offer lots of shade in the summer but to keep you extra cool this home also has AC!  A great home for all seasons & ready to enjoy!

remarks:
1921 Wheaton Avenue is one of Claremont's most complete move-in-ready pool homes: a single-level 4-bedroom on a quiet cul-de-sac with mountain views, a gorgeous kitchen, and the expensive, invisible work already done.

Some homes are updated on the surface. This one goes much deeper: designer finishes, real infrastructure, owned solar, and luxurious outdoor living brought together in one reimagined package. What looks polished is also rebuilt behind the walls, so the next owner inherits the payoff, not the projects.

Step inside and it feels bright, calm, and cohesive. Wide-plank water-resistant laminate runs throughout, under fresh interior and exterior paint, upgraded vinyl windows, and recessed lighting: a clean, modern warmth from room to room, all on one easy single-story floor.

Then you reach the kitchen, and you stop. Euro-style cabinetry. A waterfall quartz island. Large-format tile backsplash, KitchenAid appliances, a chef-inspired pot filler, and a built-in wine cooler: a true showpiece built for cooking, hosting, and everyday life.

The bathrooms carry the same intention: new vanities, LED mirrors, rainfall showerheads, hot-and-cold bidet sprayers, and floor-to-ceiling tile that turns daily routines into something restorative. The primary suite adds a walk-in closet and ensuite bath.

Behind what you see is what careful buyers pay for: approximately 90% new electrical wiring, updated switches, outlets, and faceplates; new copper plumbing throughout; HVAC serviced with a cleaned evaporator coil and all-new ducts, vents, and registers; a roof professionally inspected and confirmed leak-free; and 28 fully paid, owned solar panels overhead, with no lease and no transfer fee.

Outside, the pool anchors a backyard made for easy California living, restored with new plaster, LED lighting, new plumbing, and updated electrical, ready from the first afternoon. Low-maintenance dryscape with gravel, rock formations, and curated plants surrounds it with sculptural calm, all on a generous 10,518-sq-ft lot backed by mountain views.

With all the extensive updates and poolside setting, this rare home leaves the hard work behind you. Click on the virtual tours below for the full story and visuals.

Other upgrades include dual-pane windows, LED lighting, updated AC, newer interior/exterior paint, & new flooring. A detached 2-car garage includes an oversized laundry room with cabinets; a 2-car driveway and ample street parking is available. Ideally located in high-demand OC near hospitals, physicians, rehabilitation centers, shopping, major freeways, & public transport, this exceptional property offers an outstanding opportunity to launch or expand an RCFE business or to simply enjoy as an elegant, move-in-ready home.
