remarks: SHORT SALE - SUBMIT ALL OFFERS!! Welcome to this stunning modern detached home in the Rosemist community of FivePoint Valencia. Situated on a prime corner lot, this expansive 5-bedroom, 4.5-bathroom, three-story residence offers over 3,300 square feet of thoughtfully designed living space with scenic mountain views. Upon entry, you’re greeted by a bright open-concept floor plan featuring sleek laminate flooring throughout and stylish designer light fixtures that create a clean, contemporary feel. The gourmet kitchen features a large center island with bar seating, sleek upgraded countertops with a herringbone backsplash, abundant storage, and stainless steel appliances including a professional-grade 6-burner cooktop with griddle, range hood, and built-in refrigerator. The kitchen opens to the living and dining areas, perfect for both everyday living and entertaining. The first level includes a convenient bedroom and full bathroom with updated fixtures and a Mid-Century modern vanity, ideal for guests or multi-generational living. On the second level, the spacious primary suite offers two closets including a walk-in closet, and an en-suite bathroom with dual vanities and a separate shower and bathtub. The second floor also features three additional bedrooms, including one with its own en-suite bathroom, another full bath, and a laundry room with plenty of storage. The third floor features an expansive bonus room complete with a connecting dry bar and powder room, offering a versatile space ideal for a home office, gym, or media room. Sliding doors open to a covered deck with sweeping mountain views. Designed for indoor-outdoor living, expansive corner sliding doors open to the California Room, seamlessly connecting to the backyard with low-maintenance artificial turf. Additional highlights include an attached 2-car garage with extra storage, direct home access, an EV charger, plus solar panels and a backup battery system. Enjoy the community’s impressive recreation areas. Just across the way is Confluence Park, an HOA recreational area featuring swimming pools, a spa and splash zone, lounge areas, a clubhouse, a park, and more. In addition, the community offers a community garden, pump track, and miles of scenic trails for residents to enjoy. Conveniently located minutes from Valencia Town Center, Six Flags Magic Mountain, shopping, dining, parks, and hiking and biking trails, with easy freeway access.

remarks: Welcome to 3837 Albury Avenue, a spacious single-story Traditional home located in the Lakewood City area of Long Beach. Additional features include a newer roof, separate laundry area, private backyard, long driveway and detached two-car garage. The home has been maintained over the years but remains substantially original, is ready for updating and is being sold in its present AS IS condition. Conveniently located near Heartwell Park, Long Beach City College, shopping, dining and major commuter routes, this property offers an opportunity to renovate and make it your own.

remarks: Nestled among the towering pines of Green Valley Lake, this inviting mountain home offers the perfect blend of comfort and natural beauty. From the moment you arrive, the lush forested setting sets the tone for the peaceful lifestyle that awaits inside. The main level is designed for both relaxed living and easy entertaining. The warm and welcoming living room centers around a stunning river rock fireplace, perfect for cozy evenings after a day spent exploring the surrounding wilderness. A separate family room provides additional space to spread out, while the dining area flows naturally from the well-appointed kitchen, making gatherings a breeze. Bedroom #1 and a full bathroom round out the main floor, offering flexibility for guests, a home office, or single-level living when needed. Upstairs, the primary bedroom serves as a true retreat, complete with a private balcony where you can sip your morning coffee and soak in sweeping forested views. A third bedroom and a second full bathroom complete the upper level, providing comfortable accommodations for family and visitors alike. The attached one-car garage adds convenience year-round, and with built-in storage and the laundry located inside the garage, day-to-day living is as practical as it is enjoyable. The backyard hill makes for perfect winter sledding, and the street is the first to get plowed in the winter. Whether you're searching for a full-time residence or a mountain getaway for hiking, off-roading, fishing, swimming, etc., this Green Valley Lake gem delivers the tranquility and charm that mountain living is all about.

Welcome to 23642 Oxnard Street, a beautifully reimagined  California ranch blending timeless character with today's sought-after organic modern design. Nestled on a quiet tree-lined street in the heart of Woodland Hills, this move-in-ready residence offers effortless indoor-outdoor living, thoughtful upgrades, and exceptional future potential. Bathed in natural light, the home showcases wide-plank hardwood flooring, designer finishes, a stunning custom fireplace with built-in cabinetry, an inviting open-concept living space, and an updated kitchen featuring premium Thermador appliances, refreshed cabinetry, and a seamless connection to the dining and family rooms. Energy-efficient sliding doors open to a private backyard oasis complete with a sparkling pool, spacious patio, pergola-covered entertaining area, children's playhouse, and lush landscaping perfect for year-round Southern California living. Located within the boundaries of several highly regarded public schools, including Woodland Hills Elementary, George Ellery Hale Charter Academy, and El Camino Real Charter High School.

VIEWS! 360 degrees from all roof terraces. Prices start at $599/SF or $1,274,900 for #B. A & D = $1,399,000, B = $1,339,000. Each residence has 4 beds/4 baths with an open-concept floor plan, ideal for entertaining. The main level features a living room, dining area, gourmet kitchen, entry, powder bath with shower, and direct access to a private backyard patio. There are no stairs needed due to an ADA lift and an elevator. The second-floor bonus room can serve as a family room, home office, gym, media room, or playroom—or simply add one wall to create a true fourth bedroom! A/C unit is on the roof. You’ll always be comfortable! The top-floor primary suite is a private retreat featuring a generous walk-in closet, freestanding soaking tub, oversized shower with rainfall showerhead, and its own private balcony. Showstopper...your private rooftop sky deck. Spectacular views stretching from the Western coastal sunset, Hollywood Sign and Downtown Los Angeles to SoFi Stadium, the San Gabriel Mountains, Long Beach, and the Palos Verdes hills. Whether you're entertaining guests or simply enjoying a sunset, the rooftop offers an unforgettable indoor-outdoor lifestyle. SCHOOLS! It is very possible that Lawndale residents can attend RB Schools! Call the district or agent for details. That said, Lawndale High is rated a B+. The secure gated garage provides each owner with two long side-by-side parking spaces to accommodate a car and motorcycles, or an RV, or additional storage. More highlights: Stainless steel refrigerator, dishwasher, microwave, range, washer, and dryer. Quartz counters. Solar: Pre-installed conduit from the roof to the electrical subpanel for easy future installation. 550 SF community patio/play area. EV universal chargers in the garage. 9 ft ceilings on 2nd floor! Milgard windows. 
LOCATION: Just 2.8 miles to the Hermosa Beach sand; also nearby are Riviera Village, King Harbor, Downtown Manhattan, The Point, El Camino College, and the revitalized Artesia Blvd dining/shopping district. South Bay Galleria is 3 blocks away, offering shopping and 16 theaters. Commuters have easy access to the 405, 105, 110, and 91 freeways. A rare chance to own brand-new construction with breathtaking views, modern design, and a great South Bay location.

remarks: Welcome to 2402 Altisma Way, Unit D, a beautiful townhome in the desirable Arroyo Villas community located near the world-renowned Omni La Costa Resort & Spa golf course and just minutes from Carlsbad's stunning coastline and north counties best beaches. Offering 1,620 square feet, the residence  lives like a single-family home.   As a unique and desirable corner unit with only one shared wall and no neighbors above or below, this home offers exceptional privacy.   Located near the community pool and spa, it perfectly balances peaceful surroundings with resort-style amenities.  The  light-filled, coastal-inspired ambiance,  vaulted ceilings, and split-level floor plan offer an open-concept layout for both everyday living and entertaining. The kitchen, dining area, spacious living room and private balcony, create an inviting space to gather with family and friends.  The two downstairs bedrooms offer generous closet and storage space.   The primary bedroom features a private balcony, while the second bedroom includes a sliding glass door leading to its own garden patio ideal for guests or multigenerational living.   This home is complemented by double-pane windows for enhanced energy efficiency and comfort, radiant heating, a  laundry area with ample storage,  refrigerator, dishwasher, brand-new garbage disposal, and a private two-car attached garage with direct interior access.  Ideally located in the heart of Coastal North County, you'll enjoy convenient access to top-rated schools, shopping, dining, recreation, and some of Southern California's most desirable destinations. Nearby amenities include La Costa Meadows Elementary (approximately 1 mile), Vons (1 mile), Alga Norte Community Park & Aquatic Center (1.5 miles), Costco, Trader Joe's, Sprouts, CVS, and the Bressi Ranch shopping district (2.5 miles), The Forum Carlsbad, Interstate 5 (3 miles), McClellan-Palomar Airport (approximately 10 minutes), Carlsbad's beautiful beaches (3.5 miles), nearby Batiquitos Lagoon, as well as the dining, shopping, and entertainment destinations of Carlsbad Village and downtown Encinitas just 6–7 miles away. Golf enthusiasts will appreciate close proximity to Omni La Costa Resort & Spa, Park Hyatt Aviara Golf Club & Spa, and within 30 minutes of the famous Torrey Pines Golf Course.  This is an affordable opportunity to own a unique home in one of Carlsbad's most sought-after communities.

This exceptional property offers a total of 5 bedrooms and 4 bathrooms, along with two spacious living rooms, each featuring a cozy fireplace. One living room provides direct access to the pool area, while the other opens to the backyard.

A standout feature of this home is the permitted ADU (Accessory Dwelling Unit) located above the garage. It has its own private entrance and dedicated parking space, making it ideal for rental income, multigenerational living, or a private guest suite.

This is an outstanding opportunity for buyers seeking a spacious, versatile home in a convenient location, with the added benefit of a permitted ADU and excellent income potential.

remarks:
Welcome home to luxury in the highly desirable 55+ community of Sendero by Del Webb. This beautifully appointed single-family detached residence with expansive views features a bright, single-level floor plan. Thoughtfully designed with 2 split-wing bedroom suites for maximum guest privacy, plus a dedicated central office space perfect for remote work, a library, or hobbies. Designed for energy efficiency and sustainable living, the home comes complete with seller-owned solar power, and EV charging for year-round energy savings. 

Designed for effortless indoor-outdoor living and seamless entertaining, the home boasts a sprawling open-concept layout connecting the central kitchen, dining area, and inviting living room. Cook with ease in the gourmet kitchen featuring premium KitchenAid appliances throughout, a large functional center island with breakfast bar seating, upgraded countertops, self-closing cabinetry, and ample pantry storage. Conveniently located just off the kitchen, the dedicated laundry room offers an abundance of room with custom built-in storage solutions and utility workspace.

The primary suite serves as a true peaceful retreat, featuring spectacular multitrack sliding glass doors that open directly to the outdoor patio, effortlessly blending indoor and outdoor living spaces. The spa-like primary bath is complete with dual vanity sinks, a generous walk-in closet, and a spacious walk-in shower enhanced with dual shower heads.

Enjoy the outdoors from every angle—start your morning on the welcoming front yard porch, which offers plentiful space for comfortable outdoor furniture. Out back, step onto your private covered patio built for year-round entertaining, featuring a cozy gas firepit, a premium built-in barbecue, and breathtaking panoramic east-facing views of the community and surrounding mountains.

Direct access to exclusive 55+ Gavilán community amenities—including a private clubhouse, resort-style pool and spa, fitness center, pickleball courts, and miles of scenic walking trails—are only a short preview of what this vibrant community has to offer.

remarks: Behind gates, mature hedges, and exceptional security, 460 S. Las Palmas Avenue is one of Hancock Park's most complete private resort estates a meticulously reimagined residence offering timeless architectural character, extraordinary entertaining spaces, and an array of modern enhancements rarely assembled in one property. A grand motor court surrounded by mature trees, sculpted landscaping, and tranquil fountains creates an immediate sense of privacy and arrival. Inside, the impressive foyer introduces richly appointed formal rooms, including a mahogany-clad dining room and an elegant living room distinguished by intricate ceiling moldings. Custom de Gournay and Gracie wall coverings, bespoke designer drapery, and carefully considered finishes lend refinement and individuality throughout. At the center of the home, an expansive designer kitchen opens seamlessly to an oversized family room, creating a warm and inviting setting for everyday living as well as large-scale entertaining. A porte-cochre provides convenient direct access to the kitchen, while a private home office offers a sophisticated environment for working from home. The expansive primary suite unfolds across four beautifully conceived rooms, including a luxurious bath and private terrace with sweeping views toward Downtown Los Angeles. Five additional bedroom suites provide generous accommodations, bringing the estate's total to six en-suite bedrooms and ten baths. Beyond the main residence, a remarkable approximately 1,800-square-foot poolside guest pavilion elevates the property into a true private compound. Designed for recreation, wellness, and extended stays, it features a cinema-scale theater, spacious home gym, cabana, and three baths. The resort-caliber grounds have been extensively enhanced with water-conscious sustainable turf, a remodeled pool and spa, a private mini-golf and putting experience, lush gardens, and a beautifully curated fruit and vegetable garden. An outdoor living terrace is anchored by a fireplace and a fully equipped entertaining kitchen with bar, grill station, and commercial wood-fired pizza ovenan exceptional setting for intimate dinners or grand celebrations. Further amenities include an integrated sound system throughout, enhanced interior and exterior security, a backup generator, two-car garage and parking for 8, and abundant gated driveway parking. Offered with its designer furnishings included in the sale price, 460 S. Las Palmas Avenue represents a rare turnkey opportunity: a private, secure, and fully realized luxury estate in the heart of Hancock Park's coveted Garden District.

remarks: Just south of Mountain St. in Rossmoyne, known for its historic homes and tree-lined streets, this grand 1927 Tudor may just be the ultimate "Starter Mansion." With four bedrooms, three baths, and approximately 2,810 square feet, the house presents a remarkable collection of architectural details and craftsmanship. The vaulted living room features exposed beams, hardwood floors, beveled-glass windows, and a brick fireplace anchoring the space. French doors invite you out to the private south patio.  An ideal spot for afternoon tea. Throughout the home, arched openings, original wood doors and windows, stained and beveled glass, period lighting, and a wrought-iron stair railing add distinctive character.The formal dining room opens through French doors to the porte-cochere, while the breakfast room looks out to the garden. remarks: There is a particular quiet at 411 Glenwood Avenue.  Stand on the main level and look through walls of glass. The first thing you notice is the treetops. The second is what you do not see: neighbors. The Oak canopy and the open expanse of the Joan Olson Preserve fill the windows instead. Friends who visit call it the Treehouse. The kitchen opens to the great room, with stone counters and a gas cooktop. Walls of glass open onto a broad deck for slow dinners, the preserve as backdrop. Upstairs, the bedrooms share that same treetop view.  Downstairs adds real flexibility: an open room with a slider to a flat, green yard, suited to an office or playroom, an en suite bedroom with its own patio, plus laundry and storage.  Cross the street and you are on a trailhead into the preserve, a shortcut into downtown Woodside on foot, coffee in hand, oaks the whole way. Downtown, with the Village Bakery, Buck's, and Highway 280, is minutes out.  The home sits within the highly rated Woodside Elementary School District, TK - 8.  411 Glenwood does not ask you to choose between nature and convenience. It offers both, as the best Woodside properties do.

remarks:
There is a particular kind of quiet that only exists at the end of a cul-de-sac, and this home sits right in the middle of it. A wide front yard stretches out under a mature shade tree, the kind of spot where you end up outside more often than not, watching bikes and scooters loop the circle while the afternoon settles in. It is the sort of setting that is hard to manufacture and easy to recognize the moment you stand in it.
Inside, the home offers 3,490 square feet across two stories, four bedrooms plus a versatile loft, and three bathrooms, all set behind a rare three-car garage. The layout is built to flex. The loft was originally framed as a fifth bedroom option and can be converted with ease, making it equally suited as a home office, a playroom, a homework space, or a second gathering room, whatever the next chapter calls for. A pass-through fireplace connects the living and family rooms, giving the downstairs a natural flow between everyday living and more relaxed entertaining. The kitchen centers on a large island with neutral granite counters and warm medium-toned wood cabinetry, opening easily into the main living space. Flooring is tile through the kitchen and high-traffic areas, with newer carpet throughout the remainder, and every wall has been refreshed with new paint. Bathrooms are clean, neutral, and well cared for.
Outside, the side yard is already paved and ready for outdoor dining and grilling, a blank canvas for whatever setup fits your routine. The backyard's natural slope keeps upkeep light, while the real outdoor living happens where the home was made for it: that front yard, that shade tree, that cul-de-sac.
Located in the La Sierra neighborhood of Riverside and zoned for Alvord Unified, this is a home built around flexibility and everyday livability. If space to grow into and a setting like this one are what you have been waiting for, let's set up a time to see it in person.

Bring your vision and transform this unique property into something truly special.

remarks: This incredible estate property is located west of the 15 fwy in a coveted area of Norco. This two story home is a sight to see with a recently remodeled kitchen that has 15 ft. long Island for all your chef needs and then some! Stainless steel appliances, granite counters, farm sink, all opening to the massive family and living room areas. You don't see homes like this very often so don't miss out!!!

remarks: Opportunities like this simply do not come around often in Orange Park Acres. Set on a full acre at the end of a quiet cul-de-sac in Lazy Creek Country Estates, this 5,555-square-foot custom estate is priced well below market value, creating a rare opportunity to get into one of Orange County’s most desirable and tightly held communities. Rebuilt in 2011, the six-bedroom, six-and-a-half-bath home showcases incredible craftsmanship, with extensive work completed by a finish carpenter. Custom cherry hardwood floors, detailed moldings, door casings, built-ins and cabinetry are found throughout. This isn't mass-produced luxury—you can see and feel the quality everywhere. Here's where it gets fun! Hidden doors and secret spaces are tucked throughout, including a bookshelf that opens to a hidden bathroom. Then there’s the backyard castle—and yes, it’s a real castle. Two underground levels offer endless possibilities: wine cellar, private speakeasy, game room, man cave, she-shed or quite possibly the greatest kids’ hideout ever created. The chef’s kitchen features rare green marble countertops, custom cabinetry, oversized island, Wolf range and Sub-Zero refrigerator, plus a separate butler’s pantry. Multiple living spaces open directly to the backyard for true indoor-outdoor living. Outside, the park-like grounds feature a PebbleTec saltwater pool and spa with waterfalls, rock cave and slide, outdoor fireplace, fire pit, built-in barbecue, fountains, mature landscaping and an outdoor bathroom. A four-stall center-aisle barn provides direct access to Orange Park Acres’ extensive horse trail system. A four-car garage with workshop and gym space, dual primary suites, private offices, additional kitchen, dual laundry areas, whole-property sound and a natural-gas Generac generator round out the property. One acre. Incredible craftsmanship. Horses. Resort-style backyard. Secret rooms. And an underground castle. There simply isn't another house quite like this one.

remarks: Well-positioned on an end lot in the sought-after Broadmoor enclave, this home is sure to impress those in pursuit of a highly-upgraded single-level with panoramic ocean, Catalina, sunset, & Saddleback views. Having undergone a major remodel in 2022 including the kitchen, bathrooms, fireplaces, interior doors, smooth-finish walls, flooring & other extensive interior updates, the home is dialed-in. Since new ownership in 2023, many key improvements were made with a focus on quality, comfort & indoor/outdoor living. Upon arrival, the extensively updated exterior with new hard & softscaping creates an outdoor environment designed to complement the views & Southern CA lifestyle. Newly-pavered driveway & patios, smooth walls, high-end glass railings, privacy gate, new plantings & irrigation, extensive outdoor lighting & all-new drainage were all completed in 2025. Two in-line gas fire pits warm unique exterior scenes for those spectacular evening views. Outdoor amenities include a hot tub, outdoor shower, & an entertaining courtyard with a built-in grill & Big Green Egg. Inside the new modern pivot door, the ocean-view living, family & dining rooms feature soaring wood ceilings framed by large-scale picture windows with stunning views beyond - all warmed by the central dual-sided fireplace. The chef’s kitchen was further enhanced with new Thermador appliances in 2026, complementing the previous remodel, updated lighting, & new kitchen skylight. Improvements beyond include: completely re-piped in 2024, whole-home water filtration system, kitchen & bathroom faucets, RO drinking water, recent exterior paint, 2023 fumigation, new A/C ductwork, blown-in insulation, automated light switches, electric shades, EV charging, custom curtains, Elfa closet organizers, motorized skylight in bathroom, epoxy garage flooring & cabinetry 2023, new garage door & lift 2025 & owned solar for reduced expenses. Extensive improvements to infrastructure, technology, interior finishes & outdoor living result in a highly-upgraded home with resort-style exterior, all with panoramic views. Occupying a large 9,550 SF corner lot (only one immediate neighbor), this property sits on a single-loaded street with major off-street parking (accommodates extended Sprinter) & a finished 2-car garage. Central to all that DP & SC have to offer: Verde Park & tennis courts, new restaurants, world-class surf, oceanfront beach trail, nearby shopping, SC Pier, great beach access & the DP Harbor remodel.

remarks: Positioned along Tower Lane, a secluded private road just off Benedict Canyon, this exceptional Beverly Hills tennis-court estate offers a rare sense of tranquility and retreat only minutes from the heart of Beverly Hills. Spanning nearly three-quarters of an acre across two tax parcels, the property is defined by its championship-size tennis court, mature landscape and remarkable sense of privacy. Previously the estate of noted film and television producer Lester Persky, the residence also carries a distinguished design pedigree: its interiors were conceived by acclaimed New York design firm Fox-Nahem, whose work in Los Angeles is notably limited, lending the home a level of design exclusivity rarely found in the city. A vine-covered facade and tree-lined approach introduce approximately 8,800 square feet of beautifully proportioned interiors. The residence has undergone two extensive remodels, including upgrades to the electrical and plumbing systems and a new roof, resulting in a home that feels both architecturally established and fully considered for contemporary living. The formal living room is distinguished by coffered ceilings, a fireplace and abundant natural light, while the family room is anchored by exposed wood beams and its own fireplace. In the dining room, distinctive architectural latticework creates a tailored sense of enclosure, while multiple sets of glass doors open the principal rooms directly to the gardens. The chef's kitchen is refined and highly functional, with marble countertops, a substantial center island and professional-grade Wolf and Sub-Zero appliances. An adjoining breakfast room with built-in banquette seating offers a more relaxed setting for everyday dining, while two separate laundry rooms add another layer of practicality to the home. The primary suite has been completely reimagined as a private sanctuary, with vaulted ceilings, a fireplace and dual walk-in closets. Separate his-and-hers bathrooms bring an added sense of privacy and luxury to the suite. Five additional bedrooms include a dedicated guest wing with its own private entrance, creating a discreet, self-contained retreat for visitors, extended stays or staff. The grounds are the defining feature of the estate. A championship-size tennis court sits alongside the swimming pool and spa within a landscape of mature trees and layered plantings, creating a setting that feels worlds removed from the city. An expansive covered outdoor pavilion extends the living spaces into the garden, with dedicated areas for lounging and dining alongside a full outdoor kitchen and barbecue. A separate pool house completes the resort-like environment. With six bedrooms, eleven baths, a three-car garage, two tax parcels and one of Beverly Hills' increasingly rare private tennis courts, 9910 Tower Lane brings together privacy, design pedigree and recreational scale within a tranquil setting just minutes from the celebrated shopping, dining and amenities of Beverly Hills.

remarks: Price Reduced - Ready to Sell! Welcome to resort-style living, only 2 miles from Ocean Beach, Point Loma Tennis Club offers the best of San Diego - ocean breezes, easy beach access, and a central location close to everything. Here is your opportunity to live in a west-facing townhome, no neighbors above or below, with two bedrooms, in-unit laundry, triple-pane windows, and central HVAC. Point Loma Tennis Club features green belts and lots of open space, with a night security guard on premises.  It also offers a resort-style clubhouse with multiple game rooms, an exercise room, saunas in the locker rooms, a pool, spa, BBQ areas, and tennis and basketball courts. The ideal location makes it easy to enjoy all of San Diego, with easy access to the 5 and 8 freeways. The international airport is only 10 minutes away, and Balboa Park is a short 15 minute drive. VA buyers welcome - short drive to MCAS Miramar, and San Diego and Coronado Naval Bases. This property is also a great opportunity for students. Public schools are all within a 5 minute drive: Loma Portal Elementary (K-4), Dana Middle School (5-6), Correia Middle School just across the street (7-8), and Point Loma High School (9-12). College students enjoy a quick 12 minute drive to University of San Diego and San Diego City College, and 20 minutes or less to Mesa College, UCSD, and SDSU. The Old Town Transit Center is only 2 miles away, served by the trolley, bus, Coaster, and Amtrak. Enjoy hiking at adjacent Famosa Trail Slough, and nearby Tecolote Canyon. Whether a first home, downsizing, or a vacation getaway, this property offers a low-maintenance lifestyle in a central location.

The fresh interior remodel adds to the value and features a brand new kitchen including counters, cabinets, flooring, and appliances! remarks: Welcome home to this beautifully reimagined Silver Lake townhome, where soaring open living spaces, rich hardwood floors, and a brand-new designer kitchen come together for effortless, elevated everyday living. Just steps from the Music Box Stairs, Sunset Junction, and the Silver Lake Reservoir, this 3-bedroom, 3-bathroom retreat pairs the neighborhood's best walkability with total privacy and calm.  The main level unfolds around a sunken living room anchored by a cozy fireplace, opening onto a large shared backyard that's anything but typical for a shared living space, with room for garden beds for anyone with a green thumb, space to host backyard get-togethers, and plenty of room for a pet to run and play. The all-new kitchen is the heart of the home, with sleek white cabinetry, quartz countertops, and brand-new stainless steel appliances.Upstairs, all three bedrooms are grouped together for true separation of living and sleeping spaces. The primary suite is a serene, light-filled escape with a spacious walk-in closet and a spa-style bathroom built around a deep soaking tub, the kind of room that makes you want to linger.  The updates run deep: brand-new HVAC, a new roof, a new tankless water heater, new Milgard double-pane windows throughout, and fully updated bathrooms. Direct private-garage access plus a tandem spot brings total parking to three, and a full security system (alarm, coded entry gate, and cameras) adds everyday peace of mind. HOA is just $300/month, among the lowest in the neighborhood.  A rare, fully refreshed offering in the heart of Silver Lake. Homes with this much light, space, and turn-key ease don't come around often.

remarks: Perched at the end of the street with no neighboring homes, this 10,000+ square foot masterpiece within the prestigious 24 hour guard-gated community of The Country represents the pinnacle of custom California living. Sweeping views and absolute privacy frame every moment, while an unmatched level of craftsmanship sets this residence in a category entirely its own. The home announces itself from the entry, where a show-stopping Italian hand-blown glass light fixture lowers by key switch, and a sculptural staircase rises alongside individually hand-blown glass spheres. Jerusalem and travertine stone floors transition seamlessly to rich walnut throughout the living spaces, with Marvin and Milgard windows framing the views like living art at every turn. The kitchen leaves nothing to the imagination leather-finish granite countertops complete with warming drawers, refrigerator drawers, a built-in steamer, and an inlaid blender and mixer station, keeping every surface clean and every tool within reach. Entertaining reaches new heights with a fully soundproofed home theater and bar, a temperature-controlled wine cellar, and a resort-caliber lap pool with swimming current and waterfall. Whole-home Sonos audio flows throughout, while five AC zones, paid-off solar panels, a fully sprinklered structure, residential elevator servicing all 3 levels, and a laundry chute reflect an estate engineered as thoughtfully as it is designed. A five-car garage completes the picture. The primary suite is a true sanctuary a vertical-fill Japanese soaking tub and steam shower transform the daily ritual into something deeply restorative. Properties of this caliber, in this setting, do not come twice.

remarks: Come enjoy a little slice of European luxury in Thousand Oaks with this sparkling 2 bedroom, 2 bath home in the 55+ community of Oaknoll Villas.   This recently updated first-floor condo has smooth ceilings, newer HVAC, fresh paint, wide-plank luxury vinyl flooring, and a gorgeous kitchen with custom glazed shaker cabinetry, soft-close construction, Calacatta-inspired counters and backsplash, brass hardware, and a coordinated Cafe appliance suite.   The beautifully appointed adjacent dining room room features a statement chandelier, while the cozy living room is so inviting, you'll want to spend your days reading, relaxing or catching up with friends.   The living room flows onto a patio which showcases a handcrafted encaustic tile floor that serves as the centerpiece of this private outdoor living space, complemented by mature birch trees, climbing vines, and lush landscaping that create an intimate European-inspired garden atmosphere.  Down the hall we have a primary bedroom with custom lighting and expansive windows that allows plenty of natural light and views of greenery. The adjacent primary bathroom has been remodeled with brass fixtures, marble herringbone, glazed ceramic tile, a large wall niche, a soaking tub and elegant lighting.  A secondary bathroom with shower has the same complementary updates, including brass fixtures, penny floor tile and a handy shower niche. The secondary bedroom opens up to the patio for your continued enjoyment of the outdoor area.  Oaknoll Villas has wonderful amenities including pool, spa, clubhouse, weight room, billiards room, card room, shuffleboard courts, yoga room & dog park.   The HOA includes trash, cable/internet, complimentary plumbing service, plenty of guest parking and landscape maintenance. This active SENIOR community is all electric, has carports for parking, is centrally located and very close to nearby parks, Conejo Valley Botanical Garden, shops and restaurants, The Oaks Mall and the Hillcrest Center for the Arts. Please note, no investors allowed. Laundry room is located on 3rd floor of this elevator building

Mediterranean-inspired architecture, arched exterior details, and a private covered entry add to the home’s distinctive appeal. Tesoro Trails residents enjoy HOA-maintained common areas, a playground, barbecue facilities, and a picnic area. Conveniently located near shopping, dining, parks, walking and biking trails, and award-winning Saddleback Valley Unified schools. An excellent opportunity to personalize a well-sized home in a centrally located Rancho Santa Margarita neighborhood.

remarks: Welcome home where comfort, style, and privacy come together in Paso Robles wine country! Situated in the lovely Highlands neighborhood with close proximity to town. This beautifully crafted home features many upgrades with fine finishes, custom quality, stunning views, and privacy all at once. Enter through the gated courtyard to the impressive open floor plan with a large formal dining room and an arched entrance into the nicely appointed kitchen with custom cabinetry and unique granite counter tops. The breakfast area offers expansive views of the Paso Robles rolling hills. The impressive great room boasts a Defiant Encore combination wood/catalytic stove, a stacked stone wall, and picture windows that allow you to enjoy the stunning backyard view and firepit. The 393 square foot guest quarters offers its own private entrance with French doors, and a balcony. The guest bedroom is spacious enough for a queen bed. It has a private bathroom and a sweet kitchenette. Your guests will enjoy their very own retreat with privacy, comfort, and views.  Additionally, in the backyard there is a 10x10 building with hand rolled round trusses and a steel roof just perfect for a gym, office, art room or storage. The 2-car garage is 35 foot long with 11 foot ceilings, and a roll-up rear door.  Adjacent to the garage is additional gated parking for your RV or boat. The many upgrades include Electric car charger, larger Solar Panel, new Kitchen Hood, new Dish Washer, and a barn door for easy access to one of the guest rooms. Do not wait to experience this one of a kind luxurious property on the central coast!

remarks:
A garden lover’s retreat in the heart of Laguna Woods Village. Lush landscaping, including roses and plumeria, frames the entry of this beautifully updated 2-bedroom, 2-bath end-unit Granada. Wrought-iron fencing expands the garden patio area in front of the Dutch door, with additional patio space to the side and views toward an open green lawn, with the Serpentine pathway just beyond. Quiet interior location, no one above or below, and close to the carport.
Pass through the Dutch door into 1,040 square feet of living space with vaulted ceilings, skylights, crown molding and a relaxed beach vibe. Half-inch-thick solid wood flooring adds warmth and character. The remodeled kitchen features granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, a wine refrigerator and custom white cabinetry. An arched opening leads to the dining room with its high ceiling, large skylight and custom corner cabinetry.
The primary bedroom features full-wall mirrored closet doors, custom cabinetry, plantation shutters and a cleverly concealed washer and dryer. The second bedroom includes custom built-in cabinetry and a skylight. Two full bathrooms feature marble vanities and tile finishes, along with an extra-large tiled shower with 1/2-inch-thick glass walls and imported German bath fixtures. Solar tubes bring in additional natural light.  Ceiling fans in the living room, dining room and bedrooms, along with central heat and air and dual-pane windows, add to the home's everyday comfort.
Laguna Woods Village is a gated 55+ community offering championship golf, pools, fitness centers, pickleball, tennis, clubhouses and an extensive variety of clubs and activities. Transportation is available throughout the Village and to nearby shopping and services. Gorgeous Laguna Beach is just 7 miles away. A peaceful and yet stimulating single-level living environment.  Ease into the luxurious and peaceful lifestyle in this gorgeous unit.
